title: Principal R&D Engineer - FEA
description:
Job Title: Principal R&D Engineer - FEA

Location: Simpsonville, SC

Reports To: R&D Engineering Manager

Employment Type: Full-time

Seniority Level: Senior Level

Industry: Manufacturing | Mechanical Power Transmission Components | Engineering Services

Job Function: Engineering | Research & Development

Job Summary: The Principal R&D Engineer will act as a principal engineer for the team to drive improved decision-making skills and advanced educational development for team members. This individual will lead major multi-phase R&D projects and teach less skilled colleagues to improve overall R&D team performance. The role maintains awareness of state-of-the-art technology, as well as Dodge products and technologies, and identifies and understands technical drivers for R&D projects. The Principal R&D Engineer understands what creates customer value in own R&D projects and project portfolio, works to improve operations, increase customer satisfaction, and provides consulting services to business operations and customers.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Excellence

  • Act as a senior engineer for the team to drive improved decision-making skills and advanced educational development for team members.
  • Act as the technology leader for large multi-phase new product development projects that require advanced R&D and project management skills.
  • Innovate and implement industry-leading technologies to solve identified challenges within a problem statement that can be incorporated into assigned products and/or processes.
  • Demonstrate sound fundamental technical proficiency in own competence area.
  • Emphasis on critical thinking, root cause analysis, and problem solving.

Innovation & Creativity

  • Lead the peer team in creating new and innovative solutions that exceed the performance of current technologies.
  • Demonstrate an entrepreneurial innovative spirit to R&D projects with own unique and creative ideas.
  • Propose follow-up projects and activities within own technical area based on new ideas.

Projects, Processes & Tools

  • Demonstrate sound understanding of, and actively apply, R&D processes and tools.
  • Examples include sound communication capabilities, advanced project management processes, use of 2D and 3D CAD tools, advanced understanding of FEA, and awareness of industry standards applicable to area of expertise.

Knowledge Transfer

  • Actively teach own technical/scientific knowledge to less skilled colleagues in applying processes and tools to ensure timely and high-quality results.
  • Show solid documentation skills and write technical reports independently.

Strategic Vision & Leadership

  • Proactively seek to identify opportunities for new or advanced technologies that could be used for product enhancements or new product needs based on problem definition and project scopes.
  • Initiate business review of new technology ideas with business team members.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum of 20 years of engineering experience in the design, analysis, and development of mechanical products or systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in mechanical design principles, including structural mechanics, materials, manufacturing processes, and product development.
  • Significant experience performing and interpreting Finite Element Analysis (FEA).
  • Advanced proficiency with commercial FEA software, preferably ANSYS; experience with Abaqus is also acceptable.
  • Proven record of technical innovation demonstrated through patents, patent applications, invention disclosures, intellectual property development, or commercialization of new technologies.
  • Exceptional mechanical aptitude with the ability to quickly diagnose, analyze, and solve complex engineering problems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Significant experience designing metallic products, components, or engineered systems.
  • Experience leading design, and technical problem-solving efforts for highly engineered products.
  • Recognized industry expertise through publications, patents, conference presentations, technical committee participation, or other professional accomplishments.
  • Experience supporting products throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept development through validation, production, and field support.

Physical Demands:

  • Extended periods of sitting and/or standing at a desk or computer workstation.
  • 5-10% travel to meet with clients or attend meetings (overnight travel as needed).
  • Ability to type, reach, and grasp.
  • Able to carry, lift, and pull up to 50 lbs.
  • Reach, climb, crawl, walk.
  • Speak and present in person or virtually to individuals and small groups.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Serve as the organization's principal technical expert for mechanical design, analysis, and engineering problem solving.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple product lines, development programs, and engineering disciplines.
  • Mentor engineers at all levels, helping to elevate technical capabilities throughout the organization.
  • Lead the resolution of the most challenging engineering and design issues.
  • Drive innovation through the creation of new technologies, product concepts, and intellectual property.
  • Conduct and oversee advanced analytical evaluations, including structural, thermal, fatigue, and nonlinear FEA studies.
  • Establish engineering best practices, design methodologies, and analytical standards.
  • Review and approve critical engineering analyses, designs, and technical recommendations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, quality, product management, testing, and research organizations to ensure successful product development.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, materials, analytical methods, and industry best practices.

Why Join Us?

  • Work alongside a collaborative, experienced leadership team.
  • Be part of an industry leader with a strong brand reputation and an innovation-driven culture.

title: Person In Charge (PIC)
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, innovate, and contribute to the growth of a company that values great service and lasting customer relationships. This position offers the chance to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment that’s constantly evolving.


Position Summary

The Person In Charge (PIC) is responsible for overseeing store operations in the absence of the Store Director and Assistant Store Director. The PIC ensures a safe, customer-focused, and operationally efficient environment while providing leadership and direction to associates across all departments. This role supports sales growth, customer satisfaction, and compliance with company policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities Store Leadership
  • Assume responsibility for overall store operations when designated as the acting manager.
  • Provide leadership, direction, and support to associates across all departments.
  • Ensure company policies, procedures, and operational standards are consistently followed.
  • Communicate priorities and operational expectations to department teams.
Customer Experience
  • Promote a customer-first culture throughout the store.
  • Respond to customer questions, concerns, and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Ensure departments maintain high standards of service, cleanliness, and presentation.
  • Foster positive shopping experiences that encourage customer loyalty.
Operational Execution
  • Monitor store conditions to ensure cleanliness, organization, and readiness for business.
  • Assist with merchandising, inventory replenishment, and promotional execution.
  • Ensure proper opening, closing, and shift transition procedures are followed.
  • Support department managers in achieving operational goals.
Safety & Compliance
  • Maintain a safe environment for associates and customers.
  • Enforce food safety, sanitation, and workplace safety standards.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, cash handling procedures, and asset protection programs.
  • Address and report operational or safety concerns promptly.
Associate Support & Development
  • Provide guidance and support to associates during daily operations.
  • Coach associates on service expectations and operational procedures.
  • Promote teamwork and positive working relationships across departments.
  • Assist with training and onboarding efforts as needed.
Inventory & Asset Protection
  • Support inventory management and shrink reduction initiatives.
  • Monitor store assets and ensure proper operational controls are followed.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce loss.

title: 2027 Graduate - Modeling, Simulation and Analysis Tool Software Developer
company: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory
description:
Description

Are you looking for exciting opportunities that will continue to challenge and develop your technical abilities throughout your career?

Do you want to work as part of engineering and analysis teams which help solve some of our country's most complicated defensive challenges?

The Maritime Force Engagement Control group is seeking dedicated problem solvers to help us tackle challenging technical problems while improving the defensive capability of our Navy's ships.We focus on the command and control of kinetic and nonkinetic weapon systems and effectors to enable an optimal, layered defensive web.

If you are adept at understanding challenging technical issues and creating innovative software solutions, graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or similar degrees, we'd like you to join our team. You will have the opportunity to support the full spectrum of engineering activities, ranging from concept and algorithm development through system evaluation and analysis, as well as tactics development.

We are seeking a wide range of talented individuals to help us:

  • Create sophisticated simulations of Naval capabilities and adversarial threat systems (e.g., missiles, swarms of autonomous platforms), paired with machine learning technologies, in order to develop robust solutions to transform systemic weaknesses into strengths.
  • Create data analytic and statistical tools to analyze complex systems and root cause performance issues.
  • Assist in the development, test, and analysis of innovative advancements to our command and control systems.
  • Implement and refine novel algorithms that increase the performance of shipboard defensive systems.
  • Perform early research into promising technologies that lead to improving our Navy's ability to maintain superior situational awareness in the fog of war, identify blatant and subtle hostile actions, and dynamically allocate limited resources in a changing battlefield.
  • Effectively communicate technical recommendations to APL leadership, government sponsors, and the engineering community.
  • Contribute to a our group to uphold core values through participation in collaborative teams and activities, as well as a dedication to continual improvement, innovation and risk-taking, and developing high quality products.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

* Have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering (e.g., Electrical, Systems, Mechanical, Aerospace), Math, Physics, or a related technical field.

* Have a technical experience as demonstrated in at least one internship, research experience, or other similar opportunity

* Have demonstrated proficiency with either C++ or Python

* Have experience creating object oriented software

* Have demonstrated strong interpersonal and communications skills

* Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain Top Secret level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

* Have experience in web development (HTML, JavaScript, CSS)

* Have experience in algorithm design and optimization, decision processes, or resource optimization and allocation schema

* Have experience with processing, organizing and assessing large data sets

* Have experience with modeling or analyzing a complex system (military system preferred)

* Have experience with signal processing specific to radars or communication systems

* Have domain knowledge of U.S. Navy systems

* Are able to obtain at least a Top Secret level security clearance.

We are committed to collaboration and finding innovative solutions that advance neurovascular intervention, establishing Route 92 Medical as one of the premier companies in the field.

This position will be onsite in our San Mateo, CA office support engineering by developing medical device prototypes, performing engineering validation builds, and transferring products to production.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This role will primarily function in a clean room environment for an estimated 75% of the time.
  • Work with fellow technicians to create working prototypes, and processes for new product or product revisions which are consistent with a zero-defect level target.
  • Contribute to manufacturing of devices for verification & validation builds, and human use builds per standard good manufacturing practices.
  • Establish manufacturing processes for new products, support training new operators (in house and at contract manufacturer as applicable)
  • Ability to learn and perform product testing as required for product development and maintain thorough and accurate test datasheets.
  • Flexibly move between assignments and take on new tasks to meet the needs of a fast-paced product development program
  • Ability to troubleshoot basic manufacturing issues with little to no oversight
  • Update supervisor of work status or problems with recommendations for improvement or correction.
  • Maintain accurate records of assignments and results including documentation concerning materials, parts used, concepts, designs, drawings and processes.
  • Provide feedback on product revisions or new products to project engineers and other company personnel as appropriate.
  • Train assemblers when transferring products.
  • Maintain a clean safe and well-organized work area.
  • Maintain close cooperation with Quality Assurance and Manufacturing in determining and completing assignments and providing feedback.
  • Support company goals and objectives, policies and procedures QSR and FDA regulations.


SKILLS FOR SUCCESS:

  • AA in a technical field preferred
  • Experience with product testing utilizing Instron is a plus
  • Ability to understand engineering assembly drawings is preferred


REQUIRED EDUCATION:

  • High School graduate equivalent required


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience in the Medical Device industry is required
  • Must have experience with standard catheter manufacturing processes (hot boxes, UV bonding equipment, laminators) in a certified clean room environment
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Word is required
  • Must be comfortable working in a clean room environment for an estimated 75% of the time

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits are effective day one! R92M offers generous benefit options, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, FSA, HSA, Short-term and Long-term disability, Critical Illness Insurance, and Accident Insurance.
  • Competitive base pay plus corporate bonus program
  • Generous paid time off and 16 paid holidays, including a company-wide summer recharge week in July
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave for employees after 90 days of employment
  • Monthly cell phone stipend


The actual base pay is dependent on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, market data, skills, geographic location, and business needs. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for equity.

Role Summary

The Regional Manager owns transportation service delivery for an assigned region or contract. The role is accountable for the operational performance, staffing, compliance, and financial results of that region, and is the senior company representative to the contracting agency locally. title: Sr. Corporate Real Estate Administrator
description:
ThompsonGas is the nation’s fastest growing propane retailer, and we are looking for innovative, outside of the box thinkers who want to make an impact. We are rethinking the way we do business and, as a result, our employees are empowered to take an idea and run with it. If you are looking for an environment that will allow you the freedom to drive change, create an unrivaled customer experience and have fun while you’re doing it – then ThompsonGas is for you!


The Lease & Real Estate Specialist is a high-autonomy, execution-focused role responsible for managing lease lifecycle activities across a large multi-site portfolio. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to independently manage deadlines and deliverables, and the judgment to evaluate lease scenarios and present practical options and recommendations to internal stakeholders.


This individual will serve as a key operator within the Real Estate function, ensuring lease obligations are met, issues are resolved efficiently, and opportunities or risks are proactively identified. The role is expected to think critically, solve problems independently, and support decision-making through structured analysis — without owning portfolio strategy or enterprise-level real estate direction.


Essential Job Duties:

  • Create, maintain, update and organize all property related information for company properties, whether owned or leased
  • Support real estate project execution related to lease transactions, including renewals, relocations, expansions, consolidations, and closures, ensuring timely coordination of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Finance, Legal, vendors, and landlords to support execution of real estate projects and resolve issues that may impact timelines or deliverables.
  • Manage end-to-end lease lifecycle activities including renewals, amendments, terminations, and option exercises across a multi-site portfolio.
  • Maintain, update, and ensure accuracy of all lease and property records within the lease management system and related databases.
  • Perform lease abstraction, review, and document management to ensure accurate understanding of lease terms, obligations, and critical requirements.
  • Monitor and proactively manage key lease milestones including expirations, rent escalations, notice requirements, and renewal deadlines.
  • Analyze lease scenarios (e.g., renewal vs. relocation options) and provide clear, structured recommendations and considerations to internal stakeholders.
  • Identify risks, inconsistencies, and cost implications within lease terms and escalate issues with practical solution options.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for landlords, property managers, and external partners to resolve day-to-day operational lease matters.
  • Support lease negotiations by preparing analysis, reviewing terms, and participating in discussions alongside Legal and the Director of Real Estate.
  • Support acquisition and post-close onboarding activities on a limited basis, primarily focused on documentation, system setup, and administrative integration tasks.
  • Maintain compliance tracking related to property taxes, insurance, CSAT requirements, Tier II reporting, and other regulatory obligations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Operations, Finance, Legal, and field leadership to support real estate needs and resolve issues.
  • Independently troubleshoot lease and property-related issues, offering practical solutions and escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure accurate and timely execution of lease-related processes across multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Work closely with the Lease Administrator to maintain data integrity, system accuracy, and consistent portfolio records.
  • Support the Director of Real Estate by executing assigned initiatives and providing analysis to support decision-making.


Education and Experience:

  • Minium 5+ years of experience in lease administration, real estate operations, property management, or commercial real estate transactions (or equivalent hands-on experience in a related field). Experience may be considered in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
  • Strong working knowledge of lease administration, lease interpretation, and real estate transaction processes, including renewals, amendments, and terminations.
  • Demonstrated ability to negotiate or support negotiation of lease terms and effectively communicate with landlords and external stakeholders.
  • Experience working with lease management systems, property management platforms, or similar databases (preferred but not required).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to review lease documents, identify issues, and support decision-making with clear, structured information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with internal stakeholders, landlords, and vendors.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently.
  • Proven ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive business and lease information appropriately.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to think independently, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Customer-service mindset with the ability to address tenant, landlord, and internal stakeholder needs in a responsive and professional manner.
  • Collaborative team player who can work independently while supporting broader real estate and operations objectives.

PERKS WITH US!

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and 401k with IMMEDIATE eligibility
  • Disability and life insurance
  • Paid time off that increases with tenure
  • Daily Pay Option that offers great flexibility and financial control
  • Employee training programs with career development/advancement opportunities
  • Employee recognition program
  • Quarterly bonus potential
  • Paid maternity and parental leave benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement program


ThompsonGas provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, ThompsonGas complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Credit Officer
description:

  • Evaluate and approve credit applications, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of credit risk assessment and management principles.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in using financial software and tools for credit analysis.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Familiarity with industry-specific regulations and compliance standards.
  • Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices.
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to work.

title: Performance Improvement & Accreditation Coordinator
description:
Join Our Mission to Transform Lives!

At Rosecrance, we’ve been leading the way in behavioral health services for over a century. Our team empowers individuals and families to overcome substance use and mental health challenges through compassionate care and evidence-based therapies. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact, we’re ready to welcome you! We are looking for dedicated individuals to join our team and help deliver on our mission of hope and recovery.

Position Summary

In this role, you will establish and maintain a comprehensive Quality Improvement/Performance Management system and data aggregation framework across all Rosecrance program and affiliates. In addition, this position implements regular performance improvement activities and ensures adherence to agency policies, state and federal regulations, and accreditation standards.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in behavioral health or business-related field required
• Demonstrated experience working with customers or clients, preferably in a healthcare setting
• Must possess NiaTx, Lean Six Sigma or other change management certification
• Must be proficient with computers and database management
• Demonstrated ability in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly adept in Excel and Word
• Proficiency in training, adult learning, or education methodologies
• Proven track record in Performance Improvement initiatives or programs
• Must have a working knowledge of The Joint Commission, DASA/SUPR, DMH, DHS and/or other regulatory standards
• Training and proficiency in statistical information gathering and root cause analysis
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills coupled with strong critical thinking abilities

Responsibilities

1. Work hours prescribed by the Performance Improvement Director and any additional hours deemed necessary for the responsibilities assigned
2. Assist staff with accessing client portal data, including technical support, and troubleshooting any problems.
3. Assist staff with electronic health record (EHR) data entry questions, provide constructive feedback and training with staff regarding PI initiatives and to ensure accurate data collection and aggregation.
4. Administer paper based and/or electronic outcome and survey tools with individual and groups of clients as needed.
5. Perform data calculations and routine analytical functions relative to performance improvement activities.
6. Identify, evaluate, and correct errors caused by inappropriate decision making, human behavior, leadership practices or organizational weaknesses that impact safety and/or operational performance.
7. Incorporate identified organizational weaknesses into training methods and procedures to cultivate a culture of continuous improvement.
8. Train and mentor personnel at various levels across the organization in the handling of client data.
9. Collect and analyze company wide client outcomes and staff performance data to provide conclusions and recommendations to senior management to support improved processes.
10. Assist organization in meeting requirements for Joint Commission and state licensing surveys, including completing mock surveys, tracers, staff training, and other Joint Commission readiness activities.
11. Maintain up to date knowledge on regulations affecting the organization and serve as a resource to staff.

12. Assist leadership in reviewing and revising the Policy and Procedure Manual, safety policies, risk management policies and infection control guidelines.
13. Perform audits as requested by leadership.
14. Assist in quality assurance and focus medical reviews under the guidance of leadership.
15. Assist Director of Performance Improvement on any specific PI/Quality related tasks, research, and help to develop educational material for identified service needs.
16. Travel to various Rosecrance facilities to aid in Performance Improvement onsite activities as necessary and as assigned by leadership.
17. Assume other related responsibilities as assigned by leadership.

  • 401(k) with employer match & discretionary contribution
  • Group Life Insurance, LTD and AD&D

  • Paid Time Off, sick time, bereavement leave

Rosecrance has been at the forefront of providing behavioral health services for over a century. Our mission is to empower individuals and families to overcome substance abuse and mental health challenges through evidence-based therapies and compassionate care. Join us in our mission to foster lasting recovery and transform lives.

We are committed to providing careers that make a difference in the lives of the people we serve and the people we employ. We do this through the work we do, our core mission and values, our employee resources, and especially through our purpose-driven community of opportunity and hope.

title: Omaha - Door Knocker - PTP - Nebraska
description:
ABOUT US:

Merrimack Services is a people-first company that leads door-to-door voter mobilization programs across the country, and is working with Progressive Turnout Project, the largest voter contact organization in the country, specifically dedicated to mobilizing the Democratic Party and defending democracy.

OUR MISSION: Rally Nebraska Democrats to vote!

OPPORTUNITY:

Do you want to make a difference in your community? We are seeking enthusiastic Door Knockers to help get out the vote for Democrats in the upcoming midterm elections! Door knockers will have conversations with voters at their homes and talk to them about the importance of making their voices heard.

As independent contractors, door knockers may complete every part of the program on their own schedule, and have the flexibility to knock on doors and talk to voters when and where they choose–no schedule or time commitment is required. This is a great opportunity for individuals with other personal or professional commitments who are seeking a flexible option!

Door Knockers will be paid $150 for each completed door knocking packet, which can be done in a location convenient for you and on your own schedule. It takes the typical Door Knocker about three-four hours to complete each packet, which can be done all at once or over multiple days–it’s up to you! If you successfully complete your first door knocking packet, you’ll be offered additional opportunities.

Door Knocking will begin August 18th and continue through Nov. 3rd. Door Knockers will be able to set their own schedules and working hours.

TASKS:

  • Complete an online briefing that will provide an overview of your contract responsibilities.

  • Travel door-to-door in your community or in a surrounding region and knock doors to speak with voters.

  • Talk to voters about the upcoming election on November 3rd.

  • Door Knocking can be done all at once or over multiple periods of time.

  • Enter data from all conversations with voters into an app on your phone.

HOURS AND PAYMENT:

All Door Knockers will be *independent contractors* and paid $150 per completed door knocking packet. Door Knockers may choose their own door knocking hours, but must complete their full task to be eligible for compensation. Compensation will be provided by direct deposit, or by mailed check if requested.

title: Division Leader, Supply Chain Management
description:
What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose

The Supply Chain Division Leader is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for all supply chain, procurement, sourcing, logistics, inventory management, and supplier development activities. This role drives supply chain performance through cost optimization, risk mitigation, supplier management, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring alignment with company objectives. The Supply Chain Leader manages cross-functional teams and collaborates with engineering, manufacturing, quality, finance, and executive leadership to support business growth and operational excellence. This leadership responsibility is for the full supply chain lifecycle, from strategic sourcing and supplier development through procurement operations and organizational leadership.

Key Accountabilities

Strategic Supply Chain Management — 20%

  • Develop short- and long-term strategies, including a ten-year roadmap and buying strategies for both platforms.
  • Lead supply chain readiness and translate strategy into priorities, KPIs, and corrective actions.

Procurement and Strategic Sourcing — 20%

  • Lead direct and indirect procurement, supplier selection, qualification, sourcing, and contract management.
  • Direct RFI/RFP/RFQ activity and lead commercial negotiations and contract review.

Supplier Performance Management — 20%

  • Monitor supplier quality, cost, delivery, responsiveness, and risk.
  • Lead supplier reviews, corrective actions, development, and timely resolution of defects and part failures.

Cross-Functional Leadership — 20%

  • Lead and develop the supply chain team through coaching, ownership, and empowerment.
  • Build trusted relationships and lead collaboration across functions, suppliers, and senior leadership.

Operational Excellence — 20%

    • Oversee warehousing, logistics, inventory, supplier communications, and ERP planning.
    • Drive part availability, inventory, delivery, supplier quality, MBOM cost, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills

Minimum Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.

Minimum Experience

  • 15 years of progressive supply chain, procurement, sourcing, or operations experience.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing supply chain teams and strategic supplier relationships.
  • Demonstrated success in strategic sourcing, contract negotiations, supplier management, and cost reduction initiatives. Contract review and strategic roadmap experience preferred.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, defense, or other complex industrial environments preferred. Aerospace experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience across multiple supply chain disciplines.

Other Job-Specific Skills

  • Broad knowledge of supply chain management, procurement, logistics, inventory control, and supplier quality systems. Supplier development and ERP planning knowledge preferred.
  • Advanced negotiation, analytical, problem-solving, and cost-modeling skills. Ability to evaluate commercial terms, contract language, MBOM cost, inventory, working capital, and cost of goods sold.
  • Ability to lead organizational change, complex cross-functional initiatives, sourcing strategies, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across all organizational levels. Confident executive and supplier communication with a collaborative, empowering leadership style.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, Microsoft Office, dashboards, and performance reviews. Ability to learn systems quickly and work hands-on.
  • Knowledge of procurement policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, Lean, and Six Sigma.

Job Dimensions

  • No. of Direct Reports: 4–5
  • No. of Indirect Reports: 90–100
  • Financial Dimensions: Knowledge of in-depth organizational finance with cost of goods sold (COGS) accountability.

Decisions Expected

  • Develop and execute supply chain strategies that support short-term and long-term business objectives.
  • Lead supplier selection, qualification, and contract management processes.
  • Oversee procurement operations, inventory management processes, logistics activities, and supplier communications.
  • Direct Request for Information (RFI), Request for Proposal (RFP), and Request for Quotation (RFQ) activities.
  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risks through proactive planning and supplier diversification.

Working Conditions

  • Office floor environment. 100% onsite at Honda Aircraft Company in Greensboro, North Carolina.
  • Frequent interaction with cross-functional teams. Includes suppliers and executive leadership.
  • Occasional extended hours to support project deadlines and executive deliverables.
  • Travel up to 35%; Honda white coat required and provided.

What differentiates Honda and makes us an employer of choice?

  • Regional Bonus (when applicable)

title: Manager – Graphics Design
description:
WSP is seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Manager – Graphics Design to support our Strategic Growth Team, US. This role will lead the delivery of high-quality visual communications, with particular emphasis on cohesive, long-form proposal documents that organize complex content, strengthen strategic messaging, and remain practical for multidisciplinary teams to develop collaboratively. The Manager will establish scalable document design systems that support contributors with varying levels of InDesign experience, while also overseeing proposal graphics, presentations, infographics, digital assets, and other brand-compliant marketing materials. The position offers regular collaboration with graphic designers and business partners in the US, exposure to international projects, and opportunities to participate in training and explore new technologies and more effective ways of working. The Manager will lead and develop a team of graphic designers, strengthen design standards and delivery processes, and work closely with proposal leads, marketing leaders, graphic design leadership, and business stakeholders across regions. This is a people management and team-building role focused on developing talent, strengthening capability, and creating a collaborative environment where designers are encouraged to test new ideas while working effectively within WSP’s established visual brand standards. The Manager will also help proposal coordinators strengthen their understanding and use of graphic design principles. This role will be based in the Noida office.

Creative & Business Support
 Lead the development of cohesive, long-form proposals and related business development documents, using page architecture, hierarchy, typography, imagery, graphics, and data visualization to strengthen strategic messaging and guide the reader through complex information.
 Develop scalable, well-constructed InDesign documents and template systems that support efficient collaboration among proposal coordinators, writers, technical contributors, and designers with varying levels of InDesign experience.
 Ensure all design outputs are high quality, visually consistent, aligned with business objectives, and compliant with WSP’s visual brand standards, while encouraging fresh and effective ways to communicate within those standards.
 Provide creative direction and graphics support for strategic pursuits, high-visibility initiatives, and business development priorities, helping the team transform complex technical and business information into clear, compelling visual stories.

 Promote the use of effective design tools, workflows, templates, and best practices to improve quality and efficiency. Evaluate and help pilot new technologies and approaches that can strengthen creative quality, collaboration, and delivery.
Team & People Leadership
 Manage, mentor, and develop a team of graphic designers, providing clear direction, regular feedback, coaching, and practical opportunities to build skills through project work and training.
 Lead performance reviews, career development discussions, workload planning, and capability-building initiatives, with mentorship support from local and US graphic design leaders.
 Build a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team culture that supports quality delivery, continuous improvement, and thoughtful creative experimentation within established brand parameters.
 Support hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, and succession planning.

Operations & Stakeholder Management
 Manage resource allocation, workload balancing, priorities, and timelines to ensure
effective delivery across requests.
 Establish quality standards, review processes, performance metrics, and service
delivery expectations.
 Partner with proposal, marketing, graphic design, and business leaders to
understand requirements, build strong working relationships, and deliver effective visual solutions.
 Drive continuous improvement in delivery efficiency, stakeholder satisfaction, crossregion collaboration, and the responsible use of new tools and technologies.

Key Competencies / Skills / Qualifications
Education and Experience
 Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Fine Arts, Multimedia Design, or a related discipline.
 12+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably in a business development, proposal, marketing, or professional services environment.
 Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience leading creative, design, or graphics teams.
 Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry is highly desirable.

Technical and Design Skills
 Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in cohesive, long-form document design, including the ability to organize complex content, establish clear visual hierarchy, maintain consistency across multiple sections, and use design to reinforce strategic messaging. The portfolio should also demonstrate typography, information design, infographics, presentations, and creative variety within established brand systems.
 Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and related design tools.
 Advanced proficiency in designing and constructing long-form documents in Adobe InDesign, including page architecture, style systems, parent pages, tables, anchored objects, libraries, linked assets, and reusable components that support consistent and efficient document production.
 Demonstrated understanding of collaborative document workflows, including how to create files that are intuitive, resilient, and maintainable for users with varying levels of InDesign experience.
 Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
 Ability to develop professional design assets such as brochures, white papers, social media graphics, advertisements, infographics, charts, presentations, videos, branded templates.
 Comfortable working with common file formats including JPEG, EPS, TIFF, PNG, PDF, MOV, and MP4.

Leadership and Collaboration
 Strong communication, stakeholder management, and briefing skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear visual solutions.
 Experience working with design briefs, content managers, proposal teams, graphic designers and cross-functional stakeholders across locations and cultures.
 Ability to review and proof design outputs for accuracy, consistency, brand compliance, and print readiness.
 Strong planning, prioritization, and team management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, balance creative quality with brand compliance, and support a collaborative international delivery environment.

BGV:

 Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Senior Program Manager, Enterprise Integration
description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

In this role, you lead day‑to‑day execution of acquisition and site‑integration programs, translating approved integration objectives into executable plans and driving coordinated delivery across functional workstreams. You support diligence, readiness, stabilization, and operational handovers, ensuring predictable performance, effective issue resolution, and alignment with established integration and program‑management standards.

Responsibilities

  • Develops integrated plans defining objectives, workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, resource needs, readiness criteria, and operational handover.
  • Coordinates delivery across Finance, Human Resources (HR), Legal, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Business Systems, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, site leadership, vendors, and advisors.
  • Leads workstream and milestone reviews, clarifies commitments, and drives functional owners to complete required actions and deliverables.
  • Manages program risks, issues, and dependencies and resolves routine sequencing and coordination challenges while supporting recovery planning.
  • Supports acquisition diligence and pre‑close readiness by coordinating assigned assessments and converting findings into integration actions.
  • Leads readiness planning and reviews for Day 1, Day 30/60/90/100, stabilization, and cutover milestones and secures required sign‑offs.
  • Coordinates business process, enterprise resource planning (ERP), infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity, data, vendor, communications, and training dependencies.
  • Monitors integration costs, commitments, forecasts, and benefit measures with Finance and functional owners and recommends corrective actions.
  • Prepares program updates highlighting milestone performance, business impact, risks, options, required decisions, and upcoming actions.
  • Maintains scope and decision records, assesses impacts of proposed changes, and routes significant trade‑offs or unresolved conflicts through authorized approvers.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, engineering, operations, finance, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Four or more years of experience in project or program management, integration, enterprise transformation, business systems, operations, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading a cross‑functional project or program through completion, coordinating multiple functions, sites, or vendors and owning delivery results.
  • Experience developing integrated plans and managing milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, readiness activities, changes, and management reporting.
  • Ability to lead through influence, resolve routine delivery issues, hold owners accountable, and escalate material risks with clear business impact and recommended options.
  • Knowledge of program budgets, cost forecasts, resource planning, and benefit tracking and the ability to partner effectively with Finance and functional owners.
  • Strong analytical, communication, facilitation, and organizational skills; proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and project‑management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mergers and acquisitions (M\&A) integration, site integration, ERP deployment, entity restructuring, or comparable business transformation.
  • Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, engineering, or another regulated, multi‑site environment.
  • Exposure to integration readiness, process alignment, systems or data transitions, organizational change, or post‑implementation stabilization.
  • Familiarity with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800‑171, Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Sarbanes‑Oxley (SOX) IT General Controls (ITGC), export controls, or other compliance requirements.
  • PMP, CAPM, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, or related training or certification; experience with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Jira, or comparable platforms.

Special Mentions

  • Periodic travel may be required for integration planning, site coordination, and readiness activities.

Benefits

  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Company‑paid life and AD\&D insurance
  • Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
  • Tuition reimbursement

title: Groundsperson - Tree Care
description:
What We Offer

• Compensation: Competitive pay based on experience, with opportunities for growth as you expand your skills and certifications.
• Benefits: Health, dental, vision, 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match.
• Time Off: Paid time off and paid holidays to support your work/life balance.
• Training & Development: Hands-on training in all aspects of tree care, including pruning, removals, cable bracing, and equipment operation, with continuing education opportunities.
• Team & Collaborative Environment: Work alongside highly skilled tree care professionals in a safety-first culture.
• Tools for Success: Access to modern equipment, tools, and resources that help you deliver top-quality service and grow your expertise.

Position Summary

Looking for a place where you can thrive? SavATree’s mission is to take our passion for nature and keep this country’s outdoors beautiful and flourishing. Through our comprehensive tree, shrub, and lawn care, we work hard to make sure our customers have attractive, healthy, and cared-for green spaces to enjoy. Over the last thirty years, we have opened new offices across the country, and we are looking for people who want to grow with us.

The General Tree Care team are the muscle of our operation. These industrial athletes work together to provide high-quality tree care, helping to maintain and preserve the overall health of our clients’ landscapes.

What a Day is Like

As a General Tree Care Groundsperson, you will be part of a crew that delivers high-quality tree care to our clients. You will be involved in all aspects of pruning, removals, cable bracing, and other tree care services. You will operate equipment safely, perform assigned job tasks efficiently, and provide exceptional service to clients. You will have the opportunity to work outdoors on beautiful properties while collaborating with a team of focused, talented professionals.

What Kind of Person We’re Looking For

• Demonstrated knowledge of proper use of General Tree Care equipment
• Previous landscaping experience with safe lifting techniques and proper procedures for carrying and stacking brush on client properties
• Basic knowledge of common tree identification (a plus)
• Knowledge of two to three basic knots plus Weaver Knot, Clove Hitch Knot, and Gilhooligan Knot
• Experience with proper pruning equipment such as hand snips, pruners, pole saws, etc.

What is Essential

• Willingness to complete required trainings to obtain needed certifications and licenses
• Desire to work outdoors
• Valid driver’s license to operate service-line vehicles (CDL a plus)
• Must be authorized to work lawfully in the U.S.

Physical Demands

These physical demands must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to lift and/or move up to fifty (50) pounds.

About SavATree

We want everyone to be able to identify and achieve their own version of success, which means giving each team member the room and opportunity to grow. To ensure that everyone has the best chance to succeed, we invest heavily in training and continuing education. We make it easy for team members to reach out and get the help they need, even when it’s from the other side of the country. We pride ourselves on creating an environment where each team member has the resources and opportunities to advance their career and become a go-to subject matter expert. That’s why we often say: When you work here, you thrive here.

Equal Opportunity

SavATree is an equal opportunity employer and a drug-free workplace.

title: Full-Stack Developer - 6 Month FTC
description:
Movera are looking for a skilled and adaptable Full Stack Developer in our Microsoft- and Azure-centric environment to join our Technology Team on a 6 Month Fixed Term Contract.

This is a hands-on development role focused on modernising and integrating legacy systems with cloud-first, full-stack solutions. You will be responsible for delivering secure, high-performance applications and services, and supporting the full software development lifecycle—from analysis and design through implementation, testing, and deployment.

We expect a mix of technical expertise and architecture-level thinking.

Important Requirement: This is a UK-based remote role. To be considered, you must physically reside in the United Kingdom and hold full, independent right to work in the UK. We are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship or consider candidates based outside the UK.

Who Are We:

Movera is a flourishing platform business that brings together ambitious home moving brands from across the sector. Built on the heritage and passion of experienced legal services businesses including ONP Solicitors and Cavendish Legal Group, brought together to transform the moving market for the better. Our vision is to create moving and remortgaging experiences to be celebrated – not tolerated.

Core Technical Expectations

Backend Development (C# / .NET)

  • Mastery of ASP.NET Core, including minimal APIs and middleware pipelines.
  • Proficient in designing and implementing RESTful APIs (using controllers or minimal APIs).
  • Comfortable with asynchronous programming, cancellation tokens, background services, and parallelism.
  • Experience with Dependency Injection, middleware, and custom service abstractions.
  • Skilled at structuring solutions using Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or at least modular, testable components.
  • Strong debugging and profiling skills.

Azure Cloud Proficiency

  • Solid experience deploying and managing:
    • Azure Function Apps (timer, HTTP, queue/storage/event triggers).
    • App Services and Web Apps.
    • API Management
    • Azure Front Door/CDN (optional but helpful).
  • Familiar with Storage Accounts, Blob/Table/Queue Storage, Key Vault, App Configuration.
  • Familiar with Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs (for scalable event-driven designs).
  • Can interpret and design architectures in Azure Architecture Center diagrams.
  • Recommend appropriate Azure services based on the problem (e.g., Durable Functions for orchestrations, Logic Apps vs Functions, etc.).

DevOps & CI/CD (Azure DevOps)

  • Writes and maintains multi-stage YAML pipelines (build, test, deploy).
  • Integrates tests (unit, integration, smoke) into CI/CD.
  • Understands ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform for IaC (preferred but optional).
  • Ensures deployment slots, release approvals, and feature flags are well utilized.

Frontend

  • Strong with modern SPA frameworks like React, Angular, or Blazor.
  • Comfortable integrating with APIs, handling authentication, and state management.
  • Uses component-based architecture, lazy loading, and follows accessibility/responsiveness best practices.

Database (SQL Server/Azure SQL)

  • Skilled in:
    • Writing optimized T-SQL, views, indexes, and stored procedures.
    • Designing normalized and/or denormalized schemas depending on use case.
    • Managing migrations using EF Core (preferably fluent in IEntityTypeConfiguration).
    • Interpreting query execution plans for performance tuning.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in modernising or migrating legacy systems.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate or similar.

What We Offer

We aim to reward your hard work generously. You’ll be greeted in our offices with great coffee, fruit and biscuits to keep you going, alongside all the benefits listed below, plus much more.

  • 27 days holiday + your birthday off!
  • Health Cash Plan
  • Buy/Sell 5 days annual leave per annum
  • Build up more annual leave after 1 years service
  • Hybrid working
  • Free conveyancing legal fees
  • Moving home days off
  • Volunteering days
  • Retailer discounts and frequent socials
  • Refer a friend bonuses

Look forward to Monday mornings at Movera, we have the culture, technology and purpose to change the way you feel about your job and strive to create a positive and supportive work environment.

At Movera, we celebrate diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered. We believe that a diverse workforce brings unique perspectives and ideas that drive innovation and excellence. We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented groups. If you need any support during the application process, please let us know.

DBS and Financial Checks: We are committed to creating a safe, secure, and trustworthy workplace for everyone. As part of this commitment, all employment offers are subject to successful completion of DBS (Disclosure and Barring Service) checks and financial background checks. These checks help us maintain the highest standards of integrity and compliance while ensuring the well‑being of our employees and clients. Rest assured, all checks will be carried out with care and in full accordance with relevant data protection laws.

title: Program Engineer (Voice Core)
description:
GCI's Program Engineer is responsible for overseeing and coordinating engineering projects from conception to completion. Manage technical aspects of programs, ensuring alignment with business goals, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality results on time and within budget. Serve as a technical leader and consultant in areas of expertise.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES AT ALL LEVELS:

Program Planning and Strategy

  • Provide technical leadership, ensuring alignment and oversight for assigned programs, driving innovative and high-quality solutions which are in line with strategic goals and long-range technical plans.
  • Develop and manage program plans, including scope, schedule, budget, and resource allocations, ensuring financial & service quality monitoring controls are in place.
  • Define technical program objectives and success criteria in alignment with organizational goals and long-range plans, company culture and mission.
  • Specify architectural standards, implementation requirements, ongoing support needs, and lifecycle management planning framework.
  • Identify and mitigate program risks and issues.
  • Optimize resource utilization to achieve program goals within budget constraints.
  • Monitor and report on program technical execution & quality performance.
  • Follow IEEE/Industry regulations, codes & standards, working at industry leading levels and following engineering discipline practices.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, legal regulations, and auditing.

Project Planning & Execution Support

  • Support multiple technology projects from initiation to completion to operations hand-off as a support and escalation resource.
  • Lead project engineers through major, multifaceted projects that span multiple departments and disciplines.
  • Monitor project activities and provide strategic technical guidance and alignment within a specific program, as well as across the enterprise.
  • Develop and validate engineering estimates, project plans, and execution strategies.
  • Coordinate with project managers to ensure project milestones and deliverables are met.
  • Monitor project performance, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality standards.
  • Provide post-implementation operational support for projects, ensuring efforts align with business line services and strategic objectives.
  • Lead and mentor project teams, providing guidance and support as needed.
  • Foster a collaborative environment to enhance team performance and productivity.
  • Manage resource allocation, establish architectural standards, and ensure teams have the necessary tools and support.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with technical strategy, program management, project engineering, and project management teams, providing guidance and alignment across complex company initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Facilitate meetings and workshops to drive program objectives and decision-making.
  • Prepare and present regular program status reports and key issue updates to senior management and stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence within the engineering team.
  • Adhere to best practices and design standards when coordinating with other programs and projects to identify and implement efficiencies that extend beyond the scope of a single program.
  • Evaluate program performance and implement process improvements.
  • Identify and address dependencies and risks that may impact program success.
  • Promote best practices and lessons learned across projects and teams.
  • Drive innovation and efficiency in technology solutions and project execution across multiple teams, departments, and companywide.
  • Ensure team takes full advantage of advances in technologies used by the company and across the industry to improve and add new services for our customers.

Focus Areas –

Voice Core

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Provide technical leadership for the architecture, design, deployment, and optimization of Class 4/Class 5 switching platforms, including Metaswitch, softswitches, SBCs, and MGWs.
  • Provides advanced expertise in SIP, SS7/SIGTRAN, MGCP, ISDN PRI, TDM, and IMS architectures to support scalable, resilient, and interoperable voice networks.
  • Design and oversee end-to-end core network architectures for large-scale deployments, ensuring alignment with technical, regulatory, and organizational requirements.
  • Serve as the engineering liaison across Strategic Management Office (SMO), Front-end Estimating Engineering (FEET), Sales Engineering (SE), and other stakeholders to drive design approvals, project estimates, technical strategy, and alignment with broader business objectives.
  • Lead engineering reviews, including After Action Reviews (AARs), to assess project network impacts, drive continuous improvement, incorporate lessons learned, and inform future designs and engineering practices.
  • Strong knowledge of engineering standards, reference designs, testing, and documentation.

Protocols & Standards:

SIP/SIP-I/SIP-T SIGTRAN: M2UA,M3UA RTP/RTCP SDP
H.248/Megaco MGCP ISDN PRI
TDM

Hardware & Software:

Metaswitch Ribbon STP SCP
Media Gateways Softswitch SBC PIC
Netscout Metasolv

Preferred Certifications:

Metaswitch CCNA VoIP SS7/SIGTRAN
SSCA

COMPETENCIES:

  • ACCOUNTABILITY- Takes ownership for actions, decisions, and results; openly accepts feedback and demonstrates a willingness to improve.
    • Ability to remain current within the industry standards and best practices.
  • BASIC PRINCIPLES - Interacts with people in a way that builds mutual trust, confidence, and respect; adheres to GCI’s Code of Conduct for Employees – the Basic Principles.
  • COLLABORATION - Works effectively with others to accomplish common goals and objectives; maintains positive relationships even under difficult circumstances.
    • Ability to influence without authority and guide a team towards common goals by demonstrating strong leadership skills, building trust, and maximizing relationships across the company.
    • Ability to professionally mediate conflicts and foster technical alignment.
  • COMMUNICATION- Conveys thoughts and expresses ideas appropriately and professionally.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to patiently and accurately articulate information to internal and external audiences, professionally handle inquiries and complaints, and communicate effectively with the team.
    • Ability to convey technical information in presentation/training format to a range of technical and non-technical audiences at all levels of the company.
  • COMPLIANCE - Follows internal controls; protects confidential information; abides by GCI’s Code of Business Conduct & Ethics.
  • CUSTOMER FOCUS - Demonstrates commitment to service excellence; gives high priority to customer satisfaction.
  • RELIABILITY - Consistently follows through on assigned tasks as expected; demonstrates timely attendance at meetings, training, and other work obligations.
  • RESULTS - Uses a combination of job knowledge, initiative, sound decision making, innovation, adaptability, and problem solving.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to reconcile divergent demands and prioritize individual workload.
    • Strong critical thinking and decision-making skills with the ability to use sound, logical judgment based on data, research, analysis, and experience to choose an appropriate course of action.
    • Strong strategic planning and implementation skills with the ability to set measurable and achievable goals and objectives for the team.
    • Adept at developing, documenting and executing technical plans and activities that have a broad organizational impact.
    • Demonstrated ability to define, deliver, and support strategic plans for aligning organizational technical strategies and long-range planning.
    • Ability to prioritize and successfully execute multiple projects, under time constraints, in an environment with changing priorities, goals, and competing deadlines.
    • Demonstrated ability to professionally mediate conflicts, recommend and implement solutions, and foster technical alignment.
  • SAFETY & SECURITY - Supports a safe work environment by following all workplace safety rules and guidelines; complies with applicable Security policies and procedures.
  • TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY - Proficient computer skills and MS Office knowledge (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio) to complete job duties effectively.
    • Excellent professional and technical knowledge of the telecommunications industry.

Additional Job Requirements:

This is an intermediate level position within the discipline demonstrating broad knowledge and proficiency in areas of responsibility. Performs moderately complex tasks and job duties, receiving minimal instruction on routine work and general instruction on new assignments. Works under moderate supervision with latitude for independent judgment. Supports higher level staff in implementing more complex projects.

Minimum Qualifications:

Required: *A combination of relevant work experience and/or education sufficient to perform the duties of the job may substitute to meet the total years required on a year-for-year basis

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Project Management, Business, IT/IS, or related discipline. *
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of progressive professional engineering experience. *

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Engineering.
  • Broad experience in the telecommunications industry within any of the following fields: Broadband Internet, ISP Infrastructure, Urban & Rural Fiber Optic Networks, Mobile & Fixed Wireless, Microwave & Satellite Communications, Capacity Planning, Lifecycle Management, Information Technology & Security.
  • Other relevant telecom industry or job specific certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP), Agile or Scrum certifications.

DRIVING REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position may require access to reliable transportation for occasional travel between retail store locations, offices, worksites, or other locations as needed.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS and WORKING CONDITIONS:
  • GCI headquarters are based in Anchorage with project work occurring throughout the state of Alaska as well as locations in Oregon and Washington state.
  • Must be willing to travel up to 25% of the time to include rural locations off the road system.
  • Work is primarily sedentary, requiring daily routine computer usage.
  • Ability to work shifts as assigned, work in standard office/home office setting, and operate standard office equipment.
  • Ability to accurately communicate information and ideas to others effectively.
  • Physical agility and effort sufficient to perform job duties safely and effectively.
  • Ability to make valid judgments and decisions.
  • Available to work additional time on weekends, holidays, before or after normal work hours when necessary.
  • Must work well in a team environment and be able to work with a diverse group of people and customers.
  • Virtual workers must comply with remote work policies and agreements.
The company and its subsidiaries operate in a 24/7 environment providing critical services to Alaskans and may need to respond to public health and safety matters or other business emergencies. Due to business needs employees may be contacted outside of the core business hours to respond to the immediate emergency. As such, you will be requested to provide emergency after hours contact numbers, to include your home and cell phone numbers if you have those services.
Culture, Engagement, and Connection: At GCI, we foster an environment where the unique perspectives of our employees, customers, and fellow Alaskans are celebrated. title: Return To Work - Financial Services Representative (SIE) | Alpharetta, GA
location: Alpharetta, Georgia, United States of America
description:
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, continuously evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

Return to Work Program – Alpharetta

At Morgan Stanley, we recognize the immense potential in experienced professionals who have taken a career break and are now eager to return to the workforce. We value the life skills and experiences you've gained outside of work and recognize the significant contributions you can bring to our organization.

You don’t have to have a background in financial services to have a career with us. We welcome highly motivated candidates from a diverse range of industries and skills. We strive to create a spirit of inclusion by bringing together dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds, talents, perspectives, cultural identities, and experiences.

Our Alpharetta Return to Work program will run from January 18, 2027 through May 7, 2027 in our Alpharetta office. This 16-week paid program places participants in roles that align with their existing expertise while also broadening their horizons through comprehensive training, mentorship, and professional development.

Financial Service Representative (SIE) — Return to Work Candidates

In the Wealth Management division, we help people, businesses and institutions build, preserve, and manage wealth so they can pursue their financial goals.

Are you interested in financial services? Have you always wanted to learn the inner workings of the stock market? Do you get excited about solving problems and having customers compliment your work? Are you goal-driven and competitive? If you answered yes to these questions, you’re the person we want on our Financial Services team!

As an unlicensed Financial Services Representative, you would use your amazing customer service skills and knack for problem-solving to engage our clients via incoming calls and answer various questions related to their stock portfolios.

To get you started in your career with us, Morgan Stanley will pay for your training to obtain your Series 7 & 63 Licenses.

In This Role You Will:

  • Educate customers on Morgan Stanley ’s competitive advantage and identify additional products they would benefit from.

  • Show us your determination to drive sales by engaging customers and identifying new opportunities.

  • Follow processes and manage your time efficiently throughout the day.

  • Participating in continuing education and development.

  • Savings programs

  • Insurance plans

  • Tuition and licensing reimbursement along with student loan refinancing

  • Fitness subsidy

  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

  • Employees are encouraged to give back to your community

What You Bring to the Table:

  • You've successfully passed the Securities Industry Essentials®(SIE®) Exam

  • A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Management or Administration, or have an equivalent combination of education, training and experience (1 year of work experience can substitute 1 year of education)

  • You’ve spent at least 2 years working in a customer-facing role

  • MUST be flexible to work a hybrid schedule (3 days a week in office)

  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status.

Even better if you:

  • Have at least 2 years’ experience working in a call center environment or within a financial institution

  • You can articulate your experience working on a team and in a highly collaborative environment

  • You have previously been in a role where you had to meet sales goals either through full time work or college internships

  • You're considered a people-person and have extraordinary interpersonal skills, a strong team orientation and resiliency.

Program Duration: Return to Work programs will run for approximately 16 weeks from January 18, 2027 to May 7, 2027.

We invite you to apply and take the first step towards a rewarding and fulfilling professional journey. Applications open September 15 and close October 9, 2026. To learn more about the program, please visit: www.morganstanley.com/returntowork.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. title: AIRPORT PORTER
description:
Job Summary:
An Airport Porter is responsible for assisting passengers with their luggage, providing excellent customer service, and ensuring baggage is transported safely and efficiently within the airport. The role involves supporting passengers with arrivals, departures, transfers, and special assistance needs while maintaining high service standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist passengers with carrying, loading, and unloading luggage.
  • Escort passengers to check-in counters, boarding gates, baggage claim areas, and transportation points.
  • Transport baggage using luggage carts or trolleys safely and efficiently.
  • Provide assistance to elderly passengers, families with children, and passengers with reduced mobility.
  • Offer directions and general airport information to passengers.
  • Ensure luggage is handled carefully to prevent damage or loss.
  • Maintain cleanliness and proper storage of luggage trolleys and equipment.
  • Follow airport safety, security, and operational procedures at all times.
  • Report unattended baggage, suspicious activities, or safety hazards immediately.
  • Work closely with airline staff, ground handling personnel, and airport operations teams.
  • Deliver excellent customer service and maintain a professional appearance.

Requirements

  • Minimum secondary education or equivalent.
  • Physically fit and able to lift and move heavy luggage (up to company/airport standards).
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Basic English communication; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Ability to work shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and overnight.
  • Customer-oriented with a positive attitude.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced airport environment.
  • No criminal record and able to obtain airport security clearance.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of airport operations and passenger services.
  • Experience in hospitality, customer service, or baggage handling is an advantage.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Team player with good time management skills.

Working Conditions

  • Indoor and outdoor airport environments.
  • Shift-based work, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Frequent walking, standing, bending, and lifting of luggage.
