title: Entry Level- FPGA Engineer (Onsite- Aberdeen, Maryland)
description:
ENTRY-LEVEL FPGA ENGINEER

xG and Mixed Signal Product Development | Technical Services

About the opportunity

Fairwinds Technologies is continuously looking for curious, hands-on early-career engineers who want to turn digital design concepts into working hardware for radios, RF systems, embedded platforms, and operationally relevant test environments. In this role, you may support either our xG or Mixed Signal product development team, or technical-services contracts aligned with those product areas.

You will work alongside experienced FPGA, DSP, RF, embedded software, systems, and test engineers to design, simulate, implement, integrate, and verify programmable-logic solutions. Assignments may span internal product development and customer-funded research, integration, test, demonstration, and field-support activities. The position is designed to build practical engineering depth while giving an early-career engineer exposure to the full lifecycle from requirements and architecture through hardware verification and measured system performance.

What you will do

  • Design, implement, simulate, and verify FPGA logic using VHDL, Verilog, or SystemVerilog under the guidance of experienced engineers.
  • Develop reusable modules for data movement, control, timing, digital interfaces, buffering, signal processing, monitoring, and system integration.
  • Create testbenches, test vectors, assertions, and repeatable verification procedures to demonstrate functional and timing performance.
  • Use FPGA vendor development tools to synthesize, place and route, analyze timing, program devices, and debug designs in laboratory hardware.
  • Support device and board bring-up involving FPGAs, data converters, processors, memory, clocks, radios, RF front ends, and high-speed digital interfaces.
  • Collaborate with DSP engineers to translate algorithms and reference models into fixed-point, pipelined, resource-aware hardware implementations.
  • Collaborate with embedded software engineers on register maps, control interfaces, drivers, configuration, telemetry, and embedded Linux integration.
  • Use simulation, on-chip debug tools, laboratory instruments, and captured data to identify root causes and validate corrective actions.
  • Participate in code reviews, configuration management, issue tracking, design reviews, and continuous integration practices.
  • Prepare clear design descriptions, interface documentation, verification results, test reports, and configuration records for product and customer-funded activities.

Technology and mission areas

Depending on assignment, you may contribute in one or more of the following areas:

  • xG wireless systems, including 5G, non-terrestrial networking, software-defined radio, tactical communications, radio integration, and networked edge systems.
  • Mixed Signal products, including Global Link and EchoPhase-related capabilities, channel emulation, coherent combining, wideband signal processing, and high-speed data-converter interfaces.
  • Digital upconversion and downconversion, filtering, channelization, synchronization, buffering, timing, control, calibration, and real-time data paths.
  • Ruggedized mission modules and RF systems that combine FPGA logic, embedded compute, networking, radio, and mixed-signal hardware.
  • Government-funded R&D and technical-services contracts involving architecture, implementation, integration, verification, demonstrations, documentation, and field support.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field, completed or expected before start date.
  • Coursework, laboratory, internship, capstone, research, or personal-project experience with FPGA development, digital logic, computer architecture, or embedded systems.
  • Foundational understanding of synchronous digital design, finite-state machines, registers, counters, memories, clocking, reset strategies, and timing concepts.
  • Academic or project experience using VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog, or another hardware description language.
  • Basic familiarity with simulation, synthesis, testbenches, and debugging digital hardware.
  • Ability to apply structured problem solving, learn unfamiliar devices and interfaces, communicate assumptions, and document results clearly.
  • Ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary engineering environment and satisfy customer, site-access, export-control, and security requirements associated with assigned work.

Preferred, not required

  • Hands-on experience with an AMD/Xilinx, Intel/Altera, Microchip, Lattice, or comparable FPGA development board and toolchain.
  • Exposure to high-speed interfaces, data converters, DDR memory, Ethernet, PCIe, JESD204, SPI, I2C, UART, AXI, or similar buses and protocols.
  • Familiarity with fixed-point arithmetic, digital signal processing, software-defined radio, clock-domain crossing, timing closure, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Experience using Python, MATLAB, Simulink, cocotb, C or C++, Linux, Git, scripting, or automated build and verification workflows.
  • Coursework or project experience in wireless communications, RF systems, signal processing, 5G/LTE, non-terrestrial networks, radar, satellite communications, or test and measurement.

Why join Fairwinds Technologies

  • Work on products and customer-funded R&D activities within the same technical domain, connecting digital design with hardware, software, RF systems, measured data, and operational use cases.
  • Gain broad exposure to programmable logic, wideband signal processing, high-speed interfaces, data converters, wireless systems, embedded computing, laboratory integration, and field testing.
  • Learn from experienced multidisciplinary engineers while receiving meaningful design, implementation, bring-up, and verification responsibilities early in your career.
  • Join a growing technology organization expanding its xG and Mixed Signal portfolios and strengthening repeatable product-development practices.

How to apply

Submit your resume and, if available, links or short descriptions for relevant HDL code, FPGA projects, testbenches, laboratory work, capstone projects, research, internships, technical papers, or portfolios. Tell us what you designed, what you personally implemented or verified, how you tested it, and what you learned while troubleshooting it.


Compensation- Salary

At Fairwinds, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location and experience. Additional incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full time, exempt position.

Must be eligible to work in the US.

title: Director / VP, State & Local Tax & Incentives
location: West Palm Beach, West Palm Beach, FL, US
description:
Position Summary

TeraWulf is seeking an experienced tax professional to lead state and local tax strategy across its growing portfolio of large-scale digital infrastructure and energy campuses.

This individual will serve as the company’s principal internal expert on property tax, sales and use tax, utility and energy-related taxes, economic development incentives, abatements and other state and local tax matters.

Working closely with Development, Finance, Legal, Operations and External Affairs, this role will ensure tax considerations are incorporated into site selection, project structuring, customer agreements, capital investment decisions and community engagement from the outset.

The successful candidate will bring sophisticated, proactive tax expertise to the significant exposures and opportunities created by TeraWulf’s multi-billion-dollar investments in data centers, electrical infrastructure, power generation and related assets.

Key Responsibilities

State & Local Tax Strategy

· Serve as TeraWulf’s primary internal expert on state and local taxation across existing and prospective campuses.

· Develop comprehensive tax profiles for new projects and expansions before material capital commitments are made.

· Model long-term property, sales and use, utility, gross receipts and other state and local tax obligations.

· Evaluate ownership, leasing, financing and entity structures to optimize project economics.

· Advise executive leadership on material tax exposures, opportunities and policy developments.

Property Tax

· Own property tax strategy across TeraWulf’s portfolio.

· Evaluate the taxable treatment and valuation of land, buildings, electrical infrastructure, generation assets, cooling systems, servers and other machinery and equipment.

· Develop forward-looking property tax forecasts as projects are constructed and capital is deployed.

· Manage relationships with assessors and taxing authorities and lead valuation negotiations, appeals and challenges as appropriate.

· Identify opportunities for abatements, negotiated assessments, PILOTs and other available mechanisms.

Sales & Use Tax and Incentives

· Evaluate sales and use tax treatment of construction, equipment procurement and major capital expenditures.

· Identify and implement available data center, manufacturing, energy, construction and equipment exemptions.

· Identify, negotiate and manage state and local economic development incentives, including abatements, exemptions, PILOTs, industrial revenue bonds, grants and infrastructure support.

· Track and manage ongoing compliance obligations associated with incentive agreements.

Project Development & Commercial Support

· Participate in site diligence and project development from the earliest stages.

· Advise Development and Legal on the tax implications of land ownership, leases, power arrangements, equipment ownership, joint ventures and customer agreements.

· Evaluate the allocation of tax obligations among TeraWulf, customers, landlords, utilities and other counterparties.

· Support acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures and other strategic transactions.

Fiscal Impact & External Positioning

· Develop clear and supportable estimates of the fiscal impact of TeraWulf projects on host communities.

· Quantify projected tax revenues to counties, municipalities, school districts and other taxing jurisdictions.

· Distinguish clearly between gross tax generation, incentives received and net fiscal benefits.

· Partner with External Affairs, Legal and Development to ensure tax-related statements used in regulatory proceedings, customer diligence, government relations and community engagement are accurate and defensible.

Legislative & Regulatory Monitoring

· Monitor proposed state and local tax legislation, regulations and ordinances affecting data centers and energy infrastructure.

· Proactively assess changes to property tax, sales and use tax, data center taxes, utility taxes and incentive programs.

· Coordinate with Legal and External Affairs where proposed tax policy could materially affect existing or planned projects.

Compliance & Risk Management

· Oversee state and local tax compliance across operating jurisdictions.

· Lead examinations, audits and inquiries from taxing authorities.

· Maintain documentation supporting material tax positions, exemptions and incentive arrangements.

· Manage external tax advisors, valuation consultants and other specialists.

· Coordinate with Finance and Accounting on tax provisions and financial reporting as appropriate.

Qualifications

· 10+ years of progressive state and local tax experience.

· Deep expertise in property tax, sales and use tax and economic development incentives.

· Significant experience advising on large capital investment projects.

· Experience in data centers, energy, utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing, industrial real estate or another capital-intensive industry strongly preferred.

· Demonstrated experience working with assessors, taxing authorities, economic development agencies and other governmental stakeholders.

· Strong understanding of property valuation, exemptions, abatements and incentive structures.

· Ability to model and evaluate long-term project tax economics.

· Strong commercial judgment and ability to communicate complex tax matters clearly to senior executives and non-tax professionals.

· CPA, JD, LLM, MST or similar advanced qualification preferred.

· Big Four, national accounting firm, law firm or specialized SALT advisory experience strongly preferred.

Success Measures

· Clear and comprehensive tax strategies for each TeraWulf campus.

· Early incorporation of tax considerations into development and investment decisions.

· Accurate forecasting and active management of state and local tax exposure.

· Identification and capture of available exemptions, abatements and incentives.

· Effective property tax valuation and assessment management.

· Accurate and defensible analysis of project fiscal benefits.

· Proactive identification of tax policy risks and opportunities.

· Development of a scalable tax framework supporting TeraWulf’s continued growth.

Compensation & Benefits

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $[225,000–$275,000], depending on experience and qualifications. This position is also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus, equity-based compensation and TeraWulf’s employee benefits programs.

title: Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Job Overview

PacSci EMC is seeking two Senior Quality Assurance Engineers to strengthen quality performance in our aerospace and defense manufacturing operations. Each engineer will take independent ownership of manufacturing quality in assigned areas while serving as a quality partner to major customer programs and supporting supplier issues. These visible roles call for sound technical judgment, data-driven problem solving, strong relationships and the ability to mentor others as our quality processes continue to evolve.

Essential Functions

• Own manufacturing quality for assigned areas, working directly with Operations, Engineering and integrated product teams to resolve product and process issues and improve first-pass yield.

• Analyze production and quality data, identify trends and systemic risks, and drive action to reduce nonconformances, recurring defects and corrective-action backlog.

• Lead investigations, root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions; use a structured method appropriate to the issue and follow actions through to verified resolution.

• Review engineering requirements, configuration and revisions, manufacturing and acceptance plans, inspection methods and quality records to support alignment with design intent, statements of work and customer requirements.

• Develop and improve manufacturing process validation, control plans, inspection instructions and quality-system documentation; support first article activities, including AS9102 requirements.

• Serve as a quality interface for assigned aerospace and defense customer programs, communicating risks, quality performance and corrective-action status professionally and clearly.

• Review proposals, statements of work and customer requirements with Program Management and cross-functional partners to identify quality and compliance risks early.

• Coordinate quality issues across manufacturing, customer programs, Procurement, Planning, Strategic Sourcing and suppliers, maintaining ownership until resolution.

• Support supplier quality requirements, flow-downs and issue resolution, including occasional supplier visits when needed.

• Make well-supported quality decisions independently; seek peer review or escalate material risks with a clear assessment and recommended path forward.

• Mentor and coach team members through technical problem solving, sound documentation and consistent follow-through; help strengthen proactive quality practices.

• Build effective relationships from the production floor through engineering, customer teams and leadership; influence decisions without direct authority and contribute to continuous improvement.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline required; manufacturing engineering, electrical engineering and chemistry backgrounds are especially relevant. A master’s degree is a plus.

• Five or more years of hands-on Quality Engineering experience required; ten or more years preferred. Strong ownership, judgment and relevant results can distinguish an exceptional candidate with fewer than ten years.

• Aerospace and defense quality experience strongly preferred. Experience in other highly regulated, high-volume manufacturing environments may be considered when the candidate meets the core quality engineering and AS9100 requirements.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Demonstrated hands-on manufacturing quality engineering ownership and experience supporting customer or program quality activities. Prior direct customer interaction is valuable, but candidates with strong transferable communication and program experience will be considered.

• Strong working knowledge of manufacturing process validation, control plans, inspection methods, quality records and corrective action processes.

• Demonstrated use of structured root cause and corrective action methods, such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa or Apollo; 8D experience is preferred.

• Working knowledge of AS9100 required.

• Familiarity with AS9102 / First Article Inspection preferred; role-specific application can be learned.

• Working knowledge of GD&T required; FMEA and process capability/Cpk experience preferred.

• Lean and/or Six Sigma experience preferred; a specific belt certification is not required.

• Ability to interpret technical requirements, analyze quality trends and explain risks and corrective actions to Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, suppliers and customers.

• Independent judgment and ownership in decisions with potentially significant safety, customer, program, compliance and financial consequences; ability to seek another perspective and escalate appropriately.

• Strong relationship-building, mentoring and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge decisions constructively and work with people at different levels.

• Positive, curious, detail-oriented and coachable approach; brings recommendations with problems, works effectively with a team and drives actions through completion.

• ERP or manufacturing execution system (MES) experience is beneficial. No specific software platform is required.

Work Environment and Travel

• This position is 100% onsite in Chandler, Arizona.

• The normal schedule is Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, with staggered eight-hour schedules to support manufacturing operations running approximately 6:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Urgent mission or customer deliveries may occasionally require later hours or Saturday support.

• Travel is expected to be approximately 5% or less, primarily for problem solving at another site or occasional supplier visits.

Why Join PacSci EMC

• Help shape a more proactive quality organization in a growing aerospace and defense business.

• Own meaningful manufacturing and customer quality work on specialized energetic products that support critical missions.

• Gain broad exposure to integrated product teams, major aerospace and defense customers, Operations, Engineering and supplier quality.

• Work closely with technicians and leaders in a visible role where technical ownership and practical improvements matter.

• Develop toward a technical lead, future leadership position or advanced technical path as opportunities arise.

Export Control Requirement

Due to U.S. Government contract requirements applicable to this position, only U.S. citizens are eligible for employment in this role.

Ralliant Corporation Overview

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we're building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.

About PacSci EMC

Pacific Scientific Energetic Materials Company (PacSci EMC), a Ralliant Corporation (NYSE: RAL) operating company, makes critical missions possible. From concept to demonstration to delivery, we provide leading-edge energetic materials, devices and subsystems for use in military and commercial applications. With engineering and manufacturing capability in Arizona and California, our associates work together to solve the toughest technical challenges with a dedication to Safety First, Quality Every TimeTM. We enable success for innumerable missions on a daily basis, impacting the lives of military personnel, law enforcement officers, commercial airline pilots, astronauts, and oil field operators. For nearly a century, PacSci EMC’s experience and expertise has been relied upon in the times When Milliseconds MatterTM. For more information, go to www.psemc.com. PacSci EMC is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, sex, religion, age, national origin, color, disability, or veteran status. Nonetheless, US citizenship is a requirement for this position due to U.S. Government contractual requirements. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. We all have a role in building a community where everyone belongs. Where you can speak your mind, be yourself, and feel supported. title: Systems Security Administrator II
description:
Systems Security Administrator II

About the Role

EECU is seeking a System Security Administrator II to support the security, availability, and integrity of our technology environment. This hands-on role performs cybersecurity administration, security monitoring, vulnerability management, patch administration, incident response support, and security control documentation.

Working within IT Operations, this position partners with Information Security, infrastructure and application administrators, vendors, and business stakeholders to identify and address cybersecurity risks while supporting reliable technology operations and member service delivery.

Location/Schedule:

  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days/week at our corporate office in Fort Worth, TX after the successful completion of 6 months in the role.
  • Friday 08:00 a.m. to 05:00 p.m.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor security platforms, including SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, vulnerability management, and threat-detection solutions.
  • Review security alerts, system events, logs, and unusual activity to identify potential risks or operational issues.
  • Investigate and document security events, escalating potential incidents according to established procedures.
  • Conduct vulnerability scans across servers, workstations, network devices, cloud services, operating systems, and applications.
  • Help prioritize and coordinate vulnerability remediation based on severity, risk, exploitability, and business impact.
  • Plan, test, deploy, validate, and document operating system, application, firmware, and security updates.
  • Monitor patch compliance and coordinate corrective action for failed deployments or unresolved vulnerabilities.
  • Support secure configurations and hardening activities for Windows servers, workstations, endpoints, cloud services, and network infrastructure.
  • Assist with endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, access controls, Active Directory, Entra ID, privileged access, VPN, firewall, and related security administration.
  • Support cybersecurity audits and risk assessments by gathering evidence, maintaining remediation records, and tracking findings and corrective actions.
  • Participate in incident response activities, including alert triage, evidence collection, containment support, root-cause documentation, and remediation tracking.
  • Maintain accurate security documentation, inventories, procedures, dashboards, metrics, and configuration records.
  • Stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, security tools, and cybersecurity administration practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of related experience in information technology, cybersecurity operations, systems administration, network administration, endpoint administration, help desk escalation support, or a related technical role.
  • Experience supporting Windows server and workstation environments, Active Directory, patching, vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, security ticketing, and technical documentation is preferred.
  • Ability to analyze security alerts, troubleshoot technical issues, document findings clearly, and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, dependability, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize competing responsibilities.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and collaborate effectively in a regulated financial-services environment.

Required to attend initial and ongoing annual Bank Secrecy Act training.

For more than 90 years, Fort Worth-based EECU community credit union has been committed to providing members A Better Way of Banking®. title: Clamp Truck Operator - 2nd Shift
description:
We Create Products and Brands That People Trust to Clean, Sanitize, and Protect Their Homes and Pools

When you join KIK Consumer Products, you’re joining a team that cares about the work we do and also about each other. We bring exceptional brands and products to consumers that help them protect the health and wellness of their families and the cleanliness of their homes and pools. We are committed to building a culture of performance driven by accountability, collaboration, and agility that enables timely fact-based decision-making and exceptional execution with unwavering ethics. As one of North America’s largest independent manufacturers of consumer products, KIK helps a large portfolio of brands and retailers bring their products to life.

Your Role at KIK

We are seeking a Clamp Truck Operator on 2nd Shift (4:00 pm–2:30pm, Mon – Thurs and 2:00pm – 10:30pm Friday with weekends as business needs require). In this entry-level material handling role, you will safely move raw materials, packaging, and finished goods throughout the facility to support production and shipping operations. You will operate forklifts and other material handling equipment, complete basic inventory transactions, and help maintain a safe, organized warehouse. Success in this role requires a commitment to safety, quality, teamwork, and following established procedures in a fast-paced manufacturing environment operating under Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs). This position has an hourly rate of $21.63 and a $1.00 shift differential for hours worked after 1st shift.

What You’ll Do

  • Safely operate forklifts and other material handling equipment to load, unload, transport, and stage raw materials, packaging, and finished goods

  • Load and unload trailers while accurately placing inventory into designated warehouse locations

  • Complete basic inventory transactions using RF scanners or warehouse management systems, including receipts, moves, and cycle counts

  • Perform visual quality inspections of finished goods before shipment, ensuring products, pallets, labels, and packaging meet company and customer standards

  • Re-stack, wrap, or secure pallets as needed to maintain safe, stable loads and prevent product damage

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and inspection-ready work area by following 5S, GMP, and housekeeping standards

  • Promptly report safety concerns, damaged product, equipment issues, or near misses

  • Follow all company safety policies, SOPs, GMPs, PPE requirements, and support continuous improvement initiatives

  • Other duties as assigned

What You’ll Bring

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • At least 1 year of forklift experience in manufacturing or warehousing preferred

  • Forklift certification or ability to successfully complete company certification upon hire

  • Ability to read shipping documents, labels, and inventory records

  • Strong attention to detail, teamwork, and commitment to safety

  • Willingness to work overtime, weekends, and different work areas as business needs require

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and climb on/off forklifts throughout 10–12 hour shifts

  • Frequently lift up to 50 pounds

  • Work in a non-temperature-controlled manufacturing environment while wearing required PPE

What You Will Get

KIK offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits including health, wellness, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. You can plan for your future with KIK's retirement savings options including employer match. KIK also recognizes the importance of continuing education and offers Education Assistance to our employees to encourage continued personal development and growth.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. This position has an hourly rate of $21.63 per hour. The actual hourly rate may vary based upon several factors including your relevant skills and experience.

About KIK

We create the products and brands that people trust to clean, sanitize, and protect their homes and pools. We are one of North America’s largest independent consumer product manufacturers with 16 North American manufacturing facilities. We also operate globally in Canada, Europe, South Africa, and Australia. We are known for our portfolio of notable brands including Spic and Span® and Comet® cleaning products, Clorox® Pool&Spa™ (under license), BioGuard®, and Natural Chemistry® pool chemicals. We are also the #1 producer in North America of store-brand bleach and a leading private-label provider of laundry detergent and additives, dishwashing products, general-purpose cleaning, and other home care products.

Our global team of over 2,300 employees drives our capabilities in product development, product formulation, strategic sourcing, manufacturing, packaging design, brand marketing, project management, quality assurance, compliance, distribution, and logistics.

Our organization is constantly evolving and is driven by a set of “One KIK” values – a dedication to following through on commitments in a customer-focused, profit-motivated way; while never compromising on safety, ethics, or integrity.

KIK does not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees based on race, color, age, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or uniformed services status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information or any other status protected by law.

  • Review plans and other technical documents and serve as the main point of contact for project questions, project scope and timelines.
  • Manage project finances and budget; schedule resources including needed labor and equipment according to budget parameters.
  • Conduct Pre-Hand-Off Meeting (prior to commencement of the project) & Post-Hand-Off Meeting (post completion of the project) with the sales and operations teams, ensuring clarity of the scope and expectations, as well as establishing lessons learned.
  • Anticipate changes or challenges, maintain productivity, and ensure successful project transition throughout the project lifecycle utilizing effective change management practices.
  • Supervise field teams and provide leadership and oversight for project teams. May input time and various pay codes and approve timecards for team members.
  • Communicate directly with clients, contractors/subcontractors, and project designers utilizing a Request for Information/Quote/Proposal (RFI/Q/P) processes.
  • Keep MEI leadership, field personnel, and customers / clients and stakeholders informed of project progress on a frequent basis.
  • Collaborate with various teams to execute the project management plan; revise & document plan via a structured change order process as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
  • Work closely with sales team in all phases of the project; work with safety team to coordinate safety training, accident and injury investigations, or property or equipment/material damage incident investigations.
  • Identify, monitor, and work to continuously mitigate risk inherent with projects.
  • Problem-solve and demonstrate quality control measures to ensure project meets MEI standards and customer expectations.
  • Facilitate and/or participate in weekly department and team meetings; provide updates on project progress and resolve issues while communicating with team members, stakeholders, and executives.
  • Must be able to travel to client’s job site(s) and work onsite while directing all activities on the project.
  • Maintain project files in SharePoint to ensure project continuity and historic documentation. Prepare project status reports and works to ensure plans adhere to contract specifications.
  • Consistently demonstrates professional conduct as a representative of MEI and adheres to the corporate mission, vision, and values.
  • Perform all other duties as necessary and directed.


Minimum Qualifications (Experience, Skills, and Education):

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent necessary. Higher education (bachelor’s degree) in project management, construction, or a related field highly preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification is preferred.
  • Five (5) plus years proven machinery moving, construction, project management or construction safety experience is preferable. Rigging and rigging concept knowledge strongly preferred.
  • Familiar with a variety of field / project concepts, practices, procedures, and risks. Background in managing long-term and resource heavy projects preferred.
  • Excellent supervisory and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Able to effectively share information across all levels of staff and understanding.
  • Highly self-directed and self-motivated; works effectively with a team or independently.
  • Must be able to work along aside field technicians for the assembly of and erecting of machine tools.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and time management skills.
  • Able to utilize critical thinking skills and execute independent judgment within established guidelines.
  • Understand contract language and execute project successfully to remain in contract scope.
  • Ability to negotiate effectively with peers around priority and design.
  • Effectively recognize and resolve conflict in early stages.
  • Ability to read and interpret sets of data and plans including schematics, technical manuals, or blueprints.
  • Proficient with MS office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook). Familiarity with both Windows and Apple/iOS operating systems helpful.
  • Knowledge of Bluebeam, Autodesk, 3-D modeling, ACC preferred. Demonstrated knowledge of SharePoint a must.
  • Valid driver’s license or ability to attain, and clean background.
  • Ability to travel to various job sites, customer sites, or MEI locations.
  • Embraces and demonstrates our Values, Vision, Mission, and Company Culture.


Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

This is very physical, hands-on work. A Project Manager must be able to perform General Physical Activities — activities that require considerable use of arms and legs and move your whole body, such as climbing, lifting, balancing, walking, stooping/crouching, and lifting or moving materials weighing up to 50 pounds. Must have the ability to work off the ground at varying heights and not be affected by moving machinery or parts. Willing and able to work in a non-temperature-controlled environment and/or outdoors in all types of weather, and over uneven ground or terrain.


Additional Requirements:

Work with a Top-of-Mind Awareness for the safety of yourself and everyone at the job site. Must be able to work in a high functioning team environment. Display the highest levels of honesty, integrity, and professionalism. Take pride in your work and in the company. Communicate openly and strive for peak performance in daily tasks. Know and deliver the quality service MEI’s customers have come to expect.

description:

About the role:

The Strategic Marketing Program Manager will develop and support strategic marketing initiatives that drive market development, physician engagement, patient conversion, and growth for the Interventional Spine (IVS) business. This role will generate deep patient, physician, and market insights and translate them into actionable strategies that inform marketing investments, commercialization, and future portfolio decisions.

This individual will serve as a strategic insights partner across the IVS business, connecting customer and market insights with business needs and ensuring insights are translated into meaningful action across functions. The role will work across upstream and downstream marketing activities, partnering closely with Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs, R&D, Digital, and global marketing partners to support evidence-based decision-making and identify opportunities for growth.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead patient and physician market research strategy, including ATU, PET, voice-of-customer research, segmentation, persona development, and other qualitative and quantitative research; manage external research partners and ensure high-quality execution.

Manage external agencies, market research vendors, and strategic partners as appropriate to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

title: Java-utvecklare med Kotlin Linköping
description:
Sommaren börjar släppa taget och hösten närmar sig. Tempot skruvas upp igen, vardagen hittar tillbaka till sina rutiner – och kanske gör också tankarna på vad du vill framåt det.

Med några månader kvar av året kan det vara ett bra tillfälle att fundera över nästa steg. Kanske trivs du där du är, eller så börjar det kännas som att det är dags för något nytt. Ett nytt sammanhang, nya utmaningar eller helt enkelt en förändring inför nästa år.

Om de tankarna känns bekanta kanske det är hos Nexer som ditt nästa kapitel börjar.

Som konsult på Nexer får du arbeta med varierande uppdrag inom olika tekniker och branscher. Hos oss är varje uppdrag en chans att växa – vi tror stenhårt på utveckling. Vi tror också på en hållbar och långsiktig anställning, där kompetensutveckling och balans mellan arbete och fritid är självklara delar av vardagen.

Vem är du?

På Nexer i Linköping fortsätter vi att bygga vårt team – nu söker vi erfarna Javautvecklare med praktisk erfarenhet av Kotlin.

Du kommer att spela en viktig roll i utvecklingen av moderna och hållbara digitala lösningar för kunder inom olika branscher – från industri till offentlig sektor. Som konsult hos oss arbetar du i varierande uppdrag och systemmiljöer, där du får möjlighet att utveckla såväl nya lösningar som befintliga system.

Vi söker dig som tycker om utveckling, gillar att lösa komplexa problem och ser programmering som ett hantverk. Du har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling med Java och har även arbetat professionellt med Kotlin. Du är van vid backendutveckling, API:er och databaser och trivs i miljöer där kvalitet, struktur och långsiktigt hållbar kod är viktigt.

Du uppskattar också samarbetet runt utvecklingen – att diskutera tekniska lösningar, dela kunskap och tillsammans med andra hitta bra vägar framåt.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

  • Spring/Spring Boot

  • REST API:er och OpenAPI

  • SQL och relationsdatabaser

  • Automatiserade tester

  • CI/CD, exempelvis GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD eller Jenkins

  • Docker och containerbaserade miljöer

  • Kubernetes

  • Molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP

  • Frontendutveckling, exempelvis React eller Angular

Har du dessutom erfarenhet av mikrotjänstarkitektur, eventdrivna lösningar eller tekniker som Kafka är det ett plus. Erfarenhet av IoT, OPC UA eller MQTT är också ett plus i vissa av våra uppdrag.

Rollen kräver att du obehindrat kan kommunicera på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Det är en viktig förutsättning för att lyckas i kunddialoger och i samarbetet med teamet.

Tjänsten är placerad i Linköping.

Vilka är vi på Nexer i Linköping?

Nexer i Linköping är en arbetsplats där kompetens, engagemang och samarbete står i centrum. Här möts du av ett tight och välkomnande team där varje individs unika talanger tas tillvara, och där prestigelöst kunskapsutbyte och stöd genomsyrar kulturen. Vi tror på att skapa rätt förutsättningar med fokus på dig – dina drivkrafter, ambitioner och utveckling. Hos oss får du möjlighet att växa både som person och i din yrkesroll.

Våra uppdrag finns inom offentlig sektor, industri, försvar och andra teknikdrivande branscher. Ibland arbetar du självständigt, ibland i team – ofta i en hybrid vardag som kombinerar kontor, kund och hemmakontor på ett sätt som passar både uppdraget och livet. Här blir du en del av en trygg och inspirerande gemenskap där balans och personlig utveckling värderas högt.

Om du gillar spännande uppdrag, trevliga kollegor och att utvecklas i din yrkesroll – då kommer du trivas hos oss på Nexer i Linköping.

Ansökan

Du är varmt välkommen att söka tjänsten genom att skicka in din ansökan här nedan. Enligt GDPR hanterar vi inte ansökningar via e-post men har du frågor om tjänsten eller Nexer är du välkommen att höra av dig till ansvarig rekryterare, Petra Sivefäldt, på petra.sivefaldt@nexergroup.com.

title: Residential Home Services Consultant
description:
Hydra Pure Group | Home Services

Full-Time | In-Person
$55,000–$75,000 + Bonuses & Incentives

HYDRA PURE GROUP IS EXPANDING!

We're growing into new communities and looking for motivated, personable individuals to join our Residential Home Services team.

Hydra Pure Group works alongside The Home Depot Home Services program, helping homeowners learn more about solutions available for their home's water and air quality.

This is a field-based position working directly with homeowners in their homes.

Your appointments are with homeowners who have expressed interest in learning more about our services — this is not door-to-door canvassing and does not involve cold calling.

If you're confident, friendly, professional and enjoy meeting new people, this could be an excellent opportunity.

No industry experience is required. Full training is provided.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Residential Home Services Consultant, you'll travel to scheduled residential appointments and meet directly with homeowners.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Visiting homeowners for scheduled in-home appointments
  • Providing a professional and friendly customer experience
  • Learning about the household's water and air quality concerns
  • Conducting basic in-home water quality assessments
  • Explaining available home water treatment and air quality solutions
  • Answering homeowner questions
  • Providing information based on the customer's individual needs
  • Maintaining professional communication throughout the appointment
  • Representing Hydra Pure Group and our Home Services program professionally
  • Following up with customers when appropriate

You're not expected to arrive knowing everything.

Our training program will teach you the products, services, customer process and how to conduct an effective in-home appointment.

A CAREER THAT GETS YOU OUT OF THE OFFICE

If sitting behind the same desk eight hours a day isn't for you, you'll probably appreciate this position.

You'll be meeting different homeowners, visiting different communities and helping people better understand what's happening with the water and air inside their homes.

We offer:

  • $55,000–$75,000 annual earning opportunity
  • Weekly pay
  • Performance bonuses and incentives
  • Full professional training
  • Ongoing coaching and support
  • Home Services program training
  • Flexible field-based working environment
  • Advancement opportunities
  • Leadership development
  • Recognition and team incentives
  • An energetic and supportive company culture
  • Opportunities to grow as Hydra Pure Group expands

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We're looking for people people.

Someone who can walk into a customer's home, introduce themselves professionally, have a genuine conversation, listen to what the homeowner is looking for, and clearly explain their options.

You may be a great fit if you're:

  • Outgoing and personable
  • Confident speaking with homeowners
  • Professional and well-presented
  • A strong communicator
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Reliable and punctual
  • Coachable
  • Goal-oriented
  • Motivated by performance and advancement
  • Interested in building a long-term career

Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, home improvement, automotive, telecommunications, real estate, marketing or other customer-facing industries can be helpful.

Previous industry experience is not required.

REQUIREMENTS

Applicants must:

  • Be legally eligible to work in Canada
  • Reside full-time in Canada
  • Have reliable transportation
  • Be comfortable travelling locally to customer appointments
  • Be comfortable working inside customers' homes
  • Be bondable
  • Maintain a professional appearance and attitude

This is an in-person field position and cannot be performed remotely.

WE'RE BUILDING SOMETHING BIGGER

Hydra Pure Group is continuing to expand, creating opportunities for talented people to grow alongside the company.

We're looking for individuals who want more than just another repetitive job.

For strong performers, future opportunities may include senior consulting, training, customer relations, team leadership and management.

Your starting point is learning how to provide homeowners with an excellent in-home experience.

Where you take it from there can grow with your performance and development.

READY FOR A CHANGE?

If you're confident meeting new people, enjoy being on the road, and want an opportunity where your effort can directly impact your earnings and advancement, we'd like to meet you.

Apply today with your resume.

Selected applicants will be contacted by the Hydra Pure Group recruitment team to discuss the opportunity and next steps.

Hydra Pure Group

Helping homeowners. Developing people. Expanding communities.

description:

Select Chemistry’s Polymer Scientist supports the development, optimization, and commercialization of innovative polymer products for the oil and gas industry.

Develop and optimize polymers and formulations for oilfield applications.

Support scale-up from laboratory development through pilot and commercial manufacturing.

Analyze experimental data and communicate technical findings, conclusions, and recommendations.

MS or PhD in Polymer Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

Emulsion polymerization

title: Oracle Cloud Principal Logistics Commercial & Network Design Program Manager
description:
The OCI Supply Chain Organization is responsible for delivering the global logistics network that powers Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. The Orders & Logistics team manages transportation strategy, carrier operations, freight execution, and cross-functional supply chain programs that enable the timely deployment of cloud infrastructure across Oracle's global data center footprint.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is seeking an experienced Order Fulfillment / Logistics Program Manager to lead strategic transportation operations and global logistics initiatives supporting OCI's rapidly expanding infrastructure network. This role serves as a transportation subject matter expert, driving operational excellence across domestic and international freight movements while partnering with cross-functional organizations to deliver scalable transportation solutions.

The successful candidate will have deep expertise in transportation management systems, carrier management, logistics operations, supplier performance, and end-to-end program management. This position plays a key role in supporting OCI's accelerated growth, large-scale infrastructure deployments, and continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven decision-making and AI-enabled analytics.

Responsibilities

Logistics Network Design

  • Assess multi-procurement supply chain models and identify optimal logistics network solutions.
  • Design commercially and operationally scalable solutions that support Oracle’s hyper-scale growth.
  • Apply best-in-class logistics practices and innovative thinking to network design.
  • Lead implementation and successful delivery of complex logistics solutions.

Cost Control

  • Maintain financial control and visibility across transcontinental, parcel, warehousing and freight spend.
  • Analyze supplier charges, rates, surcharges, volumes and service mix to identify variances and cost leakage.
  • Reconcile invoices and identify recovery, savings and renegotiation opportunities.
  • Provide recurring reporting and scenario analysis on trends, exceptions, financial exposure and corrective actions.
  • Support stakeholders with commercial insight, including analytical support for logistics activities.

Freight Tariff Management and Control

  • Review and approve supplier quotations against agreed tariffs, service requirements and contractual terms.
  • Challenge unsupported, exceptional or non-compliant charges.
  • Maintain an auditable approval trail for material pricing exceptions.
  • Benchmark supplier rates across lanes, modes and services to assess competitiveness and support negotiations to drive cost-reduction opportunities.

MSA and Contract Business Development

  • Develop and maintain SOWs, SOPs and contractual frameworks for key freight suppliers.
  • Define clear scope, service levels, pricing principles, responsibilities, controls and performance expectations.
  • Drive consistent commercial and operating standards across multiple providers.
  • Support local requirements, risk management, capacity planning and contractual updates.
  • Identify and drive continuous supplier performance and service improvement opportunities.

Supplier Program Management

  • Coordinate initiatives across a multi-supplier supply chain.
  • Standardize program governance, processes and supplier management activities.
  • Coordinate supplier scorecards and performance tracking.
  • Lead and align quarterly business reviews across suppliers.
  • Ensure cross-supplier initiatives are consistently managed and executed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain operations, or global freight management.

  • Experience managing domestic and international transportation networks supporting large-scale technology or manufacturing operations.

  • Deep knowledge of transportation management systems, preferably Oracle Transportation Management (OTM).

  • Experience supporting global data center, cloud infrastructure, or high-tech supply chains is highly desirable.

Preferred Skills

  • Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) subject matter expertise.

  • Strong understanding of domestic and international freight operations, carrier management, and transportation planning.

  • Experience with reverse logistics and asset recovery operations.

  • Proven program management experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives.

  • Experience collaborating with Finance, IT, Trade Compliance, Tax, Procurement, and Operations organizations.

  • Strong commercial negotiation and supplier relationship management skills.

  • Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence tools.

  • Experience applying AI and automation technologies to improve logistics operations and decision-making.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority in a fast-paced, global environment.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • On-time delivery performance for critical OCI infrastructure shipments.

  • Successful execution of transportation support for large-scale global deployments.

  • Effective integration and performance management of transportation carriers.

  • Improved transportation cost efficiency and carrier performance.

  • Increased visibility and operational control through Oracle Transportation Management.

  • Efficient execution of reverse logistics transportation programs.

  • Successful delivery of cross-functional transportation initiatives.

  • Increased automation, predictive analytics, and AI-driven insights supporting transportation operations.

title: Forward Deployment Engineer (Residency Program)
description:
Role Mission

As HAI's Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Resident, you will own the delivery of safe, autonomous clinical conversations with patients, from the conversation layer to the integration design. You'll develop and refine the prompts and conversation logic that determine how millions of patients experience our breakthrough healthcare AI. And you’ll architect the transports and mappings to get data in and out of these conversations. This role exists because building truly autonomous clinical conversations requires both deep technical skill and relentless focus on patient experience—and we need someone who can master both.

What You Will Accomplish

Own your first major outcome: By day 90, you will have shipped improvements to at least two live conversation workflows, developed advanced prompts that meaningfully improve clinical safety scores or patient satisfaction metrics, collaborated with clinicians to translate their feedback into conversation logic, and shipped code that's now running in production healthcare environments.

Drive lasting impact: This is the front door to our Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) track: your first 6 months are as an FDE Resident, followed by 6 months as an Associate FDE, working alongside FDE leadership with exposure to Product Engineering and AI Engineering along the way. Most residents graduate into full FDE roles, with some moving into Engineering or Product based on their strengths and interests.

The Team

You'll work alongside software engineers, ML scientists, product managers, and clinical experts who are obsessed with getting conversation right. This is a collaborative team that ships fast, values experimentation, and treats patient safety as non-negotiable. You'll have direct input into product decisions and the autonomy to innovate on conversation and integration design.

What You Will Do

  • Develop advanced prompts for our conversation planning layer using sophisticated prompting techniques (chain-of-thought, few-shot learning, role-based prompting, structured outputs) to enable complex agentic workflows that handle real clinical scenarios

  • Engineer conversation logic and patient interactions that balance clinical accuracy, safety guardrails, and patient experience—writing, testing, and iterating on prompts that make our agents feel natural and trustworthy

  • Design and build the integrations that connect our conversational agents to customer EHRs, scheduling systems, and telephony platforms—turning HL7/FHIR feeds and REST/webhook APIs into the real-time signals that shape every conversation

  • Collaborate with clinicians, product managers, and engineers to translate clinical requirements into conversation designs, conduct user testing with healthcare professionals, and iterate based on feedback from real-world usage

  • Conduct rigorous experiments and analysis on model outputs, prompt variations, and conversation strategies—measuring impact on clinical safety scores, patient satisfaction, task completion rates, and other key metrics

  • Use advanced prompting techniques including retrieval augmentation, tool calling, conditional logic, and multi-turn conversation management to optimize model performance and patient experience across diverse clinical scenarios

  • Maintain and improve our conversation codebase, ensuring prompts are version-controlled, documented, and deployed safely to production healthcare environments with proper testing and rollout procedures

  • Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with customer engineering teams during go-lives, debugging integration issues live and turning one partner's edge case into a reusable pattern that ships to every future customer

Location Requirement

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Palo Alto office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent demonstrated coursework and professional projects)

  • 2+ years of professional industry experience in software development, AI/ML, or related technical roles

  • Strong Python proficiency with hands-on experience writing production or near-production code

  • Demonstrated experience with LLM prompting through professional work or substantial personal projects (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar models)

  • Experience building integrations with databases and RESTful APIs, including understanding of async patterns and error handling

  • Strong problem-solving mindset with proven ability to break down complex problems and iterate toward solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with backend development frameworks (Flask, Django, FastAPI, Spring Boot, or similar)

  • Portfolio of personal or academic projects demonstrating full-stack development, AI experimentation, or prompt engineering work

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts including model architectures, training approaches, or evaluation methods

  • Understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance best practices, particularly in regulated healthcare environments (HIPAA, healthcare data handling)

  • Healthcare or health-tech experience, including exposure to clinical workflows, EHR systems, or patient-facing applications

  • Experience with prompt engineering frameworks or tools (LangChain, LangSmith, Anthropic SDK, etc.)

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @ email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

title: Intermediate data engineer
description:
Introduction:

We are seeking an experienced Intermediate Data Engineer to join a company based in Pretoria and manage and develop an established Microsoft Fabric data platform. The successful candidate will ensure reliable day-to-day operations while delivering new data engineering requirements. This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical capability, independent problem-solving and the ability to work across data ingestion, transformation, modelling, warehousing and business intelligence integration.

Job Purpose:

To take ownership of an established Microsoft Fabric data platform, ensuring reliable operations and delivery of new data engineering requirements.

REQUIREMENTS Minimum education (essential): Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field. Minimum Education (desirable) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field. Relevant Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure data certification. Minimum applicable experience (years): 4+ years of practical data engineering experience, including strong recent hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric. Required nature of experience: Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including One Lake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines/Data Factory, notebooks and Dataflows Gen2. Strong SQL Server and T‑SQL capability, including complex query development, schema design, indexing and performance optimisation. Practical experience developing, maintaining and supporting production ETL/ELT pipelines. Experience integrating and extracting data from REST/SOAP APIs, databases, flat files and other structured or unstructured data sources. Proficiency in data transformation using SQL and Python/Py Spark, with an understanding of scalable data processing practices. Practical experience in data warehousing, dimensional modelling, incremental loading, orchestration and schema evolution. Experience with troubleshooting pipeline failures, data quality issues and performance bottlenecks, including the ability to restore service efficiently. Experience with source control, CI/CD and deployment practices using Git, Azure Dev Ops or equivalent tools. Experience supporting Power BI and other downstream analytical or reporting requirements. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of an existing technical environment with limited hand‑holding. Strong documentation, communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Skills and Knowledge (essential): Microsoft Fabric: One Lake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines/Data Factory, notebooks and Dataflows Gen2. SQL Server / T‑SQL Python / Py Spark REST/SOAP APIs and structured/unstructured data ingestion. ETL/ELT, incremental loading, orchestration and scheduling. Dimensional modelling, medallion architecture, schema evolution and data warehousing. Power BI integration and understanding of downstream analytical requirements. Git / Azure Dev Ops, CI/CD and environment deployment practices. Monitoring, data quality, performance optimisation, security and operational support. Other: Proficient in Afrikaans and English. Own transport and valid driver’s license. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS AND OBJECTIVES Fabric Data Engineering and Pipeline Development Take ownership of the existing Microsoft Fabric data engineering environment and become productive quickly following handover. Design, develop, maintain and orchestrate reliable batch and near-real-time data ingestion pipelines using appropriate Microsoft Fabric capabilities. Extract and ingest data from structured and unstructured sources, including REST APIs, SOAP APIs, databases and flat files. Develop robust data transformation logic using SQL, Python/Py Spark, Fabric notebooks and Dataflows Gen2, as appropriate. Implement incremental loading, retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring and alerting to support data integrity and pipeline reliability. Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and data processing issues efficiently. Optimise data pipelines and processing workloads for performance, scalability and cost-effectiveness. Data Architecture and Platform Management Design, manage and evolve scalable data architectures using Microsoft Fabric, One Lake, Lakehouse, Warehouse and SQL Server. Maintain appropriate data-layering and medallion architecture principles, where applicable, with clear movement from raw to curated data. Develop and maintain robust schema designs, indexes, partitioning and query strategies to support analytical and operational workloads. Manage schema evolution and version control to maintain consistency and minimise disruption to downstream consumers. Maintain metadata, data dictionaries, architecture documentation and technical documentation to improve supportability and reduce key-person dependency. Define and maintain appropriate role-based access and security controls. Data Warehousing and BI Integration Build and maintain analytical data stores using Microsoft Fabric Warehouse and/or Lakehouse patterns. Apply appropriate data-loading, partitioning, storage optimisation and query-performance practices. Develop and maintain stable, well‑modelled datasets for Power BI and other analytical consumers. Work with reporting and analytical teams to investigate and resolve data-related issues. Ensure data structures and outputs support downstream reporting and business intelligence requirements. Data Modelling and Standards Develop and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models. Apply dimensional modelling techniques, including star and snowflake schemas, to support analytics and reporting. Apply appropriate normalisation and relational modelling techniques for operational and analytical workloads. Ensure consistency of data models across systems. Manage schema versioning and evolution without unnecessarily disrupting downstream consumers. Apply agreed data engineering standards and modelling principles consistently. Ownership, Reporting and Communication Work independently and take end-to-end ownership of assigned data engineering deliverables, incidents and production issues. Provide clear and timely updates regarding progress, risks, dependencies and blockers. Engage directly with technical and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and agree practical solutions. Explain technical concepts and trade-offs in a manner appropriate to the relevant stakeholder. Maintain practical technical documentation, including runbooks, architecture notes, change logs and release notes. Take accountability for the successful delivery and operational support of assigned solutions. Automation, Monitoring and Optimisation Automate recurring data engineering and operational activities where practical. Implement monitoring and alerting to identify data quality issues, pipeline failures and abnormal processing behaviour. Analyse and optimise query, notebook and pipeline performance across SQL Server and Microsoft Fabric. Monitor capacity and resource utilisation and contribute to scalability and cost‑control decisions. Deploy solutions using appropriate CI/CD and controlled deployment practices. Security and Best Practices Apply data security best practices, including secure authentication, least‑privilege access and appropriate encryption. Ensure data engineering solutions comply with applicable data governance policies and regulatory requirements. Apply sound engineering practices relating to recoverability, auditability, supportability and controlled change. Protect confidential and sensitive business information. Contribution to the Team Collaborate with developers, data analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions. Support effective handover and knowledge transfer to reduce key‑person dependency within the data environment. Share technical knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement of team practices and the data environment. Provide guidance and support to junior team members where required. Remain accountable for the quality, reliability and timeliness of own deliverables. title: AI Solutions Engineer - Agents & Automation
description:
About Us
HeadQuarters is a global start-up that partners with US cannabis companies to provide support in finance, sales operations, and logistics. We are currently seeking an AI Solutions Engineer to join our growing product development team.

The Role

We're hiring an engineer to design and build AI agents and automations for our external customers in the fast growing Cannabis / CPG industry. You'll partner with our team from the first conversation through delivery: understanding a customer's workflows, scoping what an agent should own, building it on top of their systems, and making sure it runs reliably in production. The most important part of this job is learning how a customer's work actually gets done: sitting with their frontline staff, earning their trust, and turning unwritten rules and exceptions into logic a system can follow.

Once an agent is live, you'll hand it off to one of our Operations Managers, who oversee the agent's day-to-day work and output on the customer's behalf.

Every customer runs on a different stack, so this role calls for real engineering depth, and you don't need a long AI resume to have it. We're looking for a strong developer who has recently put LLM-powered workflows into production. Plenty of people can prompt their way to a working prototype. We need someone who can own the code behind it, troubleshoot it inside an unfamiliar environment, and harden it so it holds up long after you've moved on to the next customer.

What You'll Do

Discovery and Scoping (with the AI Sales Lead)

  • Join customer discovery calls to understand their workflows, systems, data, and pain points
  • Sit with customers' frontline staff to learn how the work actually gets done, capture the rules and exceptions that live in people's heads, and translate them into explicit logic
  • Build trust with the people whose work you're automating, and treat them as the experts on their process
  • Assess technical feasibility and identify which tasks are good candidates for an agent and where human review should stay in the loop
  • Translate customer needs into solution designs, effort estimates, and clear scope
  • Build proofs of concept and demos that show customers what an agent can do with their own workflows
  • Provide build and run cost estimates (model usage, infrastructure, maintenance) to support pricing

Build and Deploy

  • Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automations that handle multi-step workflows across customer operations
  • Build and configure integrations that link each customer's tools, such as CRMs, ERPs, accounting platforms, email, messaging, and document storage, using APIs where they exist and browser automation where they don't
  • Write production-quality Python for integrations, data transformation, and agent tooling
  • Use SQL to validate agent outputs, reconcile records across systems, and measure accuracy
  • Build error handling, retries, idempotency, logging, alerting, and graceful fallbacks into everything you ship
  • Create testing and evaluation processes for each agent: test sets, regression checks, and accuracy tracking before go-live and after every change
  • Architect deployments so each customer's data, credentials, and permissions stay fully isolated

Handoff and Support

  • Hand off live agents to Operations Managers with runbooks, monitoring dashboards, review queues, and clear escalation paths
  • Train Operations Managers to supervise agent output, spot problems early, and handle routine exceptions without engineering help
  • Serve as the technical escalation point when an agent fails or a customer's systems change
  • Use what you learn from each deployment to build reusable components, templates, and deployment patterns that make the next customer faster to deliver
  • Measure and report impact for each customer against a baseline: hours saved, turnaround time, error rates, and cost per run

First-Year Mission

Your first year is measured by the operating results customers see, not by how many agents you deliver.

  • Establish a baseline for every customer workflow you take on: hours spent, turnaround time, error rates, and cost
  • Deliver measurable, sustained improvements against those baselines for customers across multiple industries
  • Shorten the time from signed agreement to measurable customer results
  • Hand off agents that Operations Managers run day to day with minimal engineering involvement
  • Earn renewals and expansions because the results hold up over time

Requirements

  • Several years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, or automation engineering experience
  • Proof of recent production LLM workflows: something you built with Claude, OpenAI, or a similar platform that real users rely on
  • Strong Python: you structure, test, and debug your code, and you understand what AI-generated code is doing before you ship it
  • Strong SQL: joins, CTEs, window functions, and tracking down data quality problems
  • Browser automation experience with Playwright or a similar tool, for systems with limited or no APIs
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, pagination, and rate limits across a wide range of third-party platforms
  • A track record of troubleshooting production failures: reading logs and stack traces, isolating root causes, and fixing them permanently
  • Comfort with Bash and the command line for deployment, scheduling, and debugging
  • Git and version control as a standard part of how you work
  • Workflow discovery skills: you can interview the people who do the work, uncover the steps and exceptions they don't think to mention, and turn tacit knowledge into explicit rules
  • Operator empathy: you build trust with frontline staff, treat them as the experts on their work, and explain technical tradeoffs in plain language
  • Comfort in customer-facing settings: you can run a technical conversation with a customer and push back on scope when needed
  • Strong documentation habits, since the people running your agents day to day won't be engineers

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the Claude API, Claude Agent SDK, or Claude Code
  • Working proficiency in TypeScript / JavaScript (Node.js)
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or configuring MCP servers
  • Experience building tool-using AI agents that run multi-step workflows
  • Prior solutions engineering, sales engineering, consulting, or agency experience delivering technical projects for multiple clients
  • Integration experience with common business platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft 365, and Google Workspace
  • Experience with workflow platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier, and good judgment on when a workflow should move from no-code to code
  • Cloud deployment experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containers and serverless functions
  • Multi-tenant architecture and familiarity with security reviews, SOC 2, or customer data protection requirements
  • Document and data extraction from invoices, PDFs, and spreadsheets
  • Background in finance, accounting, or back-office operations
  • Experience working with distributed, international teams

How We'll Evaluate
We care about what you've actually built and whether you understand it. Expect to:

  • Walk us through an LLM workflow or automation you built and shipped: the architecture, what broke, and how you fixed it
  • Complete a practical exercise debugging and hardening an existing automation
  • Take part in a mock customer discovery conversation, including interviewing a frontline operator about their workflow, then outline how you'd scope, build, and hand off an agent for that customer

Benefits

🌍 Work fully remotely in a flexible and collaborative environment

🤖 Build and apply your AI engineering expertise by designing AI agents and automation solutions for real-world business challenges

💼 Work directly with leading U.S. cannabis companies, helping build solutions that improve how their teams operate and scale

📈 Grow your career through hands-on ownership, exposure to emerging AI technologies, and continuous learning

Our Values
We are guided by curiosity, collaboration, and persistence. We seek to understand deeply, work collectively to solve complex challenges, and remain resilient in pursuit of meaningful, long-term impact. These principles shape how we operate as a team and how we support the success of our clients.

Looking forward to meeting you!
