title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
POSITION TITLE: AI Enablement Engineer

Supervised by: Director of Software Development

Supervises: N/A

FLSA Status: Exempt / Full-Time

POSITION SUMMARY. The AI Enablement Engineer is a senior-level, hands-on technical leader responsible for enabling the rapid development of secure and scalable AI capabilities across enterprise products. This role specializes in LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-driven automation techniques, collaborating closely with rapid prototyping developers, architects, and security experts to ensure AI solutions integrate effectively with enterprise systems. This role will directly improve implementation velocity by automating data mapping, loading, validation and related workflows and will champion responsible enterprise adoption of AI tools and operational workflows across the organization.

JOB DUTIES and ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS. A qualified individual must be able to perform these essential functions of the job as listed, with or without accommodation.

  1. AI Platform Evaluation and Solution Design
    1. Evaluate, recommend, and integrate LLMs and AI tooling, including platform selection guidance (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face, and comparable enterprise AI platforms / tools). When AI tooling affects client onboarding, data migration, or conversion workflows, partner with Implementation Services and Data Engineering leadership to assess feasibility and operational impact.
    2. Provide technical evaluation input on feasibility, security posture, architecture fit, integration complexity, and total cost of ownership within a build vs. buy vs. partner framework owned jointly by Product Management and Implementation Services leadership. This role informs the business case; it does not own ROI sign-off.
    3. Collaborate with technical architecture to ensure AI solutions align with enterprise patterns, data flows, and security/compliance frameworks.
  2. AI Enablement and Workflow Automation
    1. Partner directly with the rapid prototyping developer to shape and refine AI-driven product features for feasibility, scalability, and quality, with primary focus on AI-augmented implementations.
    2. Develop advanced prompt engineering techniques, reusable AI patterns, and orchestration methods to accelerate implementation services. Document and standardize repeatable approaches so they can be adopted at scale.
    3. Apply generative AI to automate testing, linting, fuzz testing, and technical debt reduction.
    4. Operationalize autonomous coding workflows (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) with governance guardrails, review gates, and productivity metrics.
    5. Serve as the hands-on enablement lead for Implementation Services; building reference workflows, training delivery staff, and removing adoption friction so tooling produces measurable outcomes.
    6. Partner with Implementation Services leadership to document current-state data onboarding:
      1. source systems/formats (e.g., mainframe extracts, EHR exports, claims files), per-client cycle time, and where the pain concentrates (mapping logic, validation, testing, or all three).
  3. Security, Privacy and Compliance
    1. Evaluate and deploy PHI-safe LLM options (Claude Enterprise and/or local models), aligning handling with HITRUST r2 controls and HIPAA/HITECH obligations.
    2. Design and enforce guardrails for secure handling of PHI and PII within AI sessions and pipelines.
  4. Adoption, Training, and Change Enablement
    1. Establish and report adoption and impact metrics, including cycle-time reduction, mapping accuracy, defect rates, and adoption rate, suitable for SLT and board-level visibility.
    2. Lead enablement activities that drive adoption across technical and delivery teams, including training, office hours, documentation, and workflow reinforcement.
  5. Production Readiness, Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement
    1. Provide AI mentorship to senior development staff and Implementation Services delivery teams via pairing sessions, design reviews, and lunch-and-learn sessions.
    2. Create and collaborate on architectural blueprints, compliance/security standards, reusable frameworks, and reference implementations for AI projects.
    3. Support transition of prototypes into production-ready, enterprise-compliant solutions.

QUALIFICATIONS

Competencies:

  • Deep technical expertise in AI/LLM engineering.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate complex AI concepts into actionable, scalable solutions.
  • Effective mentorship and knowledge-sharing abilities with senior developers.
  • Ability to influence and drive adoption across cross-functional stakeholders.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Master’s preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive AI/ML engineering, including recent, hands-on LLM development and deployment work.
  • Deep understanding of LLM internals (tokenization, context windows, reasoning behaviors).
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization.
  • Security and privacy best practices for PHI/PII data protection in AI workflows.
  • Strong skills in prompt engineering and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, vector search, semantic caching).
  • Familiarity with NLP, OCR/ML, and document processing where applicable.
  • Strong data engineering fundamentals: ETL/ELT, schema mapping, transformation, and loading at scale.
  • Healthcare data experience; working knowledge of HIPAA/HITECH, PHI handling, and HITRUSTaligned controls.
  • Practical experience with AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent) in a governed environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive adoption, translating technical capability into workflows that are sustainable.
  • Practical experience using generative AI for test automation and code quality improvements.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across architecture, development, and security teams.

Work Environment. Employees may work from our corporate headquarters or work from home. Employees may at times be required to travel to headquarters for meetings or company events. Remote workers will be provided with a company laptop and are responsible for maintaining access to highspeed internet.

Physical Demands. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit for long periods of time, stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work. This is a full-time position, and the hours of work and days are typically Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. Some flexibility in hours is allowed, but the employee must be available during the “core” work hours of 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand.

Travel. Incumbent may occasionally experience some out-of-the-area and overnight travel.

Work Authorization. In compliance with Federal employment laws, MediQuant will verify the identity and employment authorization of each person hired. MediQuant participates in the Federal E-Verify program.

Security Clearance. Must be able to pass all security clearances mandated by various government contracts as well as client hospital/healthcare security requirements. Any employee working on government projects will be required to successfully pass a government background check and receive a Common Access Card (CAC). Additionally, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen and will be subject to a Public Trust security background investigation and must meet requirements to obtain a Department of Defense (DOD) network account.

AAP/EEO Statement. MediQuant, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

Compliance. Employees shall comply with all MediQuant policies, state and federal laws, regulations, and contractual obligations when accessing MediQuant or client Confidential Data, Confidential Information, and Information Assets.

title: Repair Specialist 3
description:
We are hiring now for a Repair Specialist! - Join the SMTC Team!

Company Overview: At SMTC Corporation, we are driven by a clear purpose: "We believe we enhance people's lives and our world every day." Our vision is to be an inspiring organization that earns the trust and admiration of our customers. As the best-in-class EMS provider, we strive to achieve the highest industry returns, driven by our passionate and dedicated employees.


*This is a temporary position for about 4 months*


Summary:

The Repair Specialist III is responsible for performing advanced printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) repair and rework while serving as the technical subject matter expert for board-level repair processes. This role performs complex component replacement, advanced circuit repair, failure analysis support, engineering builds, and process improvement activities while ensuring repaired products meet IPC standards, customer specifications, and reliability requirements.

Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Test Engineering, and Production leadership, the Repair Specialist III provides technical guidance, mentors Repair Specialists, supports new product introductions (NPI), and drives continuous improvement initiatives within a high-reliability electronics manufacturing environment.

Essential Functions:

  • Perform advanced repair and rework of printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs), including finepitch integrated circuit (IC) replacement, conductor repair, pad repair, wire adds, piggyback resistor installation, epoxy application, and complex board restoration using approved IPC repair methods.
  • Utilize microscopes, soldering stations, hot air rework systems, and specialized repair equipment to complete precision board-level repairs while maintaining product integrity.
  • Analyze failed assemblies to identify probable failure modes, workmanship concerns, component damage, and repair requirements prior to initiating corrective actions.
  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of repair issues and collaborate with Engineering, Test Engineering, and Quality to determine root cause and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support engineering builds, prototype assemblies, new product introductions (NPI), engineering change implementation, and manufacturing process validations.
  • Read and interpret schematics, engineering drawings, assembly documentation, bills of material (BOMs), engineering change notices (ECNs), repair procedures, and customer specifications to perform complex repair activities.
  • Inspect completed repairs to verify workmanship, solder quality, circuit integrity, component orientation, and compliance with IPC-7711/7721, IPC-A-610, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain complete documentation of repair activities, defect history, component replacements, manufacturing transactions, and product traceability within ERP or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to Repair Specialists by supporting troubleshooting, standardized repair techniques, and on-the-job training.
  • Identify recurring repair trends and recommend improvements to manufacturing processes, repair methods, tooling, documentation, and product design to improve quality and reliability.
  • Maintain repair equipment, microscopes, soldering stations, and specialized tools in accordance with calibration, preventive maintenance, ESD, and safety requirements.
  • Maintain compliance with IPC standards, customer requirements, company procedures, ESD controls, and quality management system requirements..

Competencies:

  • Advanced PCB Repair & Rework: Ability to perform complex PCB repair and rework using approved IPC repair methodologies.
  • Failure Analysis: Ability to evaluate failed assemblies and identify probable failure modes and repair requirements.
  • Advanced Component Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose complex board-level failures and recommend effective corrective actions.
  • Fine-Pitch & IC Rework: Ability to perform advanced integrated circuit (IC) replacement and finepitch rework while maintaining board integrity.
  • Circuit & Conductor Repair: Ability to perform conductor repair, pad restoration, wire modifications, and board restoration techniques.
  • IPC Repair Standards: Advanced knowledge of IPC-7711/7721 repair methodologies and accepted repair practices.
  • IPC Workmanship Standards: Advanced knowledge of IPC-A-610 workmanship requirements and customer quality standards.
  • Document Interpretation: Ability to interpret schematics, Bills of Materials (BOMs), engineering drawings, ECNs, repair procedures, and customer specifications.
  • Technical Mentorship: Ability to coach and develop Repair Specialists through technical guidance and standardized repair practices.
  • Continuous Improvement: Ability to identify repair trends and implement improvements that enhance product quality and manufacturing reliability.
  • Quality Inspection: Ability to verify repair quality, workmanship, and compliance with IPC and customer requirements.
  • Material Traceability: Ability to maintain accurate repair documentation and complete product traceability.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to analyze complex repair issues and implement effective technical solutions.
  • Safety Awareness: Knowledge of safe work practices, ESD controls, and equipment handling procedures. • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in ERP/MES systems and electronic manufacturing documentation.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Associate degree in Electronics Technology or a related technical field preferred.
  • Certifications: o IPC-7711/7721 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS), or ability to obtain within a specified timeframe.- Required o IPC-A-610 Certified IPC Specialist, Preferred o IPC J-STD-001 Certification, Preferred
  • Experience: o Minimum of four (4) years of progressive experience performing repair and rework of printed circuit board assemblies in an electronics manufacturing environment. o Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) experience strongly preferred.

o Demonstrated experience performing advanced board-level repair, integrated circuit replacement, conductor repair, wire adds, piggyback resistor installation, epoxy application, and precision soldering. o Experience supporting engineering builds, prototype assemblies, process improvement initiatives, or failure analysis activities preferred. o Ability to read and interpret schematics, engineering drawings, repair documentation, and customer specifications. o Advanced knowledge of IPC-7711/7721, IPC-A-610, IPC J-STD-001, and electronics manufacturing processes. o Experience utilizing ERP or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) preferred. o Strong analytical, troubleshooting, mentoring, and communication skills.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand and/or walk for extended periods during the work shift.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods when performing inspection, testing, administrative, or computer-based tasks.
  • Ability to use hands and fingers to handle, inspect, manipulate, assemble, or operate equipment and materials.
  • Ability to perform repetitive hand, wrist, and arm movements.
  • Ability to reach, bend, stoop, twist, kneel, crouch, and/or climb as required.
  • Ability to visually inspect products, components, assemblies, documentation, and computer displays with or without corrective lenses.
  • Ability to distinguish colors, markings, symbols, and other visual indicators when required by the position.
  • Ability to hear and communicate effectively in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to safely operate tools, equipment, machinery, or material handling devices as authorized.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and/or pull materials and equipment up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to work in close proximity to production equipment, moving machinery, and material handling operations while maintaining situational awareness.
  • Ability to wear and properly utilize required personal protective equipment (PPE) and ESD protection devices.
  • Ability to maintain physical stamina necessary to meet production, quality, and operational requirements.


Mental Requirements:

  • Work requires the ability to maintain attention to detail, concentration, and accuracy while performing routine and non-routine tasks in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Employees must be able to understand and follow written and verbal instructions, interpret jobrelated documentation, apply established procedures, and make decisions within defined guidelines.
  • The role requires effective problem-solving, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while adapting to changing production demands.
  • Employees must be able to communicate effectively with supervisors, coworkers, and other departments, maintain focus despite interruptions, and consistently meet safety, quality, and productivity expectations.

Work Environment:

  • Work is performed within an electronics manufacturing environment and may involve exposure to moderate noise levels, fluctuating temperatures, and proximity to production equipment, soldering operations, and automated machinery. Duties may require standing, walking, bending, or repetitive motions for extended periods, as well as lifting or moving materials as job responsibilities dictate. Employees may enter clean or controlled areas and are required to follow all environmental, safety, ESD, and equipment-handling procedures. This includes the use of SMTC-provided ESD-safe items such as foot straps, wrist straps, and smocks when working in designated areas. Employees must be able to remain attentive and compliant with all operational, safety, and quality requirements while working on or near the production floor.

Travel: 0-10% of the time based on business needs.

title: Fullstack Engineer, Beneficial Deployments
description:
OpenEvidence is the most widely used medical AI platform in the world.

In just over a year, our usage has grown to >40% of US clinicians via product-led word of mouth adoption. We are a $12B company with a 30 person engineering team from MIT, Harvard, and Stanford. We believe world-changing products come from a small group of exceptional, autonomous builders, organized along focused objectives and empowered to take individual ownership and run fast. We are growing our team to seize a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to define the default platform for medical AI. If you are a world-class engineer or scientist looking to define the bleeding edge and deliver concrete outcomes that impact hundreds of millions of lives, we want to talk.

Culture

We believe work is something that should be engaged with at a world-class level. Building 0->1 and scaling 1->1000 are professional sports, and uncompromising excellence is the bar. We believe building technologies that haven't existed is only possible with end to end ownership. We don't have separate product managers–every engineer and scientist is responsible for landing major improvements to the product. Important things are accomplished when an individual decides to accomplish them.

We believe that work should be hard. We believe good work is precise and intentional. Doing something a certain way just because that's how others are doing it guarantees mediocrity. We believe the quality of the product is paramount and the smallest details matter most. At the same time, developer and product velocity are essential. The best engineers know how to jump right to the hardest part of the problem and take every possible shortcut while keeping the user experience pristine. We believe an engineer's job is to complete and announce important projects and demonstrate their impact, or fail fast and pivot.

Who are you?

If you are looking to complete tickets 9-5 that someone else assigns, this job is not for you. If you are looking to write papers, this job is not for you. If you are looking to lean in and get your hands dirty, bruised, and bloody making something from nothing, personally impact hundreds of millions of lives, and drive ten figures of revenue, this job might be for you.

The ideal candidate is a brilliant builder. They are smart, ambitious, scrappy, autonomous, precise, motivated, hard-working, and low-ego. Does that sound rare? It is rare, we have only found 30 of them, and we would like to find more.


Skillsets

Specific skillsets are secondary, but some important spikes for different facets of our work are:

Fullstack

  • You love building end-to-end and seeing ideas through to completion.

  • The concept of creating something with your own two hands and then seeing that used and loved by millions of the most discerning users in the world is highly motivating.

Frontend and/or mobile

  • You are personally in control of the direct user experience. You have extreme attention to detail, and strive to make beautiful, modern, intentional interfaces.

  • You might have experience building beautiful mobile apps that users find to be a joy to use.

Machine learning

  • You have experience pushing the boundaries of what modern models are capable of.

  • You have a background in research, but find yourself drawn to actually making things instead of writing papers, and want real ownership and autonomy to build the future.

  • Evaluation and quantitative proof are first-class citizens to you.

Infrastructure / site reliability

  • Every single moment of downtime for a service used in literally life or death moments is something you want to personally eliminate.

  • You thrive building robust, optimized backends for mission-critical domains.

Speed

  • You know that improving speed doesn’t just make things faster, it can completely transform the user experience.

  • You enjoy tracking down and optimizing away every single source of inefficiency to create magical experiences for users.

Applied AI

  • You excel at building end-to-end systems grounded in a strong intuition about how to leverage modern models as components of extremely thoughtful, intentional systems.

Our engineering team is in-person 5 days a week in SF and Miami. We believe in creating an environment that optimizes for focus and productivity, including providing meals, transport and anything else you need to move quickly.

title: 07294 - Inspector Construction
description:
Inspect all phases of highway construction and maintenance projects under the general supervision of senior or supervisory staff, ensuring construction quality in accordance with plans and specifications and providing a quality transportation system for the traveling public.

How you will contribute:

Work proactively with the Project Inspector, Construction Manager and Communications Office to notify project support staff and the public of traffic changes and project phase start and finish. Address landowner, business owner and traveling public concerns regarding project. Assist with the coordination and distribution of lane closure notification with the Traffic Operations Center, Communications and Residency. Work with contractor to resolve issues.
  • Construction and Contract Compliance: Ensure construction activities are performed in accordance with contract, plans and applicable documents to include environmental, erosion and sediment controls, safety, traffic controls and EEO and DBE guidelines, regulations and permits. Ensure project compliance and quality requirements are met. Assist Project Inspector and Construction Manager with notifications to contractor of non-compliance issues and resolution through documentation. Ensure all materials are tested and approved for acceptance before use on project and proper documentation is in hand before payment. Oversee or perform materials testing.
  • Project Documentation: Track and maintain materials documentation for project. Maintain detailed DWRs and diaries and correlate to the contractor's scheduled construction activities so VDOT can track individual activities, resources, productivity and efficiencies. Assist in maintaining project files. Document all daily occurrences, meetings, and communications and correlate to contract documents to provide information on changes in the contractor's scope of work. Keep jobsite photos. Assist Project Inspector and Construction Manager with issuing quarterly CPEs for prime and each subcontractor working on project to allow VDOT to evaluate contractor's performance. Assist with closing out project. Maintain as-built drawings.
  • Project Oversight: Ensure assigned QC tasks are monitored and documented for contract compliance. Assist Project Inspector and Construction Manager in monitoring project schedule. Assist Project Inspector and Construction Manager in determining support equipment required to include obtaining equipment and returning it in its proper condition. Assist in maintaining all assigned work areas by keeping them clean and appropriate for use. May be assigned the role of Project Inspector for less complex contracts, working closely with the Construction Manager. May train and oversee the work of other inspectors and trainees assigned to a project.
  • Project Safety and Environmental Compliance: Ensure work zones are properly established and maintained. Ensure project employees and equipment are performing in compliance with safety practices and directives. title: Masters Thesis: Measurement-driven DSP Superoptimization
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

The Ericsson Many Core Architecture (EMCA) is an in-house developed ASIC architecture designed for computation in mobile networks. Among its components is a custom digital signal processor (DSP) core, for which we maintain a custom compiler. Applications running on the EMCA DSP have strict real-time constraints and limited hardware resources, making the performance and memory footprint of compiler-generated code very important.

Superoptimization takes fragments of the code being compiled and searches for the cheapest fragment that computes the same result. The candidates come from a search over possible programs, and a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver such as Z3 proves equivalence before one is accepted. A notable example is Souper, which works on LLVM Intermediate Representation (IR).

A previous thesis project adapted Souper to our tool chain and ran it offline over DSP application code. That work is the starting point for this project: a superoptimizer that already runs against our EMCA DSP target. One limiting factor in that project was the cost model, and this follow-up explores an alternative. Souper decides which fragment is cheapest from a table of fixed per-operation costs. Such a table can only guess, because the chosen fragment then passes through the rest of the compiler and is transformed further on its way to machine code. On a Very Long Instruction Word (VLIW) DSP, the gap is wide enough that Souper both accepts rewrites that are slower on the hardware and discards real improvements.

What you will do:

  1. Survey the state of the art in superoptimization.
  2. Use the compiler back-end as the cost model. Instead of scoring candidates using a static instruction-cost table, whose entries provide estimated costs for individual instructions, compile them for the target DSP and measure properties of the generated code. This allows the search to be guided by the compiler's own cycle and size estimates. Compiling every candidate makes the search considerably slower than using a table, so a central question is whether the better cost information is worth that price.
  3. Expand the set of DSP instructions the superoptimizer can reason about. Examples of native DSP operations are multiply-accumulate and bit-field operations, which the compiler exposes through intrinsics. This should enable the superoptimizer to discover efficient uses of DSP-specific instructions that are not represented by more general operations.
  4. Evaluate offline on production DSP code. The superoptimizer is a tool for compiler developers and is not meant to run inside the compiler, so the deliverable is a set of suggested optimizations to build into the production compiler. The evaluation will consider performance improvements and memory footprint reductions.


The project is hands-on: your work can directly influence our production compiler and DSP program performance. You will work with SMT-based reasoning about programs, target-specific compiler passes, a VLIW instruction set, and real hardware constraints.


The skills you bring:

This is a technically advanced thesis project suitable for:

  • Master’s student in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
  • You have experience in C/C++ and enjoy working with low-level programming, compilers, and assembly-level optimization.
  • You have (or are willing to develop) skills in LLVM development and formal methods.

Why join Ericsson?

At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

What happens once you apply?

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Entry Level- Front End Software Engineer (Onsite, Aberdeen MD)
description:
ENTRY-LEVEL FRONT END SOFTWARE ENGINEER

xG and Mixed Signal Product Development | Technical Services

About the opportunity

Fairwinds Technologies is continuously looking for curious, hands-on early-career engineers who want to build software that connects directly to real hardware and operational systems. In this role, you may support either our xG or Mixed Signal product development team, or technical-services contracts aligned with those product areas.

You will work alongside experienced software, RF, FPGA, DSP, systems, and test engineers to develop, integrate, automate, and troubleshoot embedded solutions. Assignments may span internal product development and customer-funded research, integration, test, demonstration, and field-support activities. This structure gives an entry-level engineer exposure to the full engineering lifecycle while contributing to products and capabilities that move from the lab toward operational use.

What you will do

  • Develop, integrate, debug, and maintain embedded software on Linux-based platforms, including Ubuntu and other embedded Linux distributions.
  • Write and test software in C and C++, with opportunities to use Python for automation, test tooling, data handling, and engineering utilities.
  • Bring up processors, development kits, carrier boards, microcontrollers, peripherals, and connected subsystems in close coordination with hardware engineers.
  • Support device control, monitoring, configuration, logging, health/status reporting, and web-based or API-driven management interfaces.
  • Integrate software with radios, modems, network interfaces, RF subsystems, FPGA-based signal-processing hardware, sensors, and edge devices.
  • Create automated test scripts, repeatable lab procedures, troubleshooting tools, and clear engineering documentation.
  • Participate in code reviews, configuration management, defect tracking, and continuous integration practices as the team expands its software development discipline.
  • Support laboratory and field testing, customer demonstrations, technical-service deliverables, and root-cause troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate across the xG and Mixed Signal teams and grow into increasing technical ownership as your skills develop.

Technology and mission areas

Depending on assignment, you may contribute in one or more of the following areas:

  • Embedded Linux platform integration, board bring-up, system services, networking, and management software.
  • xG wireless systems, including 5G, non-terrestrial networking, software-defined radio, tactical gateways, radio integration, and automated test infrastructure.
  • Mixed Signal products, including Global Link and EchoPhase-related capabilities, control and monitoring software, channel emulation, coherent combining, and FPGA/DSP hardware interfaces.
  • Ruggedized mission modules and edge systems that combine compute, network, radio, and RF functions.
  • Government-funded R&D and technical-services contracts involving integration, test, performance characterization, documentation, and field support.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, completed or expected before start date.
  • Academic, internship, personal-project, laboratory, or work experience programming in C or C++.
  • Basic familiarity with Linux through coursework, projects, labs, internships, or personal use.
  • Foundational understanding of computer architecture, digital interfaces, networking, operating systems, or embedded systems.
  • Ability to use structured problem solving, learn unfamiliar hardware and software, and document work clearly.
  • Ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary engineering environment and communicate respectfully with technical and non-technical teammates.
  • Ability to satisfy customer, site-access, export-control, and security requirements associated with assigned work.

Preferred, not required

  • Hands-on experience with a single-board computer, microcontroller, FPGA-connected processor, development kit, or custom electronics project.
  • Exposure to Python, Bash, Git, build systems, debuggers, serial consoles, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or network-analysis tools.
  • Familiarity with device drivers, boot processes, Linux services, containers, web services, REST APIs, or embedded user interfaces.
  • Coursework or project experience in wireless communications, RF systems, digital signal processing, software-defined radio, 5G/LTE, or computer networks.
  • Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or writing test procedures and technical reports.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: learn the assigned platform, development workflow, lab environment, and product or contract objectives; complete scoped tasks with mentoring.
  • First 6 months: independently develop and test small software features or automation tools; contribute useful documentation and troubleshooting results.
  • First year: own a defined embedded software component, integration activity, or test capability and become a dependable contributor across software and hardware boundaries.

Why join Fairwinds Technologies

  • Work on products and customer-funded R&D activities within the same technical domain, creating a direct connection between experimentation, productization, and operational support.
  • Gain broad exposure to embedded computing, networking, wireless systems, RF hardware, FPGA/DSP interfaces, laboratory integration, and field testing.
  • Learn from experienced multidisciplinary engineers while receiving meaningful, hands-on work early in your career.
  • Join a growing technology organization building repeatable product-development practices and expanding its xG and Mixed Signal portfolios.

How to apply

Submit your resume and, if available, links or short descriptions for relevant projects, code samples, lab work, capstone projects, internships, or technical portfolios. Tell us what you built, what you personally contributed, and what you learned while troubleshooting it.

Compensation- Salary

At Fairwinds, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location and experience. Additional incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full time, exempt position.

Work Authorization/Security Clearance:

Must be eligible to work in the US.

Fairwinds Technologies, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

title: Sr. Associate, Front End Developer
description:
About Us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

About Us

Appnovation is a global, full-service digital partner that combines Strategy, Experience & Design, Engineering and Managed Services. We build digital solutions that deliver real impact today and serve as foundations for future growth. Bold ambition. Practical action. Endless possibilities.

About The Role

As a Senior Frontend Developer, you will build the user-facing application for a modern operational SaaS platform for K-12 education. The platform helps school divisions automate administrative processes, manage information across their organization, and surface operational insight - which means the interfaces you build are workflow-driven and data-dense: multi-step forms with real validation consequences, long-running processes whose state the UI has to reflect honestly, role-sensitive views that change shape depending on who is looking, and reporting surfaces backed by real analytical queries.

This is product engineering rather than marketing site work. You will build in Next.js, React, and TypeScript against .NET REST APIs, using Shadcn/UI and Tailwind CSS in a component-driven model, and you will own Playwright end-to-end coverage for the flows you build. Authorization is enforced through Keycloak and OpenFGA, so the frontend has to handle OIDC flows and render correctly against fine-grained, policy-driven permissions in a multi-tenant product where an administrator in one school division must never see another's data.

You will work as part of a dedicated, cross-functional scrum team that operates as an embedded extension of the client's product and engineering organization. The team includes business analysis and QA capability and owns assigned product services end-to-end - from refinement through development, testing, documentation, and release readiness. You will work directly in the client's repositories and follow their established architecture, design system, and engineering standards. The platform is moving from pilot deployments toward general availability, so the work is real-user-facing from the start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Building and maintaining application features in Next.js, React, and TypeScript, including server-side rendering, routing, and state management decisions
  • Developing reusable, accessible components in a component-driven model using Shadcn/UI and Tailwind CSS, extending the existing design system rather than working around it
  • Integrating with .NET REST APIs, including handling loading, error, empty, and partial-failure states properly rather than assuming the happy path
  • Building interfaces that accurately reflect asynchronous and long-running backend processes, including in-progress, retrying, and failed states
  • Implementing authentication flows against Keycloak using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, and rendering conditionally against OpenFGA-driven permissions
  • Building data-dense reporting and analytics views over backend query results, with attention to performance at realistic data volumes
  • Writing and maintaining Playwright end-to-end coverage for the flows you build, and contributing to the shared test suite
  • Meeting WCAG 2.x Level AA, and treating accessibility as part of the build rather than a remediation pass
  • Producing implementation plans for significant changes, and delivering work in small, reviewable merge requests
  • Participating in code review, responding to CodeRabbit findings, and keeping GitLab CI/CD pipelines green
  • Participating in refinement, planning, review, and retrospective as a member of a self-directed scrum team, and raising missing business or UX decisions early
  • Maintaining frontend technical and component documentation as part of the definition of done, not after it
  • Resolving defects and supporting post-release stabilization of recently delivered functionality
  • Mentoring less experienced developers through code review and pairing

What we are looking for

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's Degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 6+ years of web development experience, having delivered production applications as part of a team
  • Strong command of React, including hooks, composition patterns, state management, routing, and server-side rendering
  • Production experience with Next.js, including App Router, rendering strategies, and data fetching patterns
  • Strong TypeScript skills - you use the type system to prevent defects, not to satisfy a linter
  • Expert knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3, and fluency with utility-first CSS (Tailwind CSS or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated experience building complex, stateful application interfaces - forms, workflows, dashboards - rather than primarily content or marketing sites
  • Experience consuming REST APIs, including error handling, retry behaviour, and designing UI around asynchronous operations
  • Experience building and maintaining component libraries or design systems, and working with design tokens and tools such as Storybook
  • Experience implementing authentication in a frontend application against an identity provider using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
  • Experience building role-or-permission-sensitive interfaces where what a user can see and do varies
  • Experience with end-to-end testing (Playwright preferred; Cypress considered), and an understanding of what makes automated tests durable - avoiding hard-coded waits, brittle selectors, shared test state, and environment-specific assumptions
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.x Level AA and practical accessible-component implementation
  • Strong understanding of frontend performance - bundle size, rendering cost, and behaviour at realistic data volumes
  • Comfortable working inside an existing codebase and an established set of engineering and design standards, rather than setting your own
  • Strong understanding of version control, CI/CD, and peer review through merge requests
  • Strong understanding of security and privacy by design principles
  • Experience working with agile delivery methodologies, including refinement, planning, review, and retrospective
  • Experience mentoring other developers
  • Must be located in British Columbia, Canada

Technologies

  • Core: Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
  • UI and Styling: Shadcn/UI, Tailwind CSS, component-driven development, design tokens, Storybook
  • Integration: REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger consumption
  • Identity and Authorization: Keycloak, OpenFGA, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, role-and-policy-based authorization in the UI
  • Testing: Playwright end-to-end testing, component and unit testing (Jest / Vitest, React Testing Library)
  • Accessibility: WCAG 2.x Level AA, semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard and screen reader support
  • Engineering and Collaboration: GitLab, GitLab CI/CD, CodeRabbit automated code review, Jira, Jira Product Discovery, Jira Service Management, Confluence
  • Backend context: C#, .NET Core, .NET APIs, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Temporal workflows, event-driven pub/sub

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with C# and .NET - enough to read backend code, trace an issue across the stack, and have a productive conversation about an API contract
  • Familiarity with fine-grained authorization models (OpenFGA, Zanzibar-style ReBAC)
  • Experience building analytics or reporting interfaces over large datasets, including data visualization
  • Experience with workflow-driven or long-running process UIs
  • SaaS product delivery experience, particularly through a pilot-to-GA transition
  • Experience with Canadian public-sector or education accessibility and data privacy requirements (AODA and provincial equivalents, PIPEDA, provincial FIPPA)
  • Experience with distributed tracing or frontend observability and error monitoring
  • PWA, service workers, and advanced performance optimization
  • Experience in a consulting or client-facing delivery environment

Who you are

  • You are a product-mind engineer who asks what the user is actually trying to accomplish before deciding how to build it.
  • You have experience in customer-facing roles and communicate clearly, including when something is off track.
  • You treat a feature as incomplete until it is tested, accessible, documented, and supportable - finishing the code is the middle of the job, not the end.

What Appnovation Offers

  • Challenging and rewarding work with real impact
  • Direct Access to Cutting-Edge AI Platforms
  • Diverse and Inclusive Culture
  • Growth opportunities for personal and professional development
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued
  • Exposure to exciting projects and high-profile clients
  • Supportive work environment with access to company leaders
  • Hybrid working model

Thank you for your interest in a career with Appnovation Technologies! Please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

At Appnovation, we recognize that diverse teams are the strongest teams. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is not only something that we embrace - we celebrate it! We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage applicants from all backgrounds, lived experiences and industries to apply. Come join us at Appnovation, and learn more about how we stay true to our company values as we build better lives through better digital.

Accommodations are available upon request throughout the recruitment process.

title: Front Office Associate
description:

title: Loan Operations Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
Job Title: Loan Operations Administrator (Part-Time)
Location: Baltimore, MD
Reports To: Loan Servicing Manager, VP
Department: Credit Administration
Type/Status: Part-Time / Non-Exempt (Salaried Hourly)

Position Overview:

The Loan Operations Administrator plays a pivotal role in driving our mission at The Harbor Bank of Maryland. This position is responsible for delivering exceptional service, supporting team development, and ensuring operational excellence. The loan operations administrator is responsible for performing a variety of duties related to loan processing and servicing of commercial, residential mortgage, and retail loans and escrow accounts, boarding all new loans onto the core system and maintenance of existing loans, customer billing and set-up and maintenance of loan ticklers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review daily system generated maintenance reports to validate the accuracy of the loan system records (including interest rate adjustments on adjustable-rate loans) and ensure related general ledger accounts are properly maintained.
  • Perform daily and monthly settlement and reconciliation of all loan related general ledger and checking accounts used for loan processing and escrows.
  • Read and interpret loan documents to validate the accuracy of loan booking packages and loan maintenance requests prior to boarding new loans onto core system and performing maintenance on existing loans.
  • Perform loan maintenance as necessary for renewal, extension and/or modification of existing loans and maintain the accuracy of the loan data in the core system.
  • Process loan payments, loan advances, loan payoffs and other transactions for all loans (active loans, charge-offs and non-accruals) in the core system including participation remittances, general ledger transactions, deferred fees, adjustments, fee processing and other changes.
  • Process escrow transactions, including the setup, review, analysis and disbursement of funds for all escrow accounts regarding taxes, insurance, ground rents, etc.; process and complete escrow account maintenance in core system.
  • Research and resolve routine inquiries from customers (internal and external) regarding loan balances, payments, escrow disbursements, etc. and process written requests for loan payoffs and account verifications in accordance with applicable laws, regulations and Bank policies.
  • Provide support for audits and compliance reviews by gathering data electronically, pulling loan files for scanning, if required.
  • Communicate with various insurance agencies to obtain renewals of existing insurance policies and initiate forced place insurance with the bank’s blanket insurance coverage, for any canceled policy.
  • Scanning of work process for upload into core system once transition has been completed and general filing of documents to be maintained in the loan operations department.
  • Process loan transactions for affiliate organizations as required.
  • Ensuring not to harm consumers with any act that could be misleading, unfair, deceptive, or abusive in act or practice.
  • Comply with all federal and state regulations and rules impacting this position, meet all risk and compliance obligations, including the completion of required training.


Skills and Abilities:

  • High level of interpersonal skills necessary to represent the bank positively in dealing with internal and external customers.
  • Well organized and attentive to detail with a high degree of accuracy. Able to assist and coordinate activities with others.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and prioritize tasks consistently throughout each day, with minimum direct supervision and good deal of autonomy.
  • Strong analytical skills necessary to understand various types of loan and general ledger transactions.
  • Experience with software applications including MS Office and ability to use PC, various software tools and other basic business equipment essential job functions.

description:

Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose

Lead and create processes to monitor, analyze, and report Cost Per Unit (CPU) data across the logistics network to support the overall Transportation cost and budget evaluations.   • Standardize and document Transportation CPU calculation processes and support cross-functional cost improvement initiatives

DevOps Developer DRA•Woodmead, Johannesburg Metro, South Africa

DevOps Developer

DRA Global is seeking an experienced DevOps Developer to join our Shared Services team based in Woodmead, Johannesburg.

Overview

We are expanding our Platform Engineering capability and invite applications for a skilled DevOps Developer to enhance software engineering practises organisation-wide. This pivotal role focuses on driving Agile and DevOps adoption throughout the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), with an emphasis on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), automation, software quality, security, governance, and scalable software delivery.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Platform Engineering, Business Systems, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other IT teams to enhance integrated software delivery.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and eliminate bottlenecks, manual hand-offs, and inefficiencies within the SDLC.
  • Incident Support: Support incident investigations, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement related to software releases and development platform services.
  • Citizen Development Governance: Support and govern citizen development through approved environments, reusable components, tooling, and engineering guidance.
  • Technology Evaluation: Assess emerging DevOps, AI, software development, and automation technologies for potential application within DRA Global.
  • Automation Enhancement: Increase automation across the SDLC and assist in translating engineering policies into measurable, automated controls.
  • Engineering Metrics: Support metrics related to deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, automated testing, code quality, pipeline adoption, and SDLC compliance.

Qualifications

  • BSc degree in Information Technology, Computing or a closely related field.

Experience

  • At least 5 years’ software development experience.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in MS SQL Server development.
  • A minimum of 4 years’ experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps and other CI/CD tools.
  • At least 4 years’ experience working within Microsoft development environments.

Knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, monitoring technologies and Microsoft Power Platform is desirable.

This is a technically hands-on position requiring an individual capable of working across software development, DevOps, platform engineering and governance functions.

The successful candidate will challenge inefficient development practises, introduce practical automation and engineering controls, and foster an environment where secure, scalable and maintainable software can be developed and deployed efficiently organisation-wide.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.

Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Design performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
Automation & Change Management:
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.


Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

description:

Mamoura British Academy is a British curriculum, mixed gender school until Year 8 and a girl’s only school from Year 9 onwards. It is located in a state of the art building in the heart of Abu Dhabi. We strive for excellence in all that we do through our high expectations and commitment to ensuring that we provide high quality learning opportunities for our students. Our vision is to be ‘a sustainable and innovative learning community, where we nurture all learners through our bespoke Mamoura British Academy DNA .’ This Mamoura Learner, Teacher and Values DNA is at the heart of the school community.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.

The successful candidates will be closely aligned with our core values and ethos and possess a genuine understanding and appreciation of the values of the region.

A. Qualities and attributes:

· A supportive and approachable team player who can collaborate effectively with others.

· A good communicator at all levels.

· A commitment to developing positive relationships with all members of the school community.

· A desire to be part of a school that strives for excellence in all that we do.

· Passion to instil awe and wonder to the learning of young students.

B. Leadership:

· Contribute to the whole school vision and the strategic direction of the school.

· Lead team and planning meetings to ensure that the team is well informed, organised and successful.

· Ensure that the learning opportunities for the children are innovative, purposeful and challenging across all curriculum areas.

· Promote the pastoral care and well-being of children within the year group by ensuring all systems and procedures are followed.

· Effectively line manage a team of teachers and teaching assistants to ensure they are performing successfully against the UAE Professional Teacher Standards.

· Contribute to the school’s Monitoring, Evaluating and Reporting processes and quality assure all aspects of provision within the year group to ensure we are consistently promoting high standards and expectations.

· Contribute to the school’s Professional Development cycle helping to upskill and share good practice amongst fellow teachers.

· Actively participate in the school’s bespoke Middle Leader training programme.

C. Teaching and learning:

· To be able to teach all areas of the Primary English National Curriculum.

· Organising the classroom, learning resources and creating displays to encourage a positive learning environment and support the development of the Mamoura British Academy USP in this area.

· Planning, preparing and presenting lessons that cater for the needs of the whole ability range within the class.

· Providing support and interventions for students with EAL or who have additional learning needs.

· Motivating pupils with enthusiastic, imaginative presentation.

· Evidencing children’s work and learning in line with the Mamoura British Academy Marking and Feedback policy.

· Being reflective of lessons taught and student progress, and adjusting planning, curriculum and continuous provision to reflect this.

· Meeting with other professionals such as speech and language therapists, occupational therapists and educational psychologists, if required.

· Ensuring that the Mamoura British Academy Teacher and Learner DNA language and attributes are being embedded throughout the curriculum.

· Contribute to the development of teaching and learning across the school by sharing best practice, participating in school CPD and T&L initiatives.

· To be able to demonstrate effective use of technology through innovative and creative lesson delivery and continuous provision.

D. Assessment and data:

· Taking responsibility for the attainment and progress of a class of children to ensure that they reach above expected expectations.

· Meeting the requirements for the assessment and recording of pupils' development using Learning Ladders.

· Using data provided by assessments to influence further planning and interventions.

· Providing regular feedback to parents and carers on a student’s progress at Parent Teacher Conferences and other meetings.

· To plan, prepare and contribute to termly Pupil Progress meetings.

E. Behaviour management and duties:

· To follow the Mamoura British Academy behaviour management policy and promote the TRACK Values to set high expectations.

title: Sociaal Psychiatrisch Verpleegkundige Gebiedsteam Lelystad West
description:
Zo werk jij

Voor wie jij er als sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige bent? Volwassenen met ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen, vaak in combinatie met problemen op meerdere levensgebieden. Je biedt behandeling en begeleiding zoveel mogelijk in de eigen leefomgeving van de cliënt. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de psychiatrische klachten alleen en betrek je het netwerk en andere professionals wanneer dat bijdraagt aan herstel.

Als SPV combineer je verpleegkundige en psychiatrische expertise met een brede sociaal-maatschappelijke blik. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, terwijl je altijd kunt terugvallen op de expertise van je multidisciplinaire team. Wat de functie van SPV binnen Gebiedsteam Lelystad West bijzonder maakt is:

  • zelfstandig uitvoeren en coördineren van ambulante behandeling en begeleiding, afgestemd op de doelen van de cliënt.

  • signaleren van veranderingen in het psychiatrisch toestandsbeeld en tijdig handelen bij dreigende ontregeling of crisis.

  • voeren van behandelgesprekken en inzetten van verpleegkundige en sociaalpsychiatrische interventies.

  • actief betrekken van naasten en het sociale netwerk en samenwerken met huisartsen, gemeenten en andere ketenpartners.

  • bijdragen aan behandelplannen en vanuit jouw SPV-expertise meedenken over de koers van de behandeling binnen het multidisciplinaire team.

Jouw team

Jouw nieuwe collega’s van Gebiedsteam Lelystad West kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten. Samen met jou als sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige bieden we specialistische ggz aan volwassenen die ondersteuning nodig hebben op verschillende gebieden van hun leven. We werken ambulant en herstelgericht en sluiten de behandeling zoveel mogelijk aan op de leefomgeving en mogelijkheden van de cliënt.

Wat ons team kenmerkt? De ruimte om zelfstandig te handelen en tegelijkertijd intensief multidisciplinair samen te werken. Je hebt korte lijnen met collega’s en regionale samenwerkingspartners en brengt vanuit jouw eigen expertise een belangrijk perspectief in de behandeling.

Jouw nieuwe werkplek? Lelystad, waarbij je zowel vanuit onze locatie als ambulant in de wijk werkt.

Wij zorgen voor jou

Werk dat ertoe doet en waar je van betekenis bent, dat is alvast onze eerste belofte. Omdat we een grote organisatie zijn met verschillende werklocaties kunnen we inspelen op ontwikkelwensen en voorkeuren qua functie-inhoud, type behandelprogramma en woon-werkafstand. We zien wie je bent en wat je kan. Als sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige bij GGz Centraal kun je in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.294,- (CAO GGZ, functiegroep 55) o.b.v. 36 uur.

  • een contract voor 24-36 uur per week voor onbepaalde tijd. We werken vanuit vertrouwen, dus je krijgt bij ons meteen een vast contract.

  • een eindejaarsuitkering en een vakantietoeslag van 8,33%.

  • 166 verlofuren en 35 levensfase-uren o.b.v. 36 uur. Zo willen we bijdragen aan een goede werk-privébalans.

  • de mogelijkheid om via de WKR fiscaalvriendelijk een (elektrische) fiets of extra vakantiedagen te kopen.

  • een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1.000,- naar rato. Dit budget kun je besteden aan iets waar jij blij van wordt. Denk aan een cursus, extra
    salaris of verlofuren, aan jou de keuze.

  • een lease fiets via Lease a Bike. Hiermee stimuleren we duurzaam en gezond woon-werkverkeer.

  • de ruimte om jezelf professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen via opleidingen en trainingen.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO GGZ. Heb je vragen? Laat het ons weten.

Dit breng je mee

Je bent een SPV die zelfstandig beslissingen durft te nemen en tegelijkertijd actief de samenwerking zoekt. Door je brede blik zie je niet alleen de psychiatrische problematiek, maar ook wat er speelt rondom wonen, relaties, werk, financiën en het sociale netwerk. Je kunt schakelen tussen geplande behandeling en situaties waarin snel handelen nodig is.

Ook heb je voor deze baan:

  • een afgeronde opleiding tot sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige.

  • een geldige BIG-registratie.

  • affiniteit met ambulante psychiatrie en de behandeling van volwassenen met complexe psychiatrische en sociaal-maatschappelijke problematiek.

  • het vermogen om methodisch en herstelgericht te werken en samen met de cliënt haalbare doelen te formuleren.

  • goede samenwerkingsvaardigheden om cliënten, naasten, collega's en ketenpartners met elkaar te verbinden.

Wie zijn wij?

Elk jaar rekenen zo’n 25.000 patiënten op ons als de specialist in geestelijke gezondheidszorg in midden Nederland. Vanuit verschillende locaties, binnen de thuissetting én online, bieden we specialistische hulp aan mensen met psychische problemen, in alle fasen van hun leven.

Ontdek meer over GGz Centraal als werkgever en over onze visie en missie.

In Flevoland bieden we specialistische ggz vanuit onder andere Almere, Lelystad, Dronten en de Noordoostpolder. Onze gebiedsteams brengen behandeling dichtbij de cliënt en werken samen met naasten en partners in de wijk. Zo verbinden we psychiatrische behandeling met wat iemand nodig heeft om zo zelfstandig mogelijk te functioneren en mee te doen in de samenleving.

Solliciteren

Wil je meer informatie over de vacature? Neem contact op met Andrea Heldoorn - van Beek, sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige, via 06 1030 3338 of Marcel Knijn, clustermanager, via 06 8327 6691.Voor overige vragen helpt de recruiter je graag verder op weg.

Kom je graag eerst sfeer proeven? Een dagdeel meelopen is mogelijk als onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Kom je bij ons werken, dan checken we standaard referenties en vragen we je om een actuele Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Natuurlijk vergoeden wij deze kosten.

title: Verkoper bijbaan
description:
Zoek jij een leerzame bijbaan waar je nieuwe vrienden maakt en in een hecht team werkt dat aanvoelt als familie? Kom werken bij BAUHAUS!

Als Verkoper bij BAUHAUS ben jij samen met je collega’s het gezicht van de afdeling. Je adviseert onze klanten en helpt hen bij het vinden van de juiste producten voor hun klus. Daarnaast leer je alles over ons brede assortiment, zorg je voor een nette afdeling en houd je je bezig met het bestellen van producten.

We zoeken verkopers voor onze afdelingen: Decoratief/verf/Elektra, IJzerwaren/Gereedschappen, Vloeren, Sanitair/Badkamerland, Drive-in/Grote Bouwmaterialen, Hout/bouwelementen en Stadstuin.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent 16 jaar of ouder.

  • Je vindt het geen probleem om af en toe op koopavonden of in het weekend te werken.

  • Je hebt goede communicatieve skills en je vindt het leuk om in contact te staan met klanten.

  • Je bent tot 12 uur per week beschikbaar.

Wat mag jij van ons verwachten?

  • 💰 Salaris: Vanaf 21 jaar een all-in uurloon vanaf €18,19 (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Door ervaring kan dit uiteraard hoger uitvallen! Ben je jonger dan 21? Dan start je met een uurloon tussen €9,02 en €18,05.

  • 💸 Extra toeslagen: Als je werkt in de avonden, zondagen en feestdagen.

  • 🕒 Flexibele werktijden: Wij vinden het belangrijk dat het werken bij BAUHAUS goed te combineren is met familie, vrienden, sport en studie.

  • 🚗 Reiskostenvergoeding: €0,23 per km (vanaf 10 km, max. 50 km enkele reis).

  • 🛍️ Personeelskorting: 10% korting op onze toch al aller laagste prijzen.

  • 🎉 Bonusregeling: Behalen wij ons resultaat? Dan ontvang je een extra bonus als dank voor jouw inzet!

  • 🚀 Ontwikkeling: BAUHAUS is een erkend leerbedrijf. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen door het volgen van diverse opleidingen en cursussen.

  • 🙂 Gezellige werksfeer: Je wordt onderdeel van de BAUHAUS familie met enorm leuke collega’s die elke dag voor elkaar klaar staan. Ook heb je de mogelijkheid tot deelname aan de personeelsvereniging met de leukste feestjes en uitjes!

Over BAUHAUS

BAUHAUS is een internationale doe-het-zelf retailer met meer dan 275 vestigingen in 19 landen. Sinds 2015 zijn we actief in Nederland en blijven we groeien. In 2027 openen we onze nieuwe vestiging in Amersfoort. BAUHAUS is een echt familiebedrijf. Bij BAUHAUS voelt iedereen, zowel collega’s als klanten, aan als familie. We staan voor elkaar klaar, helpen elkaar vooruit en zorgen samen voor een fijne sfeer. Word jij onderdeel van onze BAUHAUS familie?

Zie je het al voor je?

Kun jij niet wachten om de klanten met een glimlach en mooie producten de deur uit te laten gaan en denk je goed te passen binnen onze BAUHAUS familie? Dan zien wij graag jouw CV tegemoet. We kunnen niet wachten om jou te leren kennen!

- Een integriteitscontrole via het Waarschuwingsregister van de stichting Fraude Aanpak Detailhandel.

title: Quality & NDT Engineer
description:
ABOUT COMPANY

Agnikul Cosmos is a company incubated at IIT Madras and we build rockets that can take satellites up to 500 kg to Lower Earth Orbit (LEO). In May 2024, we successfully completed our maiden launch from our own launchpad (India's first private launchpad). The launch has proven all the new technologies developed by Agnikul and also earned recognition from Honourable Prime Minister of India.

We are looking for a hands-on Quality Engineer with experience in aerospace composites and metallic manufacturing, who can drive vendor quality, inspections, NDT, NCR/CAPA closure, and ensure suppliers consistently meet our quality standards.


RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Perform incoming inspection of composite and metallic raw materials to ensure compliance with specifications and quality requirements.
  • Ensure vendor-side in-process inspection activities for metallic and composite structures are carried out as per approved quality standards and process requirements.
  • Lead final quality inspection activities including:
    - Visual inspection
    - Dimensional inspection using gauges and CMM
    - Coordination of NDT activities such as Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
  • Coordinate and support NDT inspections and destructive testing activities to ensure product qualification and compliance with applicable standards and acceptance criteria.
  • Ensure compliance with engineering drawings, route cards, process documents, and acceptance criteria.
  • Handle supplier-side Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and closely coordinate with vendors to obtain corrective and preventive action (CAPA) closure within defined timelines.
  • Prepare Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), inspection scope documents, and quality-related reports.
  • Review vendor-submitted documents including:
    - Process plans
    - Inspection plans
    - Inspection reports
    - Manufacturing and quality records
  • Conduct supplier evaluation audits and supplier quality audits to ensure product and process quality compliance.
  • Maintain quality documentation and ensure complete traceability of materials, manufacturing, and inspection records.


Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of AS9100 Quality Management Systems
  • Strong knowledge of engineering drawings and GD&T interpretation.
  • Experience in CFRP composite manufacturing processes and metallic machining operations.
  • Experience in NDT inspection techniques (UT, DPT, RT, VT) and destructive testing of composite and metallic aerospace structures.
  • Experience in handling NCRs and CAPA follow-up activities.
  • Experience in supplier quality management and vendor coordination.
  • Familiarity with inspection tools, gauges, CMM, and quality documentation systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
  • NDT Level II Certified.
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
