title: Modular Autonomous Response System (MARS) FSE
description:
Modular Response System (MARS) Field Service Engineer


About OWT Global


Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Tampa, FL, OWT Global is an SBA Small Business delivering reliable, operationally proven expertise and mission-focused support to the U.S. Government, industry partners, and commercial clients. Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Tampa Bay Times from 2022–2026, OWT Global specializes in deployed Field Services, Engineering Support, RDT&E, Technical Program & Project Management, logistics, maintenance, training, and operational support for advanced technologies and mission systems across Unmanned Systems (UxS), Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (C5ISR), and Air Domain Awareness & Defense (ADAD) mission areas. Our unique services-first and vendor-agnostic approach provides customers with dedication, quality, flexibility, and reliability from a partner that prioritizes mission success above all else. OWT Global proudly supports the DoW SkillBridge Program, helping transitioning service members move into civilian careers. With a workforce comprised of more than 90% veterans from the very operational communities we support, our team brings unmatched mission understanding, operational experience, and technical expertise to every effort.


Position Overview


OWT Global is seeking a Field Service Engineer (FSE) to support the Modular Autonomous Response System (MARS) program at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, OH. The MARS FSE will provide operational, technical, training, integration, and sustainment support to Air Force organizations responsible for the continued development, maturation, fielding, and expansion of MARS capabilities.


The FSE will serve as an operational and technical Subject Matter Expert (SME), supporting the integration and employment of small Uncrewed Aerial Systems (sUAS), airspace management capabilities, communications systems, command-and-control technologies, Tactical Assault Kit (TAK), autonomy, and other technologies incorporated into the MARS architecture. This position requires an individual who can operate independently in a dynamic mission environment while effectively coordinating with Government leadership, operational users, technical organizations, program offices, and industry partners. Travel is approximately 20–30%.


Key Responsibilities


  • Serve as an operational and technical SME supporting MARS operations, integration, training, sustainment, and capability development.
  • Support the installation, configuration, integration, operation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and sustainment of MARS systems and associated technologies.
  • Provide technical and operational support for sUAS, TAK, communications, airspace management, autonomy, and related mission technologies.
  • Support the training and qualification of MARS operators, sUAS pilots, and other mission personnel.
  • Assist with the planning and execution of operational exercises, demonstrations, system testing, and technology evaluations.
  • Support MARS operations as required to address operational requirements and mission support needs.
  • Assist with the evaluation and integration of emerging technologies into the MARS architecture.
  • Identify technical, operational, integration, and sustainment issues and provide recommendations for resolution or mitigation.
  • Support the development and refinement of operational concepts, integration requirements, and future MARS capabilities.
  • Coordinate with Air Force organizations, installation personnel, program offices, research organizations, technical partners, and industry stakeholders.
  • Provide technical input and recommendations to Government leadership regarding system performance, operational readiness, capability gaps, technology integration, sustainment, and future requirements.
  • Support the expansion and fielding of MARS capabilities at additional Air Force locations.
  • Provide technical and operational support for activities associated with MARS cybersecurity and Authority to Operate (ATO) requirements, as needed.
  • Provide input to recurring program and operational reporting regarding activities, accomplishments, system status, identified issues, and upcoming milestones.
  • Support the development and delivery of training associated with MARS operations and employment, Tactical Assault Kit (TAK), Small Uncrewed Aerial Systems (sUAS), Counter-small Uncrewed Aerial Systems (C-sUAS), airspace management and UAS Traffic Management (UTM), communications and networking technologies, Full Motion Video (FMV) operations, advanced sUAS operator training, and autonomous and remotely operated mission systems.
  • Participate in operational exercises, developmental testing, technology demonstrations, and research and development activities supporting continued maturation of MARS capabilities.


Required Qualifications


  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex technical or operational systems in a military, Department of War, Federal Government, or similar mission environment.
  • Experience with one or more of the following mission areas: Small Uncrewed Aerial Systems (sUAS), Counter-small Uncrewed Aerial Systems (C-sUAS), Tactical Assault Kit (TAK), airspace management, command-and-control systems, communications and networking systems, autonomous or remotely operated systems, or C5ISR systems.
  • Experience installing, integrating, configuring, operating, troubleshooting, or sustaining technical systems.

title: Chauffeur CE (semi dieplader)
description:
Bij Burgers Verhuur bereik je meer!
Meer vrijheid, meer vertrouwen en meer plezier in je werk.

Als Chauffeur CE rijd je elke dag met je eigen, vaste combinatie. Je hebt oog voor techniek en maakt het verschil bij onze klanten. We leveren onze hoogwerkers, verreikers en heftrucks in heel Nederland en België. Dit is een fulltime functie. Benieuwd hoe dat eruitziet? Lees verder.

Waarom chauffeur worden bij Burgers Verhuur?

  • Eigen, vaste combinatie: je rijdt met je eigen trekker-oplegger (semi-dieplader). Geen gespring tussen voertuigen, want je bent zelf verantwoordelijk voor je eigen materieel.

  • Meer dan kilometers maken: je bent betrokken bij het laden, lossen en zekeren van onze bouwmachines. Techniek, verantwoordelijkheid en variatie horen bij jouw werk.

  • Weinig wachttijd: we laden en lossen efficiënt, dus je staat niet uren te wachten op bouwplaatsen of distributiecentra. Je bent altijd in beweging.

  • Goed materieel: onze voertuigen en machines zijn modern en goed onderhouden. Zie je iets wat beter kan? Zeg het gewoon, dan doen we er wat mee.

  • Toekomstperspectief: rijd je nu als ZZP'er? Dan bieden we je een stabiele en zekere toekomst met groeimogelijkheden.

Het mooiste aan het werk van een chauffeur bij Burgers Verhuur?
"Spelen met machines, puzzelen tot alles past en overal kunnen komen." Jean-Pierre, chauffeur bij Burgers Verhuur.



Een dag als chauffeur bij Burgers Verhuur

Je start je dag vroeg met een kop koffie en een praatje met je collega's, want de eerste machines moeten vaak voor 7.00 uur op locatie zijn. Je combinatie staat voorgeladen klaar, zoals je gisteren samen met de logistiek medewerker hebt voorbereid, dus je kunt direct op pad. Even een korte check en je vertrekt naar je eerste adres. Op de bouwplaats los je de machines op de juiste plek, laad je andere machines terug en voer je een eerste controle uit. Daar komt je technisch inzicht van pas. Dan rijd je door naar de volgende adressen. Aan het eind van de dag parkeer je je combinatie netjes en laad je hem samen met de logistiek medewerker weer voor, zodat hij de volgende ochtend klaarstaat.

Waarom werken bij Burgers Verhuur?

Bij Burgers Verhuur draait het om mensen: betrokken, nuchter en met plezier in het werk. We zijn trots op wat we doen en werken elke dag met dezelfde energie als onze klanten. Ons familiebedrijf in Tilburg groeit, dus we gaan verhuizen naar een nieuw pand in Tilburg om die groei bij te benen.

  • Teamgevoel: je werkt samen met collega's die net zo gedreven en loyaal zijn als jij.

  • Vrijheid en vertrouwen: je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken. Wij vertrouwen op jouw vakmanschap.

  • Korte lijnen: direct contact met planning, werkplaats en collega's. Geen gedoe, gewoon duidelijkheid.

  • Afspraak is afspraak: klanten rekenen op ons omdat we doen wat we beloven.

Samen zorgen we dat klanten meer bereiken, en dat geldt ook voor jou.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Je hebt rijbewijs CE en Code 95, en je weet hoe je veilig en soepel de weg op gaat.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor techniek en houdt je wagen en materiaal in topconditie.

  • Je denkt in oplossingen en houdt het praktisch.

  • In drukke situaties blijf je kalm en in controle.

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en overlegt makkelijk met collega's en klanten.

  • Ervaring met het laden en lossen van groot materieel is een grote pré.

  • Ervaring in de verhuur is ook mooi meegenomen.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een fulltime functie (40 uur) met een eigen, vaste trekker-oplegger.

  • Een salaris tot € 3.800,- per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Kwaliteit telt, en dat belonen we.

  • Een vaste koffievergoeding.

  • Werktijden overdag, zonder nacht- of weekenddiensten, zodat werk en privé in balans blijven. Overuren worden in principe uitbetaald, met de mogelijkheid om TVT-uren op te bouwen.

  • Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Grote variatie in ritten en klanten in Nederland en België.

  • Onderhoud van je Code 95 en opleidingsmogelijkheden.

  • Tot 27 vakantiedagen per jaar.

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling via ASR met een hoge werkgeversbijdrage.

  • Gezelligheid op z'n Brabants: bouwvakbarbecue, personeelsuitjes en kerstborrel.

Solliciteren op de functie van Chauffeur CE

Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Bel 06 30 23 34 42 of mail naar nick.hoffmans@burgersverhuur.nl. Zie jij jezelf als Chauffeur CE bij Burgers Verhuur? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatieknop!

Bij Burgers Verhuur bereik je meer! Ook in jouw volgende stap.

Voor recruiters: Wij trachten deze vacature zelf in te vullen. Ben je echter overtuigd dat jij de geschikte kandidaat in huis hebt? Neem dan vooral contact met ons op. Wordt het niks, dan vragen wij een donatie van €100,- per kandidaat t.b.v. de Voedselbank in Tilburg.

title: Partnerships Lead, Beneficial Deployments
description:
OpenEvidence is the most widely used medical AI platform in the world.

In just over a year, our usage has grown to >65% of US clinicians via product-led word of mouth adoption. We are a $12B company with a 30 person engineering team from MIT, Harvard, and Stanford. We believe world-changing products come from a small group of exceptional, autonomous builders, organized along focused objectives and empowered to take individual ownership and run fast. We are now bringing OpenEvidence to the clinicians and health workers who need it most: those working in low- and middle-income countries, in low-connectivity and resource-constrained settings, where access to high-quality medical expertise is scarcest and the stakes are highest. If you are a world-class operator in global health who wants to put the best medical AI in the world into the hands of the people delivering care where it is hardest to deliver, we want to talk.

Culture

We believe work is something that should be engaged with at a world-class level. Building 0->1 and scaling 1->1000 are professional sports, and uncompromising excellence is the bar. We believe building things that haven't existed is only possible with end to end ownership. We don't have separate program managers or account teams; you are responsible for landing flagship deployments and demonstrating their impact. Important things are accomplished when an individual decides to accomplish them.

We believe that work should be hard. We believe good work is precise and intentional. Doing something a certain way just because that's how others have done it before guarantees mediocrity. We believe the quality of the product is paramount and the smallest details matter most, including in a rural clinic with intermittent connectivity. At the same time, velocity is essential. The best operators know how to jump right to the hardest part of the problem and build an intuitive experience for health workers. We believe your job is to complete and announce important deployments and demonstrate their impact.

Who are you?

If you are looking to manage a portfolio of partnerships that someone else assembled, this job is not for you. If you are looking to write reports and attend convenings, this job is not for you. If you are looking to lean in and get your hands dirty, bruised, and bloody building a global health program from nothing, personally put OpenEvidence in the hands of health workers across the Global South, and impact hundreds of millions of lives, this job might be for you.

The ideal candidate is a brilliant builder with deep roots in global health. They are smart, ambitious, scrappy, autonomous, precise, motivated, hard-working, and low-ego. They have 10+ years in global health, international development, or related fields, 5+ years managing external partnerships, grantmaking, or multi-stakeholder initiatives, and they have built programs or organizations from scratch. They know the key players at the major NGOs, foundations, and ministries of health, and those people take their calls. Does that sound rare? It is rare, and we would like to find them.

The role

You will be the primary relationship owner for our flagship global health deployments, working with governments, international NGOs, foundations, and innovators strengthening care in low-resource settings. You will grow the partnerships we have, identify and onboard the ones we need, and translate partners' clinical and operational needs into deployment plans that actually work in low-connectivity, low-bandwidth, and offline environments. You will bring on-the-ground insight back to the product, clinical, and research teams and use it to make OpenEvidence best-in-class for global health, including in local languages. You will run structured programs such as accelerators and cohort-based engagements, support funder and ecosystem engagement to sustain the work, and set a research agenda for measuring OpenEvidence's impact on health outcomes in low-resource settings, partnering with external organizations to study efficacy. You will represent OpenEvidence at global health convenings, help shape how the team works as it scales, and spend roughly 25% of your time at partner sites across the Global South.

Skillsets

Specific skillsets are secondary to the builder profile above, but some important spikes for different facets of this work are:

Global health relationships

  • You have deep credibility in the global health ecosystem. You have worked directly with organizations in low- and middle-income countries and have a nuanced understanding of what deployment actually looks like in low-connectivity, low-resource environments.

  • You may have language skills relevant to Sub-Saharan Africa, or Latin America, or a background in clinical or public health settings.

Technical fluency

  • You can engage credibly on AI concepts, understand what LLMs can and cannot do, and partner effectively with engineers and scientists. You might come from a healthtech company, an AI organization, or a product-adjacent role.

Programs and funders

  • You have built and run structured programs from scratch, likely at a startup or in a founding role, and you have worked with philanthropic foundations on global health initiatives.

  • You are comfortable managing a high volume of partnerships and opportunities and ruthless about prioritizing among them.

Impact and evidence

  • You have an analytical mindset and use data to inform strategy and measure impact. Evaluation and quantitative proof are tools you constantly seek to deploy.

  • You are familiar with global health research and evidence-based interventions, and you want to prove, not assert, that OpenEvidence improves outcomes.

We work in-person in Miami and SF, and this role travels extensively (~25%) to partner sites across the Global South. We believe in creating an environment that optimizes for focus and productivity, including providing meals, transport, and anything else you need to move quickly.

Argenta is currently looking to fill the role of Production Scheduler for our Shawnee, KS site.
This role translates the site's Master Production Schedule (MPS) into a detailed, executable production schedule — generating and sequencing work orders so that Argenta's Shawnee manufacturing operations run efficiently, on time, and in compliance with GMP requirements. Working closely with the Customer Supply Planner and shop floor management, this role balances capacity, materials, and labor to minimize downtime, resolve day-to-day scheduling conflicts, and keep production aligned with customer commitments.



Key Responsibilities:



  • Generate and release Work Orders in SAP/ERP, ensuring the correct Process Instructions and Batch Records are issued to Production, Packaging, and Warehouse teams in line with the Master Production Schedule.
  • Develop and maintain the detailed daily/weekly production schedule, sequencing work orders in line with SIOP capacity planning and the 18-month MPS maintained by the Customer Supply Planner.
  • Coordinate with Production and shop floor management to align schedules with equipment availability, labor capacity, and changeover/cleaning requirements.
  • Monitor production progress against schedule, proactively identifying and communicating risks, delays, material shortages, or priority changes.
  • Adjust and re-sequence schedules in response to constraints, escalating significant capacity or supply issues to the Customer Supply Planner and site leadership.
  • Ensure Materials Requirements Planning (MRP) parameters are accurate and that raw materials, components, and packaging are available to support the production schedule; flag shortages to the Customer Supply Planner and Procurement.
  • Run “what-if” scenarios to optimize the production schedule from both a manufacturing and supply chain perspective.
  • Communicate schedule changes clearly and promptly to Production, Quality, Warehouse/Logistics, and Procurement.
  • Track and report schedule-related KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, utilization) and support root-cause analysis of schedule misses.
  • Identify bottlenecks in the production process and recommend workflow or process improvements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and enhancements to planning systems and processes, including performing system checks, tests, and developing reports.
  • Comply with all Argenta company, local, and global policies, including cGMP requirements.



About You:



  • High school diploma (or equivalent) required. Bachelors degree Business, Supply Chain & Logistics, or a related field is preferred.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years’ relevant experience in production scheduling, planning, or production supervision within a manufacturing environment; pharmaceutical/GMP experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of SAP or similar ERP/MRP systems.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and administrative abilities.
  • Thorough attention to detail, without losing sight of the big picture.
  • Ability to set priorities and manage multiple tasks, working accurately and within strict deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable coordinating across Production, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Determination to see jobs through to completion.

title: Director, Deposit and Digital Operations - Harrisburg or Halifax
description:
A great company begins with a great team! Mid Penn Bank is actively seeking a Director of Deposit and Digital Operations to join our team in Harrisburg or Halifax, PA.

We believe that our ongoing success depends upon a skilled, satisfied, and valued work force. As a member of our team, you can expect opportunities to develop your skills to help you excel in your role and achieve your professional career goals. We offer a comprehensive range of flexible benefits to support your personal and financial well-being. Our inclusive culture encourages all employees to share ideas, collaborate, and contribute to the values that make us a winning team for our customers, shareholders, and communities.

Position Overview

The Director manages and leads the organization’s Deposit and Digital Operations functions. This position is responsible for ensuring efficient, consistent, and high-quality delivery of customer service and operational support while maintaining strong internal controls, regulatory compliance, risk management practices, and adherence to policies and procedures. The Director of Deposit and Digital Operations identifies opportunities to improve processes and the customer experience, and works collaboratively with Retail Banking, Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other business units to strengthen operational effectiveness and mitigate risk, while supporting the company’s overall growth and service goals.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provides leadership and oversight of the organization’s deposit operations and digital banking operations departments, ensuring efficient operations and a high level of customer service.
  • Oversees operational processes related to deposit accounts, account maintenance, transaction processing, electronic banking, online and mobile banking, debit card services, and other banking services, as applicable.
  • Monitors operational performance through established service-level agreements, key performance indicators, productivity measures, error rates, exception volumes, and other metrics.
  • Develops and maintains effective procedures, workflows, and internal controls to promote consistency, efficiency, accuracy, and a high level of customer service.
  • Evaluates operational processes and identifies opportunities to automate, streamline, or otherwise improve processes while maintaining appropriate risk controls.
  • Partners with Information Technology and third-party providers to support the implementation, enhancement, testing, and ongoing administration of deposit and digital banking systems. Partners with Compliance, Risk Management, Internal Audit, Information Security, and other control functions to address findings, regulatory requirements, and operational risk and fraud concerns.
  • Provides operational leadership for system implementations, product enhancements, conversions, upgrades, and other technology initiatives affecting deposit or digital operations.
  • Participates in user acceptance testing, process validation, issue resolution, and implementation planning for new or enhances products and systems.
  • Oversees the investigation and resolution of operational issues, transaction exceptions, customer-impacting errors, system issues, and service disruptions.
  • Maintains awareness of emerging digital banking technologies, fraud trends, and industry practices that may affect the bank’s operational environment.
  • Serves as an operations leader during mergers and acquisitions, contributing expertise in operational areas.
  • Ensures operational activities comply with applicable banking laws and regulations, internal policies, procedures, and established risk controls.
  • Assists in the development, testing, and maintenance of business continuity and disaster recovery procedures for deposit and digital operations.
  • Serves as a key contributor during exams, audits, and risk assessments.
  • Oversees vendor relationships for Deposit and Digital Operations.
  • Demonstrates high standards of integrity, honesty, and fairness.
  • Communicates expectations and provides feedback to ensure the best results; creates an atmosphere where communication is encouraged.
  • Performs tasks, which are supportive in nature to the essential functions of the job, but which may be altered or re-designed depending upon individual circumstances.
  • Regular and predictable attendance is required.

Education & Qualifications

  • A B.S. or B.A. degree in related field of study normally required.
  • A minimum of seven (7) to ten (10) years' experience in related positions is normally required.
  • Experience in banking operations, deposit operations, digital/electronic banking, or a relational operational discipline strongly preferred.

Skill(s)

Proficient reading, writing, grammar, and mathematics skills; proficient interpersonal relations and communicative skills; advanced knowledge of operational controls, audit processes, risk management practices, and banking regulations; experience with banking technology platforms, digital banking systems, core processing systems, or related operational technologies; strong knowledge of deposit products, banking operations, and electronic banking; strong analytical , problem-solving, and decision-making skills; ability to analyze operational data and identify trends, control weaknesses, and opportunities for improvement; proficient computer skills; demonstrated management and supervisory skills: ability to sit, stand, walk, bend, stoop, reach with hands or arms, use hands to manipulate objects, handle or feel, and lift items weighing 20 lbs. or less; visual, auditory, and speaking skills.

Pay Transparency

We set standard salary ranges for our roles based on the position, function, and responsibilities, as benchmarked against similarly sized companies in our industry. Specific compensation offered will be determined based on a combination of factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. The salary range may vary based on geographic location.

Benefits

Mid Penn Bank offers a comprehensive benefits package to those who qualify. This includes medical plans with prescription drug coverage; flexible spending account, dental and vision insurance; life insurance; 401(k) program with employer match and employee stock purchase plan; paid time off, paid holidays; disability insurance coverage, parental leave; employee assistance program, and tuition reimbursement.

In addition, all employees are eligible to participate in mentorship programs, receive individualized development and career counseling, and participate in Mid Penn University courses and development programs.

EEO Statement

Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, genetic information, pregnancy, disability, or protected veteran status. We also comply with all applicable laws governing employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of any unlawful criteria.

Equal Opportunity Employer–Minorities/Females/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

Sponsorship Statement

As a condition of employment, individuals must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship for a work visa by Mid Penn Bank currently or in the future.

title: Wholesale Parts Representative
description:
Central Florida Toyota, a Penske Automotive Group dealership, is looking for an experienced Parts Counter Representative to join our team and help deliver extraordinary customer experiences.

JOIN OUR TEAM

At Penske Automotive Group (PAG), we strive to create a positive and challenging workplace that promotes excellence and achievement, and we aim to deliver the very best experience possible to our customers. We are looking for dedicated and motivated professionals who share that same passion to join our team.

Imagine working in a professionally and financially satisfying job where you have the opportunity to make a positive impact on our organization and customers every day. As a Parts Counter Representative, you'll support both retail and wholesale customers, as well as service technicians, by ensuring timely and accurate delivery of parts--contributing to customer satisfaction and smooth operations.

WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER

  • Fortune 500 company, consistently recognized by Automotive News as among the "Best Dealerships to Work For."

title: IOS Engineer
description:
Join our team at the Guardian and be a part of a diverse and inclusive global organisation that delivers fearless, investigative journalism and holds power to account. Our team of award-winning journalists, cutting-edge commercial professionals and industry-leading digital experts are committed to making a difference and represent a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives. We offer a challenging and exciting environment for career development, with a focus on training, growth and fostering an inclusive culture.

We are now looking for an iOS Engineer to join our Apps Experience team. We build the Guardian iOS app primarily in Swift. With 4.8+ star reviews, one of the UK's top 12 news apps on the App Store, and handpicked by Apple's editorial team for its Editor's Choice collection, we're trusted by millions of readers to deliver a fast, reliable and accessible experience.

As an iOS Engineer you'll build and maintain features, taking ownership of the delivery of appropriately scoped pieces of work from design through to release with the support of your team.

About the role

  • You'll be building and testing major new features, as well as improving and maintaining existing functionality.
  • Our programming language of choice is Swift, and we now build all new features exclusively using SwiftUI, but you'll occasionally work with legacy code in Objective-C.
  • You won't be coding in isolation - our culture is strongly collaborative, whether pair programming with other developers or working closely with designers, editorial and commercial colleagues.
  • Sometimes deciding what code to write is as hard as writing the code itself. As an engineer you'll be involved in product decisions as well as technical ones.
  • You’ll be reviewing the code of other engineers to ensure we maintain our app's high standard.
  • You’ll contribute to technical discussions and help evolve our architecture and engineering practices
  • You’llcollaborate closely with product managers, designers and fellow engineers to deliver high-quality user experiences
  • You’ll strive to be innovative on a daily basis, as well as at our regular hack days. For example, a recent hack day saw the iOS team develop a new home screen widget using SwiftUI, which has now been shipped to the App Store.

About you

  • Experience developing iOS applications in Swift, with a good understanding of modern iOS development using SwiftUI and UIKit and Apple's core frameworks.
  • The ability to independently deliver well-scoped features, producing high-quality, maintainable code and taking responsibility for your work from development through to release.
  • An understanding of software design principles and a willingness to contribute to architectural discussions, learning from and collaborating with more experienced engineers on complex technical challenges.
  • A collaborative approach to working with product managers, designers and fellow engineers, communicating effectively and contributing positively to the team's success.
  • Curiosity and a desire to continually develop your technical skills, improve the developer experience, and contribute ideas that enhance our products and ways of working.
  • An appreciation for cross-functional collaboration, enjoying working with Android and backend engineers to deliver a consistent experience across platforms. Familiarity with Kotlin for Android, or Scala and Typescript for server side development is useful, but not essential.

We actively encourage applications from groups traditionally underrepresented in the UK media

Our engineers and developers operate in a hybrid environment working 1 day a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 4 days a week remotely.

We strive for salary transparency wherever possible. The salary band for new iOS Developers starts at £62,000 per annum.

We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

The closing date for applications is Friday 25th September 2026.

Benefits at the Guardian

You’ll have 30 days of annual leave per year (plus bank holidays) with the option to purchase an additional 5 days. Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.

You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.

We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

Culture and wellbeing

We want everyone to feel like they belong at the Guardian and we champion diversity of thought. Our various employee forums provide a platform to use their voice to foster an inclusive workplace. We became the first major media organisation to achieve B Corp status.

We offer tools to help you prioritise your wellbeing including access to our employee benefits platform which provides tailored support for health and wellbeing. In addition, we also offer free yoga and pilates classes. These run alongside our corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.

Our canteen has views overlooking the Regents Canal and caters for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

Learning and development

We encourage personal and professional growth. Employees have access to a broad range of tools and solutions, and we are happy to support the pursuit of professional qualifications through vocational courses and apprenticeships.

title: Program Manager
description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role supports our Defense Systems business, bringing together Hypersonics, Strategic Missile Defense, Tactical Missiles, and Integrated Defense Systems. Modern defense missions demand more than piecemeal parts or patchwork products; they require hardware that seamlessly integrates disparate technologies into a unified system. Backed by decades of flight-proven performance, our teams deliver tailored mission-ready solutions across air, land, and sea, including: launch and deployment systems, propulsion, payload protection, integration and deployment.

In this role, you will lead defense programs through planning, development, qualification, production, and delivery. You will develop integrated program plans, manage performance against cost and schedule, coordinate cross-functional execution, and serve as a primary interface with customers and internal stakeholders. Your work ensures the successful delivery of mission-critical missile, propulsion, launch, payload, and defense-system hardware.

Schedule

  • This role follows a 9/80 schedule, with 9-hour shifts Monday through Thursday, an 8-hour shift every other Friday, and the alternating Friday off.

Responsibilities

  • Leads assigned programs through planning, development, qualification, production, delivery, and contract completion.
  • Owns performance against cost, schedule, technical, quality, contractual, and customer objectives.
  • Develops and maintains integrated program plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, resource requirements, and performance metrics.
  • Coordinates cross-functional execution across engineering, operations, quality, supply chain, contracts, finance, and test.
  • Serves as a primary program interface for customers, prime contractors, government stakeholders, suppliers, and internal leadership.
  • Identifies technical, programmatic, supply-chain, cost, and schedule risks and drives mitigation and recovery plans.
  • Leads recurring program reviews and communicates financial performance, risks, decisions, dependencies, and corrective actions.
  • Supports design reviews, test‑readiness reviews, qualification activities, production‑readiness reviews, and customer acceptance events.
  • Manages contractual deliverables, statements of work, program changes, customer requests, and scope changes.
  • Supports proposals, estimates, contract negotiations, follow‑on opportunities, and program‑growth activities.
  • Performs other related duties as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business program management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience supporting or managing aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex technical programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in a related technical field or a Master of Business Administration (MBA).
  • Experience managing Department of Defense, U.S. government, allied‑defense, or prime‑contractor programs.
  • Experience with missile systems, propulsion, launch systems, payload integration, separation systems, energetic devices, or related flight hardware.
  • Experience managing programs from development through qualification and production.
  • Knowledge of government contracting and fixed‑price, cost‑reimbursable, or incentive‑based contract structures.
  • Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM), cost‑account management, or similar financial‑performance methods.
  • Experience supporting proposals, estimates, negotiations, contract modifications, or follow‑on program capture.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent formal program‑management training.
  • Experience with program scheduling, enterprise resource planning (ERP), or product‑lifecycle management (PLM) systems.
  • Experience leading engineering teams to develop mechanical and pyrotechnic components and systems.

This position requires U.S. person status under U.S. export control laws, including U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance
  • Short‑ and long‑term disability coverage
  • Tuition reimbursement

Karman Space and Defense is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Experience Designer
description:
THE ROLE

Biglight's Experience Designers help organisations solve complex customer and business challenges through research, strategy and design. From shaping journeys and defining product experiences to creating wireframes, prototypes and service concepts, we turn insight into solutions that deliver measurable impact.

Our Experience Design team brings together UX, research and strategy specialists who care deeply about creating products and services that work for both customers and businesses. We collaborate across disciplines to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes for some of the world's leading brands.

As a Senior Experience Designer, you'll play a key role in translating customer insight into products, services and experiences. You'll lead research and design activities, own significant workstreams, facilitate workshops and work directly with clients to shape decisions and drive progress.

Using user-centred design methods, you'll balance customer, business and delivery needs to create experiences that are intuitive, effective and commercially valuable.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Work on complex, high-impact projects

You'll work closely with clients across a range of transformation initiatives, owning key workstreams from discovery through to delivery. Whether facilitating workshops, shaping UX or influencing stakeholder decisions, you'll play a central role in delivering meaningful outcomes.

See your ideas come to life

At Biglight, your work will have real, measurable impact. You'll help shape products, services and experiences that drive value for our clients, turning insight into solutions that improve customer outcomes and support business goals.

Grow with us

You'll continue to deepen your expertise across research, UX design and strategy, working alongside experienced practitioners on complex challenges. You'll have opportunities to mentor more junior team members and take increasing ownership of client relationships and project delivery.

SKILLS WE ADMIRE

Curious and insightful

You love uncovering the behaviours, motivations and needs that drive great experiences, and can translate complex insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

Strong opinions, loosely held

You bring confidence and expertise to discussions, presenting your thinking clearly and influencing clients and stakeholders while remaining open to challenge and new perspectives.

Collaborative and creative

You enjoy working across disciplines to solve complex problems and create meaningful experiences. You're an excellent communicator who understands that great design is as much about clarity and storytelling as it is about interaction and visuals.

Organised and self-motivated

You can navigate ambiguity, make informed decisions and turn loosely defined problems into actionable work. You bring critical thinking and a proactive approach to moving work forward.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Planning and conducting user research

  • Determine when research is needed and plan and deliver the most appropriate approach, including customer interviews, usability testing, surveys and stakeholder discovery sessions.
  • Analyse qual/quantitative data to uncover needs, behaviours, pain points and opportunities.
  • Translate research findings into clear insights and recommendations that inform product, service and experience decisions.

Experience and service design

  • Create UX design deliverables including user flows, wireframes, customer journey maps, service blueprints, prototypes and A/B test approaches.
  • Combine customer research, data and business insight to identify opportunities and shape effective, commercially valuable experiences, whether optimising journeys or shaping entirely new propositions and services, recommending pragmatic MVP solutions where appropriate.
  • Champion user-centred principles, working closely with product and development teams to navigate technical and operational constraints and ensure successful implementation.

Client collaboration

  • Lead workshops, client discussions and design reviews, confidently presenting your design recommendations and facilitating decision-making.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders and embed customer-centred thinking.
  • In some engagements, act as a UX leader within a dedicated client account, helping shape priorities and delivery direction.

Strategic thinking

  • Translate insight into practical solutions, experience strategies and service improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve products, services and customer journeys, helping clients frame problems, prioritise opportunities and connect user needs with business outcomes, even when the solution extends beyond digital experiences alone.
  • Contribute to the development of product roadmaps and transformation plans.

Team collaboration and development

  • Work closely with colleagues across strategy, design and development disciplines to deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Provide guidance and constructive feedback to Associate and Midweight Experience Designers, helping to maintain quality and consistency across UX deliverables.
  • Support the development of junior team members through coaching, collaboration and sharing best practice.

Requirements

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • 5+ years' experience, with a portfolio demonstrating expertise across user research, UX and service design, and evidence of delivering measurable outcomes for clients.
  • Proven ability to plan and lead research activities, facilitate workshops and translate insight into effective product, service and UX solutions.
  • Strong experience using tools such as Figma, Miro and other digital collaboration platforms.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present recommendations and influence decision-making at multiple levels.
  • Collaborative and commercially aware, with the ability to balance customer needs, business objectives and delivery realities.
  • Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities and driving workstreams forward with minimal oversight.
  • Experience supporting and mentoring junior team members, helping to maintain quality and consistency across project delivery.

Why Biglight?

Biglight is an experience design agency focused on helping leading B2C and B2B brands create remarkable customer experiences that drive commercial impact.

We combine UX, design, insight, and experimentation to unlock new value for our clients — including organisations like The North Face, George @ ASDA, M&S and Booker Cash N Carry.

We are a people business, powered by talented specialists who want to make a difference. We hire the best people, regardless of background, and create an environment where they can grow while delivering exceptional work for our clients.

Read more about us at

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity pay
  • Access to Perkbox employee benefits platform
  • Hybrid office/home working
  • Regular business updates and company socials
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development
  • 25 days annual leave
  • Being part of a dynamic, fast-paced agency environment
  • Working with a team of incredibly talented professional colleagues

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their authentic selves.

description:

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across data pipelines and reporting systems.

What You'll Do:

  • Own and maintain data pipelines and GCP infrastructure.

  • Build data pipelines and integrate new data sources into the data warehouse.

Business Intelligence & Analytics

  • Build Tableau dashboards from the ground up.

This is an opportunity to own a critical function rather than simply contribute to one. You'll have meaningful ownership over how data is collected, structured, automated, visualized, and ultimately used across the organization.

Your work will directly influence how teams operate and make decisions, while giving you the opportunity to shape the future of the company's data environment through cloud technology, automation, AI, and business intelligence.

You'll work across teams, have real visibility into the impact of your work, and become the technical owner helping turn data into a true business asset.

description:
About Lyra

Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. Role Overview

The international data team is undergoing a complete transformation of their data architecture, migration from a legacy SQL server, Azure Data Factory, SSAS and Power BI stack to Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Tableau and Sigma.

This opportunity will give the successful candidate a chance to share knowledge about best practices with Snowflake and dbt with the team, as well as a chance to build data infrastructure from scratch.

Key Responsibilities:

Build and maintain pipelines to ingest data from Salesforce and various other data sources

Work closely with our Business Intelligence team - monitoring and implementing enhancement requests for the data warehouse to meet the reporting demands of stakeholders

Work collaboratively with team members in different timezones

As we work collaboratively with team members in different time zones, it is important that the candidate has strong interpersonal skills.

Requirements: 3+ years experience in data engineering Experience in development of pipelines to ingest and transform data from sources using REST APIs, AWS S3 and Airflow Experience in building dbt models to transform data using Medallion architecture Experience in maintaining dimensional data models with Type 2 SCDs and star schemas Experience in maintaining data warehouses on SQL Server Experience working with Snowflake, dbt and Tableau is essential

title: Program Manager
description:
Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role is part of our Hypersonics and Strategic Missile Defense business, which designs, develops, and delivers highly dependable missile systems for hypersonic and strategic missile defense missions. We provide integrated, mission-ready hardware that brings together multiple technologies into unified systems engineered to perform in demanding operational environments. Our tip-to-tail capabilities include payload protection and deployment systems, propulsion systems, aerodynamic interstage systems, separation systems, missile subsystems, shroud systems, launch systems, and payload integration solutions.

As Program Manager, you will lead assigned defense programs from planning and development through qualification, production, and delivery. Reporting to the Integrated Product Lead, you will coordinate cross-functional teams, manage program performance, and guide technical and business decisions to deliver missile, propulsion, launch, payload, and defense-system hardware that meets customer and mission requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Develops and maintains integrated program plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, resource requirements, and performance metrics.

  • Manages contractual deliverables, statements of work, customer requests, and program scope changes.

  • Identifies technical, programmatic, supply-chain, cost, and schedule risks and drives mitigation and recovery plans.

  • Serves as a primary program contact for customers, prime contractors, government stakeholders, suppliers, and company leadership.

  • Leads program reviews and communicates financial performance, risks, decisions, dependencies, and corrective actions.

  • Supports design and test-readiness reviews, qualification activities, production-readiness reviews, and customer acceptance events.

  • Supports proposals, estimates, contract negotiations, follow-on opportunities, and program growth.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Business Program Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience supporting or managing aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing, or similarly complex technical programs.

  • A current U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master of Science degree or Master of Business Administration degree.

  • Experience managing DoD, U.S. government, allied-defense, or prime-contractor programs.

  • Experience with missile systems, propulsion, launch systems, payload integration, separation systems, energetic devices, or related flight hardware.

  • Experience managing programs from development through qualification and production.

  • Knowledge of government contracting and fixed-price, cost-reimbursable, or incentive-based contract structures.

  • Experience with Earned Value Management, cost-account management, or similar financial-performance methods.

  • Experience supporting proposals, estimates, negotiations, contract modifications, or follow-on program capture.

  • Project Management Professional certification or equivalent formal program-management training.

  • Experience with program scheduling, enterprise resource planning, or product-lifecycle management systems.

  • Experience leading engineering teams to develop mechanical and pyrotechnic components and systems that exceed customer expectations.

Strong SQL and DSP or programmatic advertising experience are central to this role.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Direct or adjacent experience with digital advertising / DSP data (e.g. Amazon DSP, Amazon Advertising API, or comparable programmatic platforms).
  • Working knowledge of AWS data services (RDS/Postgres, S3, ECS) sufficient to build within an existing cloud environment.
  • Ability to contribute to application and backend work beyond pure ETL to support broader platform needs.
  • Familiarity with, or ability to quickly evaluate, managed ELT tools (such as Fivetran) against custom builds.
  • Ability to ramp into existing attribution and scoring logic so ingestion output aligns with downstream dashboard needs.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience replacing legacy third‑party data pipelines with owned, custom infrastructure.

title: UX Designer- Commercial Web Marketing
description:
Overview

Our Commercial Web Marketing team is transforming Microsoft.com into an AI-powered decision platform and growth engine that helps commercial customers understand solutions and take action. This role will bring that vision to life by setting UX direction, designing connected customer journeys, advancing scalable design-system patterns, and using research and performance data to improve the experience.

We are seeking a collaborative, strategic UX Designer to shape customer journeys across Microsoft.com. You will translate complex product, audience, and business requirements into intuitive, cohesive web experiences for the Microsoft Security business. Working at enterprise scale, you will lead information architecture, interaction design, prototyping, and validation across multi-page programs. You will design within the Microsoft Design System, extend existing patterns where appropriate, and partner with the design system team when new patterns are needed. You will collaborate with product marketing, web production, analytics, engineering, content, and design partners to connect customer needs with business goals. Success requires strong systems thinking, clear communication, sound design judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities. Applicants should provide a digital portfolio demonstrating design process, information architecture, systems thinking, UX rationale, and outcomes for websites, e-commerce, online communities, or digital products.

At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.



Responsibilities
  • Develop thoughtful UX approaches for assigned Microsoft.com customer journeys, with guidance from senior design partners.
  • Create information architecture, navigation, wayfinding, and content hierarchy for defined experiences.
  • Translate product, licensing, audience, and business requirements into clear, customer-centered designs.
  • Design and prototype end-to-end journeys from awareness through enrollment or purchase.
  • Apply established Design System patterns, identify opportunities for reuse, and contribute proposed extensions with the design system team.
  • Collaborate with design, content, analytics, engineering, web production, and agency partners to deliver high-quality experiences.
  • Use research findings, feedback, and post-launch data to refine designs and improve comprehension and wayfinding. Participate in design reviews, clearly explain design decisions, and offer constructive feedback to peers.

title: Senior/Semi-Senior WordPress Developer & Web Publisher
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Web Developer with a real programming background who can own the development, publishing, performance and technical optimization of client websites. Most of our work runs on WordPress, with a growing number of Shopify stores and, increasingly, custom-coded sites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern frameworks such as React, Next.js and Astro.

This is an implementation role, not a strategy or content role. You turn briefs, designs and content into fast, technically sound, conversion-focused pages, and you keep them healthy. You are expected to use AI tools to work faster, but you need to understand the code and the concepts well enough to direct them, review their output and fix what they get wrong.

You will work closely with content strategists and project managers. We are not looking for someone to design SEO strategy or write content. We need someone who implements SEO, tracking and performance correctly and builds with good judgment.

Key Responsibilities

WordPress (primary)

  • Update and maintain WordPress sites and pages: ACF, custom templates, theme modifications and page builders (Elementor Pro, WPBakery, Divi) when needed.
  • Implement new sections, templates and layout variations from briefs, wireframes or existing design systems, writing clean HTML and CSS by hand.

Shopify (growing)

  • Build and maintain Shopify pages, sections and theme changes using Liquid and JSON, including schema-driven editable sections.
  • Support custom logic for templates, product and collection layouts, and landing pages.

Custom code (growing)

  • Build and modify custom-coded pages and components with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and work in modern frameworks such as React, Next.js and Astro.
  • Read, understand and safely modify existing codebases, not just generate new code from scratch.

Performance

  • Keep pages fast: compress and correctly size images, use modern formats and lazy loading, reduce render-blocking resources, and improve Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse scores.

SEO implementation

  • Apply on-page SEO at the implementation level: titles and meta, heading structure, internal links, schema and JSON-LD, and Yoast or Rank Math configuration.
  • Use tools such as Lighthouse, Screaming Frog and Ahrefs to find and help resolve technical issues.

Analytics and tracking

  • Understand the basics of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, and configure and validate event tracking (form submissions, key clicks, conversions), or know how to direct an AI tool to do it and verify the result.

Content formatting and QA

  • Turn Google Docs and content outlines into clean, conversion-optimized pages with clear hierarchy, spacing, CTAs and media.
  • Review published pages for formatting, responsiveness and performance, and test across devices and browsers.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • A genuine programming background: you write and understand HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can work in at least one modern JavaScript framework (React, Next.js or Astro).
  • 4+ years of hands-on web development experience, with a strong track record in WordPress (ACF, theme edits, custom templates, page builders).
  • Shopify experience with Liquid and JSON, or proven ability to ramp up quickly on a new stack.
  • A portfolio of live sites you can walk us through, explaining exactly what you built (code and/or CMS). Links required.
  • Solid design and UX judgment: spacing, hierarchy, contrast and responsive behavior, not just following a checklist.
  • Working knowledge of performance optimization: image compression, Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse.
  • Working knowledge of SEO implementation and of GA4, Search Console and Google Tag Manager basics, or the ability to direct AI tools to configure them and verify the result.
  • Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to work faster, while understanding and reviewing everything they produce.
  • English level B2 to C1 (comfortable working with an international, English-speaking team).
  • 3+ references (full name, company, role, email and/or phone, and dates from and to).

Nice to have

  • Experience in a fast-paced agency with multiple concurrent clients.
  • Headless WordPress, Webflow or Framer experience.
  • Familiarity with Asana, Jira or Teamwork.
  • Basic Figma or Photoshop for resizing and exporting assets and handling SVGs.

Benefits

  • Salary of $2,500 - $2,700, depending on experience
  • 2 Weeks of PTO
  • Fully Remote

Compensation

  • Salary range: $30,000–$32,400, commensurate with experience

This is a full-time position focused on web development across multiple client accounts.

title: Lead Blow Mold Operator - 1st Shift
description:
We Create Products and Brands That People Trust to Clean, Sanitize, and Protect Their Homes and Pools

When you join KIK Consumer Products, you’re joining a team that cares about the work we do and also about each other. We bring exceptional brands and products to consumers that help them protect the health and wellness of their families and the cleanliness of their homes and pools. We are committed to building a culture of performance driven by accountability, collaboration, and agility that enables timely fact-based decision-making and exceptional execution with unwavering ethics. As one of North America’s largest independent manufacturers of consumer products, KIK helps a large portfolio of brands and retailers bring their products to life.

Your Role at KIK

We’re seeking an experienced, hands-on Lead Blow Mold Operator on 1st Shift (6:00am – 4:30pm, Monday–Thursday with weekends per business need) to help lead safe, efficient blow molding operations. As a working lead, you’ll serve as a technical resource and first point of support for the team while operating, setting up, and troubleshooting blow molding equipment. You’ll coordinate daily work assignments, support start-ups and changeovers, coach operators, monitor quality and production performance, and partner with Production, Maintenance, and Quality to minimize downtime and keep lines running safely and efficiently. This role is ideal for an experienced blow molding professional who enjoys solving problems, developing others, and driving continuous improvement. This position has an hourly rate of $29.87.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead day-to-day blow molding activities for assigned lines or shift, coordinate work assignments and staffing coverage, and serve as the first point of support for operators

  • Operate blow molding equipment from cold start through full production; perform machine setups, mold and bottle-size changeovers, shutdowns, and adjustments to machine and process parameters

  • Troubleshoot blow molders and auxiliary equipment, identify mechanical or process issues, complete minor adjustments and basic preventive maintenance, and escalate complex repairs to Maintenance as needed

  • Monitor production performance, downtime, scrap, and throughput; take timely corrective action and communicate issues, priorities, and shift handoffs to the appropriate teams

  • Perform and verify routine quality checks, including bottle weight, appearance, dimensions, color, and other product specifications; adjust machine profiles and process settings to maintain quality standards

  • Operate and support auxiliary equipment such as trimmers, leak testers, bag/debag tables, cooling beds, grinders, and related material-handling systems

  • Train, coach, and support operators on equipment operation, troubleshooting, safety requirements, quality standards, standard work, and changeover procedures

  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), OSHA requirements, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), PPE, hazardous materials procedures, and company safety policies

  • Maintain accurate production, downtime, quality, scrap, and compliance documentation and ensure required records are completed for the shift

  • Partner with Production, Maintenance, Quality, and other teams to resolve recurring issues, improve equipment reliability, reduce waste, and support continuous improvement initiatives

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work area and ensure proper handling of waste oil, wastewater, regrind, and other materials in accordance with plant procedures

What You’ll Bring

  • High School Diploma or GED required

  • 3 or more years of hands-on blow molding experience in a manufacturing environment; prior lead, senior operator, trainer, or informal leadership experience preferred

  • Hands-on experience with machine start-ups, shutdowns, mold changes, bottle-size changeovers, process adjustments, and troubleshooting

  • Experience with Uniloy blow molding equipment and programmable parison controls strongly preferred

  • Working knowledge of HDPE processing, material compounding and mixing, regrind, grinders, and related auxiliary equipment

  • Strong mechanical aptitude with the ability to diagnose equipment and process issues and make sound decisions in a fast-paced production environment

  • Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and provide day-to-day direction to team members while maintaining positive working relationships

  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement

  • Ability to read and follow work instructions, production specifications, safety procedures, and equipment documentation and to complete required production records

  • Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and/or manufacturing production systems

  • Flexibility to work overtime, weekends, holidays, or alternate shifts as business needs require

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during the shift

  • Ability to lift and/or carry up to 50 pounds

  • Frequent bending, twisting, reaching, and climbing as required in a manufacturing environment

  • Ability to work around moving equipment and in an industrial environment while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE)

What You Will Get

KIK offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits including health, wellness, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. You can plan for your future with KIK's retirement savings options including employer match. KIK also recognizes the importance of continuing education and offers Education Assistance to our employees to encourage continued personal development and growth.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. This position has an hourly rate of $29.87 per hour. The actual hourly rate may vary based upon several factors including your relevant skills and experience.

About KIK

We create the products and brands that people trust to clean, sanitize, and protect their homes and pools. We are one of North America’s largest independent consumer product manufacturers with 16 North American manufacturing facilities. We also operate globally in Canada, Europe, South Africa, and Australia. We are known for our portfolio of notable brands including Spic and Span® and Comet® cleaning products, Clorox® Pool&Spa™ (under license), BioGuard®, and Natural Chemistry® pool chemicals. We are also the #1 producer in North America of store-brand bleach and a leading private-label provider of laundry detergent and additives, dishwashing products, general-purpose cleaning, and other home care products.

Our global team of over 2,300 employees drives our capabilities in product development, product formulation, strategic sourcing, manufacturing, packaging design, brand marketing, project management, quality assurance, compliance, distribution, and logistics.

Our organization is constantly evolving and is driven by a set of “One KIK” values – a dedication to following through on commitments in a customer-focused, profit-motivated way; while never compromising on safety, ethics, or integrity.

title: Senior Product Manager, WinZip
description:
Role Overview:

WinZip is one of the world’s most recognized software brands, used by millions of people, businesses, and governments worldwide to manage, encrypt, compress, and share files.

We are transforming the WinZip portfolio, and we are hiring a Senior Product Manager in Canada to help lead that shift. You will own product areas end-to-end: roadmap, execution, and results. This is an AI-fluent role. AI and agentic workflows are your primary way of working, not a side interest: you will use them to inform strategy, pressure-test roadmap decisions, run discovery, and build working prototypes yourself, then codify what works so the team can repeat it, on a faster cycle than traditional product management allows. You will report to the Senior Director of Product Management and work daily with Engineering, UX Design, Product Marketing, and Sales.

One thing to know before you apply: this is not the role for you if AI is something you reach for occasionally to draft a document. We work through agents daily, and we will ask to see what you have built. Beyond that, we want a partner who challenges our thinking, proposing alternatives when we disagree, and moving forward with what customers need without waiting to be asked. If you want to own a roadmap, from research to execution, this is the right role for you.

What success looks like in your first 12 months:

  • You have put several working prototypes in front of real customers, not just in front of us.

  • The AI workflows you built are being used by the rest of the product team.

Responsibilities:

  • Be the customer’s voice: consolidate customer feedback, understand their pain points, and turn qualitative and quantitative signals into decisions, and decisions into shipped product.
  • Own the roadmap and outcomes for products within the WinZip portfolio, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Help shape the portfolio transformation: question existing workflows, rethink them from first principles with AI as a design assumption rather than an add-on, and design the product around where customers are going.
  • Make AI the default in planning and execution: use AI and agentic tools daily for research, analysis, prototyping, writing, and decision support, build repeatable AI workflows the team can adopt, and raise the bar for how the whole team works.
  • Write crisp PRDs, EPICS/User Stories, and business cases that Engineering and Product Marketing can act on.
  • Partner with Engineering on technical trade-offs and sequencing, and with Product Marketing on positioning, pricing, and launch.
  • Contribute to the business side of the product: packaging, pricing, and monetization.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and disagreements openly to stakeholders, up to the executive level.

Required qualifications:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including owning a commercial software product or major product area end to end.
  • Daily, hands-on use of agentic AI tools, not a chat assistant alone. You run agents, build your own workflows and tooling, and have shipped work that would not have been possible without them. Come ready to share concrete examples of what you have built, automated, or shipped with it, and how AI changed the way you made product decisions.
  • A track record of shipping: products or features you took from problem to launch, and what happened after.
  • Strong written communication: you can make a complex decision clear in one page.
  • Comfort working directly with engineers on technical trade-offs.
  • Legally eligible to work in Canada.

Who you are:

  • You build to think: faced with a hard problem, your first move is to prototype it, not to schedule a meeting about it.
  • You automate your own job: when you do something twice, you build the thing that does it the third time.
  • You make the people around you better: the workflows and tooling you build get adopted, not just admired.
  • You push back with a proposal: you challenge a decision directly, bring a better option, and commit once the call is made.
  • You start from the customer problem and work backwards, with evidence rather than instinct.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Deep use of an agentic coding environment such as Claude Code, including custom agents, skills, or MCP integrations you built yourself.
  • Experience building agent skills, sub-agents, or evaluation frameworks for LLM-powered products.
  • Something you built with AI that nobody asked you to build: a tool, an agent, an automation, an open-source contribution, or a piece of writing that shows how you think about this.
  • Experience with data analytics tools like Amplitude, Google Analytics, and Snowflake.
  • Experience in consumer or SMB productivity/utility software, desktop and cloud.
  • Experience with monetization models: subscriptions, freemium, usage-based pricing, and PLG (product-led growth).
  • Familiarity with file management, compression, security, or collaboration domains.

How we hire:

We are not looking for a polished pitch about AI. Send us the most advanced thing you have built with it: an agent, an automated workflow, a prototype, an evaluation harness, a side project. A link, a repository, or a short screen recording is ideal. Tell us what it does, what it replaced, and what you learned when it did not work.

You will then work through a real WinZip problem with us, live, using your own tools and your own setup.

Corel is a beloved and trusted industry titan fueled by make-everything-easier flexibility. This individual will serve as the operational leader for our Live Events function, shaping best practices, improving workflows, mentoring the team, and ensuring a consistently exceptional experience for event participants and audiences.

  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for executive stakeholders during high-profile events.
  • Partner with AV Engineering, Workplace, Production, Communications, and external vendors to ensure seamless execution.

Basic Qualifications (Minimum Requirements)

  • 10+ years of professional experience in live event operations, event production, or corporate event management.
