title: Senior Risk Data Engineer — Aml & Fraud Analytics
description:
Hoy

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Why join us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to lead the replacement of a third‑party digital ingestion tool with a custom‑built ETL pipeline. This person will document existing logic, evaluate build‑vs‑buy options such as Fivetran, and build a standalone pipeline within an existing AWS environment. Strong SQL and DSP or programmatic advertising experience are central to this role.

What you will do

  • Document current ingestion logic inside the legacy tool (TapClicks), including sources, endpoints, schemas, and transformation logic.
  • Build the ETL pipeline to replace the legacy system, handling ingestion from the Amazon API, other DSP platforms, and related digital data sources.
  • Evaluate and decide between off‑the‑shelf solutions (e.g., Fivetran) and custom‑built ETL systems alongside the Infrastructure Lead.
  • Design the pipeline as a standalone, owned system to power client‑facing dashboards.
  • Provide flexible engineering support for application and backend work within the AWS environment when directed.
  • Coordinate with data science teams to ensure ingestion output aligns with the attribution and scoring logic of downstream models.
  • Work seamlessly within the existing AWS environment (ECS, S3, RDS) rather than standing up parallel infrastructure.

MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of strong SQL and large‑scale data ingestion/pipeline experience (batch ETL, orchestration, schema design).
  • Direct or adjacent experience with digital advertising / DSP data (e.g., Amazon DSP, Amazon Advertising API, or comparable programmatic platforms).
  • Working knowledge of AWS data services (RDS/Postgres, S3, ECS) sufficient to build within an existing cloud environment.
  • Ability to contribute to application and backend work beyond pure ETL to support broader platform needs.
  • Familiarity with, or ability to quickly evaluate, managed ELT tools (such as Fivetran) against custom builds.
  • Ability to ramp into existing attribution and scoring logic so ingestion output aligns with downstream dashboard needs.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience replacing legacy third‑party data pipelines with owned, custom infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and how data feeds predictive models.
  • Experience working alongside part‑time technical advisory leads to validate architecture decisions.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Chief Engineer
description:
Chief Engineer of Pyrotechnic Mechanisms

Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development, and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War and its allies’ core mission priorities, and meet the accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Aero/Hydrodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to more than 80 prime contractors supporting over 130 space and defense programs.

This role is part of our Tactical Missiles and Integrated Defense Systems business, which designs and develops integrated missile and defense systems that support critical missions across air, land, and sea. We combine comprehensive analysis, engineering, and program execution capabilities to deliver mission-tailored solutions that reduce lead times, lower costs, and simplify complex multi-vendor supply chains. Backed by decades of flight-proven and fielded performance, we design and build mission-critical technologies including launch systems, propulsion, payload integration solutions, UAV components, missile subsystems, and Safe & Arm systems.

As Chief Engineer of Pyrotechnic Mechanisms, you will serve as the company-wide technical authority for the mechanical and structural design of cutters, initiators, separation joints, and energetically actuated release systems. You will guide development from concept through qualification and low-rate production, helping ensure devices are safe, robust, producible, and compliant. Through hands-on technical leadership, risk management, and engineer development, you will help teams make sound design decisions and meet program requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Leads development of pyrotechnic mechanisms from conceptual design through qualification and low-rate production, providing hands-on oversight during build, test, and flight operations.

  • Translates system-level requirements into mechanical and structural solutions, identifying implied and derived requirements early to prevent scope creep and misinterpretation.

  • Develops and enforces design guidelines, analysis methodologies, and test plans to ensure device robustness and repeatability.

  • Defines design for manufacturing (DFM) and design for assembly (DFA) practices in collaboration with suppliers and internal manufacturing teams.

  • Owns technical risk management for pyrotechnic hardware, maintaining risk registers and driving mitigation across design, materials, manufacturing, and testing.

  • Tailors standards, processes, and qualification approaches to program needs, balancing rigor, cost, and schedule while maintaining compliance.

  • Leads design and safety reviews, documenting tailoring decisions and maintaining alignment with customer and regulatory expectations.

  • Defines scope, risks, and technical approaches for proposals supporting new business opportunities.

  • Represents mechanisms engineering in customer meetings, technical interchange meetings, and safety boards.

  • Mentors and develops engineers to strengthen in-house expertise in mechanism design and pyrotechnics.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering field.

  • At least 15 years of experience designing and qualifying pyrotechnic or energetic mechanisms in aerospace, defense, or related industries.

  • Deep knowledge of energetics, ignition systems, detonation and deflagration physics, and mechanism actuation principles.

  • Proven record of leading multidisciplinary teams and serving as a technical authority.

  • Demonstrated expertise in safety and compliance for energetics handling, storage, and testing.

  • Strong familiarity with U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) and National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) regulations governing energetic systems.

  • Hands-on experience with test planning, execution, and data reduction for pyrotechnic devices.

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to represent the company to customers, suppliers, and regulators.

  • A current U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or doctoral degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related engineering field.

  • Experience integrating pyrotechnics into spacecraft, launch vehicles, missiles, or defense systems.

  • Knowledge of alternative non-pyrotechnic actuation systems to support trade studies.

  • Published technical contributions in pyrotechnics or energetics.

  • Paid time off

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution

  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

  • Company‑paid life and AD&D insurance

  • Tuition reimbursement

title: Student Success Librarian
description:
Earlham College is a Top 100 National Liberal Arts College located in Richmond, IN, a small city that's just a short drive away from several major metropolitan areas including Dayton, Cincinnati, Indianapolis and Chicago.

Richmond and Earlham have a symbiotic relationship. Through research, studies, internships and volunteering, Earlhamites offer Richmond expertise and service as Richmond offers our students the chance to gain valuable, real-world experience. Our community assumes no religious affiliation but follows Quaker principles and practices, which include respect for persons, integrity, a commitment to peace and justice, simplicity, and consensus-based community decision-making. Earlham is committed to and proud of being a diverse and inclusive place most clearly visible in our student body: 20% of our student body are international, coming from 60+ nations in 2022, and 24% are domestic students of color. Faculty and staff also bring tremendous diversity to the College; many have lived and worked outside the United States, and they make a point of drawing on those experiences in their interactions with students. Additionally, Earlham makes it a priority to serve as a safe and welcoming place for LGBTQ+ communities and has a four-star rating on the Campus Pride Index. Our community is characterized by respect for every person and a commitment to social justice. Equity and inclusion are central to Earlham's institutional priorities and our leadership is committed to widening the path to an Earlham education.

Position Overview

The Student Success Librarian is focused on instruction, outreach, programing & partnerships for the library. The Student Success Librarian is a primary point of direct library and research support for students and faculty across the campus.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Instruction

  • Design, teach, and assess course-integrated information literacy sessions in collaboration with faculty to infuse critical thinking and research fluency throughout the curriculum.
  • Teach in LIFT, the library's credit-bearing first-year program for first-generation college students.
  • Teach AI literacy — how generative AI tools work, where they fail, how to evaluate their output, and how to use them ethically in academic work. Audiences include students and employees.
  • Support media and multimodal assignments with options including podcasting, video and audio editing, infographic design, and poster design for students presenting at Epic Expo and the Academic Fair.
  • Provide individual research consultations to Earlham students, in person and online; answer reference questions from students, employees, and the wider community; and administer the library's chat support service.

Outreach

  • Conduct vigorous library outreach with campus faculty, students, and staff. Build relationships that bring students into the library, and foster a sense of belonging.
  • Run the library's social media presence and promotional communications.
  • Serve as a library liaison to select academic departments and programs. Select materials for assigned areas.
  • Administer the library's web presence through LibGuides. Create, maintain, review, and retire research and course guides; and lead the remediation project bringing library digital content into conformance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards ahead of the April 2027 federal deadline.
  • Coordinate with library colleagues to optimize database and discovery interfaces and troubleshoot user-reported problems.

Programming & Partnerships

  • Plan and organize library programming. Coordinate with partners for campus-wide events like New Student Orientation, Earlham Day, and Epic Expo.
  • Partner closely with colleagues in the Library, Information Technology Services, and the Academic Enrichment Center to align student support across the building and to build shared referral pathways.
  • Partner with campus student success units, including academic advising, the Center for Global and Career Education, the McNair Program, and other departments.
  • Represent Earlham in PALNI (Private Academic Library Network of Indiana) working groups and collaborative initiatives. Participate in consortial and professional communities relevant to the position.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • A Master's degree in library/information science, or a related field, required.
  • Experience in higher education settings, preferred.
  • Teaching experience, in a library or another educational setting, preferred.
  • Interest in or experience with generative AI tools in teaching, research support, or professional development, preferred.
  • Familiarity with web accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508), preferred.
  • Experience with LibGuides, content management systems, or web editing, preferred.
  • Knowledge of trends in academic libraries, preferred.

To Apply

Please submit the following materials with your application:

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • List of Three References with Contact Information

The review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled.

title: Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
description:
The Stellantis Quality organization is seeking a highly analytical, innovative, and results-oriented Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join the Business Intelligence & Analytics (BI&A) team at the Headquarters & Technology Center in Auburn Hills, MI. In addition to advanced reporting and executive communication responsibilities, the analyst will lead the development and governance of critical reporting platforms including Palantir and Contour, while identifying opportunities to leverage AI and proactive analytics to improve quality performance, early issue detection, and reporting efficiency.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical capabilities with business acumen, data storytelling expertise, and a passion for innovation.   • Apply advanced analytics, statistical techniques, and AI-enabled capabilities to support predictive quality monitoring, early warning detection, and proactive issue management.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to leverage generative AI, machine learning, and automation tools to streamline reporting processes, reduce manual effort, and increase analytical capacity.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reporting automation, dashboard modernization, and advanced analytical capabilities.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Intelmatix

Intelmatix is a deep tech Artificial intelligence (AI) company founded in July 2021 by a group of MIT scientists with the vision of transforming enterprises to become cognitive. A cognitive enterprise is one that uses AI and Decision Intelligence in making their decisions. This leads to better business decisions with improved accuracy, reduced errors, and better outcomes across various aspects of the business.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer to lead the technical design, implementation, and delivery of an enterprise-grade, AI-ready Data Lakehouse. This role is critical to establishing the foundational data layer for a massive digital transformation initiative, designed to power advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, digital workers, and complex knowledge graphs (Ontologies).

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development with a focus on building and optimizing data pipelines, ensuring data quality, and integrating data from various sources. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data infrastructure that supports our business intelligence and analytics efforts.

Based in Riyadh, you will be responsible for architecting a highly secure platform that complies with strict national data residency and cybersecurity standards. You will not only build the system but also act as a technical leader, mentoring client engineering teams through a collaborative "co-build" model to ensure long‑term operational ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lakehouse Architecture & Implementation: Design and deploy a unified Data Lakehouse utilizing the Medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and open table formats (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) on cloud infrastructure hosted within Saudi Arabia.
  • Data Ingestion & Pipeline Engineering: Build reusable, automated ingestion frameworks (batch and streaming) capable of processing both structured data (RDBMS, APIs) and unstructured data (PDFs, policy documents) to feed downstream AI models and semantic reasoning engines.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Implement automated data quality "circuit breakers" (completeness, uniqueness, referential integrity) and end‑to‑end data lineage tracking frameworks.
  • Optimization: Optimize data processing workflows for performance, scalability, and cost‑efficiency.
  • System Monitoring and Maintenance: Monitor and maintain data systems, responding to SEVs or other urgent issues to ensure continuous operations.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure the platform adheres strictly to NCA (National Cybersecurity Authority) and NDMO (National Data Management Office) standards. Implement AES‑256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, robust Key Management Systems (KMS), & centralized audit logging.
  • Access Control Integration: Design and deploy granular Role‑Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute‑Based Access Control (ABAC), integrating seamlessly with existing enterprise Identity Providers (e.g., Active Directory).
  • Capability Building & Handover: Lead hands‑on knowledge transfer sessions, pair‑programming with client engineers, creating operational runbooks, and conducting "Game Day" failure simulations to ensure the client’s team is fully ready to operate the platform independently.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in Data Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Big Data Architecture, with at least 2+ years specifically leading Data Lakehouse or Cloud Data Platform implementations.
  • Technical Skills & Core Technologies:
    • Programming Languages: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala.
    • Data Architecture & System Design: Strong expertise in designing data-intensive applications, complex data modeling, and schema design for enterprise environments.
    • Distributed Systems & Lakehouse Technologies: Deep, hands‑on experience with distributed processing engines (e.g., Apache Spark, Kafka, Hadoop) and modern open table formats (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi).
    • ETL/ELT & Orchestration: Experience designing and building robust data pipelines using modern transformation and orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Prefect, dbt).
    • Database Ecosystems: Proven track record with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra), and distributed SQL query engines like Hive and Trino.
    • Cloud Infrastructure: Proven experience deploying enterprise data solutions on major cloud providers, specifically within localized Saudi cloud regions. Expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is highly preferred, though experience with AWS or Azure is acceptable.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong problem‑solving skills with a keen eye for detail and a passion for data.
  • AI/Data Science Enablement: Prior experience building data pipelines optimized for Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), vector embeddings, or Knowledge Graphs/Ontologies is highly desirable.
  • Security & Networking: Strong understanding of enterprise network security, Private Endpoints, Identity & Access Management (IAM), and cryptographic key management.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, manage stakeholder expectations, and successfully transition complex systems to internal IT/Data teams.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with Saudi Arabian data compliance frameworks (NCA CCC, NDMO, SDAIA) is highly preferred.

title: Sr. Planning Analyst - Supply Chain Excellence
description:
The Role:

As the Sr. Planning Analyst - Supply Chain Excellence, reporting to the Director of Global Supply Chain Excellence, you will be responsible for advancing enterprise planning excellence by serving as a subject matter expert and process owner for supply, inventory, capacity, S&OP/IBP, and available-to-promise processes. You will establish and strengthen global planning standards and governance, leads cross-functional continuous improvement and transformation initiatives, and partners with business and technology stakeholders to deliver system enhancements, automation, analytics, and digital planning capabilities. Through data-driven analysis, performance management, structured problem solving, and capability building, you will improve decision quality and delivers measurable gains in customer service, inventory, working capital, cost, productivity, and organizational responsiveness.

How You Will Make an Impact:

Enterprise Business Process Ownership

  • Serve as the enterprise process owner and subject matter expert for Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, S&OP / IBP, Capacity Planning, and Available-to-Promise processes.
  • Define, maintain, and continuously improve global planning standards, decision rights, process maps, operating procedures, and work instructions.
  • Drive adoption of standardized planning practices across regions, business units, manufacturing sites, and planning teams.
  • Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, and performance barriers, then recommend practical solutions that improve consistency, scalability, and effectiveness.
  • Establish process governance routines, compliance measures, and escalation paths to sustain planning discipline.

Strategic Continuous Improvement & Value Delivery

  • Lead strategic planning improvement initiatives with measurable impact on service performance, inventory investment, working capital, operating cost, planning productivity, and business responsiveness.
  • Develop business cases, implementation roadmaps, value estimates, and benefits tracking for improvement opportunities.
  • Lead cross-functional process redesign workshops and value stream assessments involving Supply Chain, Commercial, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Customer Service, and IT.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, operational excellence, and change management methods to simplify processes and remove waste.
  • Track business value delivered through completed initiatives and communicate progress to functional leaders.

Planning Systems, Digital Enablement & Analytics

  • Act as the senior business representative for planning-related systems, enhancements, implementations, and digital planning capabilities.
  • Translate business needs into documented requirements, user stories, process designs, test scenarios, training materials, and adoption plans.
  • Partner with IT and external partners to improve planning tools, reporting platforms, automation, exception management, and analytics capabilities.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use advanced analytics, AI, machine learning, optimization, and planning automation to improve decision speed and quality.
  • Support user acceptance testing, deployment readiness, change impact analysis, and post-implementation stabilization.

Performance Management & Executive Insights

  • Develop and maintain planning dashboards, scorecards, KPI definitions, and performance routines that improve visibility and accountability.
  • Monitor and interpret KPIs including forecast accuracy, forecast bias, inventory turns, inventory health, OTIF / OTCC, ATP performance, service levels, schedule adherence, and planning productivity.
  • Analyze trends, root causes, and trade-offs, then recommend corrective actions and improvement priorities.
  • Provide executive-ready insights, business cases, and recommendations to support planning strategy, process design, and technology decisions.
  • Connect operational planning metrics to business outcomes including service, growth, margin, working capital, and cost.

Complex Problem Solving & Transformation Support

  • Resolve ambiguous planning and business process challenges requiring evaluation of multiple operational, financial, system, and strategic factors.
  • Assess competing priorities and recommend balanced solutions across customer service, inventory, capacity, manufacturing constraints, procurement lead times, and commercial objectives.
  • Support network optimization, business integration, portfolio changes, and transformation initiatives from a planning process perspective.
  • Develop scalable process solutions where existing standards are incomplete, inconsistent, or not yet established.
  • Influence stakeholders at multiple levels through data-driven analysis, process expertise, and structured problem solving.

Data, Governance & Capability Building

  • Support planning master data governance, data quality improvement, parameter management, and ownership models.
  • Define process controls, audit points, and performance measures that sustain planning standards.
  • Create training materials, playbooks, process documentation, and knowledge-transfer tools for planning teams and cross-functional partners.
  • Coach stakeholders on planning practices, system use, KPI interpretation, and continuous improvement methods.
  • Promote a culture of process discipline, fact-based decision-making, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Creating Extraordinary Starts With:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Operations, Data Analytics, or related field required.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive supply chain planning, supply chain excellence, business process ownership, planning transformation, or related experience.
  • Deep experience in demand planning, supply planning, inventory planning, S&OP / IBP, capacity planning, or integrated planning processes.
  • Experience supporting ERP, advanced planning system, analytics, or digital supply chain implementations in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience developing business cases, KPI frameworks, executive reporting, process documentation, and adoption plans.
  • APICS/ASCM CPIM or CSCP certification a plus.
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification a plus.

What We Value:

We strive for all employees to nurture physical, mental and emotional health both personally and professionally. Our commitment to health and wellness centers around prevention, early detection and embracing a healthy lifestyle. Some offerings may vary by role or region, but may include:

  • Physical Health benefits including competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision packages, company contribution to Health Savings Account, cash incentive for Annual Physical and reimbursement
  • Financial Wellness opportunities including company paid life insurance and disability plans, 401(k) Retirement Plan with generous company match, and certified Financial Planning & Investment services
  • Mental Health benefits including generous Paid Time Off and 10 Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Bonding Leave, and much more!

  • Excellent stamina is required.
  • Work with and near heavy equipment and other vehicles on a regular basis
  • Flexible working hours including occasional weekend work.

What kind of person are we looking for? Someone with:

  • The ability to run stump grinding equipment in various weather conditions.
  • 1-2 years of hands-on experience in the green industry

SavATree’s mission is to take our passion for nature and keep this country’s outdoors beautiful and flourishing. Through our comprehensive lawn and tree care, we work hard to make sure our customers have attractive, healthy and cared-for green spaces to enjoy. Over the last thirty years, we have opened new offices across the country, and we are looking for people who want to grow with us.

We want everyone to be able to identify and achieve their own version of success, which means giving each employee the room and opportunity to grow. To ensure that everyone has the best chance to succeed, we invest heavily in training and continuing education. We make it easy for you to reach out and get the help you need, even when it’s from the other side of the country. This means actively fostering a collaborative culture where we come together to learn from each other and help each other succeed. We pride ourselves on creating an environment where each employee has the resources and opportunities to advance his or her career and become a go-to subject matter expert. That’s why we often say that when you work here, you thrive here.

title: Supplier Quality Specialist
description:
The Supplier Quality Specialist is responsible for ensuring supplier critical processes such as materials, components, and processes meet high-quality standards. With advanced education, technical expertise, and/or experience, they often serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in areas like metallurgy, coatings, welding, or non-destructive testing (NDT).

  • Track supplier performance metrics (e.g., defect rates, on-time delivery).

Collaboration:

  • Work with internal teams (engineering, procurement, manufacturing) to align supplier quality with company goals.

Compliance & Documentation:

  • Ensure supplier compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain records of audits, certifications, and supplier quality performance.

SME Focus Areas:

  • Provide in-depth expertise in disciplines like metallurgy, coatings, welding, materials, or NDT.

title: Program Evaluator
description:
ATA Services is seeking Program Evaluators to provide evaluation and epidemiological support to the Adult Mental Health Division (AMHD) for reports to the legislature on emergency transportations, assisted community treatment petitions and orders, and related services or programs.

This position collects, analyzes, and interprets behavioral health and service utilization data; designs and leads the development of reporting and evaluation systems; and works with DOH and partnering agencies to manage local logistics and data collection support. The Program Evaluator applies qualitative and quantitative research methods to assess program implementation, data infrastructure, and outcomes; and supports DOH in meeting annual legislative reporting requirements while building a sustainable framework for ongoing program monitoring and quality improvement.


Pay Rate: $52 hourly

Schedule: 7:45 am - 4:30 pm, Monday - Friday

Contract Length: Until June 30, 2027, with possible extension.

No PTO, Holidays off without pay, Dental, Health, Vision, & Life Insurance available after 1 month of employment.

Onsite position with potential for remote work, as approved by the supervisor.


Job Description:

  • Review legislation and relevant materials to document current implementation and operational processes, including variation across agencies and/or programs.
  • Conduct semi-structured interviews and/or surveys with relevant stakeholders (e.g., service providers, hospitals, court personnel) to supplement document review and identify barriers to and facilitators of successful program implementation
  • Conduct data mapping and gap analysis of existing data systems relevant to reporting. Inventory available data relevant to legislative reporting elements , noting data quality. completeness, and limitations.
  • Assess feasibility Of administrative data linkages. including records from Other agencies (e.g., MedQuEST, hospitals, behavioral health facilities, district and circuit courts, law enforcement). prepare and submit IRB materials as needed.
  • Develop an evaluation framework linking contextual inputs, program characteristics, and outcomes informed by program reporting elements.
  • Draft appropriate program evaluation and analysis plans.
  • Develop standardized data collection tools.
  • Conduct data quality assessments and preliminary descriptive analyses.
  • Provide recommendations for future Outcome evaluation activities and Draft and finalize annual legislative reports in coordination with DOH staff, incorporating qualitative implementation findings, the data inventory, and evaluation/analysis findings as appropriate.
  • Assist with drafting testimony as needed.
  • Organize and facilitate in-person or virtual meetings as needed to engage DOH staff and partnering agencies.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for DOH leadership and Other stakeholders.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

Master's degree from an accredited college or university in Heald' Services Administration, Public Health, Psychology, Epidemiology, Social Work, Public Administration, or a related field.

Minimum of two years of professional experience in program evaluation, applied research. or health services/quality improvement. including experience with mixed-methods (qualitative and quantitative) research designs.

Demonstrated experience designing and conducting interviews, surveys, and Other qualitative data collection including coding and synthesis.

Experience with quantitative data reporting, statistical analysis, and interpretation Of administrative and health services data.

Working knowledge Of relational database principles, data mapping, and data quality/gap analysis.

Familiarity with IRB protocols and human subjects research requirements.

title: 60345-Mac_Ham N/C & Single Spindle Op / Set-Up
description:
GENERAL JOB SUMMARY

Sets up and operates grinding machines (Internal Diameter, Outside Diameter) to grind specific aspects of cylindrical and tapered surfaces of races by performing the following duties.

SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  • Uses blueprints to ensure grind work is done within expected tolerances
  • Selects grinding wheel and mounts wheel on spindle.
  • Moves controls and reads dial to set angle of workpiece to grinding wheel.
  • Dresses wheel manually or with preset device.
  • Positions and secures workpiece on faceplate, magnetic chuck, or in chuck jaws.
  • Selects and sets grinding wheel speed, work surface speed, and workpiece table travel rate.
  • Positions and tightens stops to set depth of grinding wheel cut and stroke of workpiece table.
  • Moves controls to feed wheel to workpiece manually and automatically.
  • Turns valve handle and directs flow of coolant against wheel and workpiece.
  • Verifies dimensions of ground workpiece for conformance to specifications.
  • Dresses grinding wheel to specified profile for contour grinding.
  • Operates grinding machine (s) to produce parts within specification. Operates grinding machine to rework out of tolerance pieces as needed.
  • Performs all necessary paperwork including (time sheets, SPC charts, PM charts, etc).
  • Support the plant quality systems goals / improvements and productivity goals & improvements within the scope of the job.
  • Regular and predictable attendance.
  • Compliance with applicable Company, Corporate, State, and Federal regulations.
  • May be required to perform minor preventative maintenance activities.
  • 5S (Sort, Shine, Set in Order, Standardize, and Sustain) is required of every job.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED); and one to three months related experience and / or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Language - Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to communicate effectively to all levels of employees of the organization.
  • Math - Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as fundamentals of geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical solutions.
  • Reasoning - Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several variables in standardized situations.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand. The employee is frequently required to walk and to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to talk or hear. The employee must regularly lift and / or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and / or move up to 50 pounds, and occasionally lift and / or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to caustic chemicals and to vibration. The noise level in the work environment is variable; however, it is usually loud.

title: Senior Front-End Developer
description:
Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer – ideally with full-stack experience/knowledge – to contribute to building our modern stack Jamstack projects and help raise the technical bar of the team.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

The Role:

Jobber’s website is one of our most important growth engines — the place where small home-service businesses first meet the product and decide to start a trial. The Web team builds and continuously improves getjobber.com , shipping new pages, running a high-velocity experimentation program, and pushing the limits of what a marketing site can do for conversion, SEO, and AI-driven discovery.

We’re looking for a Senior Front-End Developer – ideally with full-stack experience/knowledge – to contribute to building our modern stack Jamstack projects and help raise the technical bar of the team. You’ll work primarily in Next.js , Sanity, React and TypeScript within a headless/composable architecture, contributing to our growing UI library and the systems that lets us ship and test quickly. Back-end familiarity is important: our site is content-driven, so you’ll work across a headless CMS with the APIs and services that power our pages. You’ll regularly interface with engineers on the Product side. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real technical influence: you’ll set patterns, mentor other developers, and partner with the Engineering Manager on standards and code quality — without carrying people-management responsibilities.

Just as importantly, we want someone who treats AI-assisted development as a core engineering skill. We’re actively reshaping how we build — using AI coding agents, MCP-connected tooling, and automated workflows to move faster without sacrificing quality — and we want this person to help lead that evolution, not just keep up with it.

What you’ll do:

Build on a modern front-end stack

Ship production features in Next.js, Sanity, and React with TypeScript across getjobber.com, from marketing and feature pages to conversion-critical surfaces like pricing.

Contribute to and extend our shared component library and design system so the team builds faster on consistent, reusable, well-tested foundations.

Own performance and accessibility as first-class requirements — Core Web Vitals, semantic and accessible markup, and fast, resilient page loads that directly support conversion.

Work across the stack on a content-driven site — integrate with a headless CMS, and build and consume the APIs and services that power our pages.

Write well-tested, scalable, well-organized code and drive consistent engineering practices through code review.

Collaborate with our other developers on best technical practices and project decisions.

Push our AI-assisted workflow forward

Use AI coding tools and agents fluently (e.g. Claude, AI-assisted IDEs, agentic workflows) to accelerate development while keeping a critical eye on output quality and reliability.

Improve how the team works with AI — building and refining MCP integrations, prompts, and context so our tickets, content, and codebase are AI-ready.

Help define and benchmark team standards for AI-assisted development — identifying what works, documenting it, and raising the whole team’s baseline.

Power experimentation and growth

Build and ship A/B and multivariate experiments quickly, partnering with CRO and product stakeholders to keep the test pipeline moving.

Engineer for velocity — reduce the friction between a test idea and a live experiment, and make iteration cheap.

Support SEO, LLM, and AI-search initiatives with the technical foundations (structured data, performance, rendering) that keep the site discoverable as search evolves.

Raise the technical bar

Set patterns and technical direction for how we build, and bring the team along through pragmatic, well-reasoned decisions.

Mentor and coach other front-end developers, lifting their skills and holding the team to its engineering principles.

Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical standards, code quality, and architecture

Interface with engineers on the Product team, coordinating across shared systems and boundaries (e.g. the signup and pricing surfaces) to align on patterns, integrations, and handoffs.

Identify and act on opportunities to improve the stack, tooling, and processes, and maintain strong team documentation.

To be successful, you should have:

Strong Next.js and React experience. You’ve built and maintained real applications on this stack and understand modern rendering, component architecture, and tooling.

Back-end familiarity — full-stack ideal. You’re comfortable working beyond the front end: building and integrating APIs and services, and reasoning about the systems behind the pages. A full-stack background is highly preferred.

Headless CMS experience. You’ve built content-driven sites on a headless CMS and understand how to model, integrate, and ship content at scale.

Hands‑on AI‑assisted development. You actively use AI coding tools in your day‑day work and have a point of view on where they help, where they don’t, and how to use them responsibly.

A growth and experimentation mindset. You’re comfortable building for measurement and iteration, and you care about the business outcome your code drives.

Technical leadership without ego. You set standards and mentor others while staying collaborative and open to better ideas.

Strong communication. You collaborate easily with both technical and non-technical partners — designers, marketers, PMs, and CRO.

Ambitious and humble. You don’t accept the status quo simply because “it’s what we’ve always done” — you push for better, newer, more innovative approaches while staying grounded.

Comfort in the grey areas. You’re adaptable, can prioritize amid ambiguity and changing priorities, and break large, complex problems into shippable pieces.

Nice to have:

Experience with client-side and feature-flag experimentation platforms (e.g. Optimizely, Kameleoon, Adobe Target) and analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, GA360).

Experience working within a design system or maintaining a shared component library.

Experience collaborating with product engineering teams across shared systems.

Experience collaborating closely with designers in Figma.

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $121,000 a midpoint of $142,200, and a maximum salary of $163,600 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player…yet.

To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

title: Field Technical Assistance Director
description:
Stellantis Mopar Technical Service Operations is seeking a Field Technical Service Operations Director to provide strategic and operational leadership for field technical service across the North American market. This role leads the organization responsible for resolving complex vehicle concerns, strengthening dealer service execution, improving warranty performance, increasing customer satisfaction, and reducing vehicle buyback risk.

The Director provides leadership and direction to Technical Advisors for aligning field technical support, dealer assistance, and escalation management to enterprise priorities. The role serves as a senior liaison among Technical Service Operations, Field Operations, Customer Care, Quality Engineering, Supply Chain, dealer personnel, and third-party partners to improve repair timeliness, technical accuracy, warranty compliance, and customer outcomes.

This position establishes the operating strategy, performance expectations, processes, and accountability required to deliver consistent support across the dealer network. The Director translates field insights into corrective actions, process improvements, training priorities, system requirements, and executive recommendations that improve organizational effectiveness and service performance.

Duties Include:

  • Provide strategic leadership and operational direction for field technical assistance and repair support activities across the North American market.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Technical Advisors, establishing clear responsibilities, performance expectations, decision rights, and accountability for results.
  • Establish and execute the field technical service strategy in alignment with customer satisfaction, vehicle repair, dealer performance, and buyback prevention objectives.
  • Direct field support for complex diagnostic and repair concerns, emerging product issues, repeat repairs, customer escalations, and vehicles with elevated buyback risk.
  • Support buyback prevention and reduction initiatives, ensuring timely case management, effective escalation, cross-functional alignment, and disciplined execution of corrective actions.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for cross-functional initiatives involving Technical Service Operations, Field Operations, Customer Care, Quality Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Centers, dealer teams, and third-party partners.
  • Define key performance indicators, targets, reporting requirements, and management routines that provide visibility into repair timeliness, case activity, dealer support, escalation trends, and program effectiveness.
  • Analyze business and field performance data to identify trends, systemic barriers, execution gaps, and opportunities requiring leadership action or cross-functional intervention.
  • Direct the development and enhancement of dashboards, reporting tools, case management processes, and system capabilities that improve decision-making, transparency, and accountability.
  • Ensure field resources are effectively deployed based on business priorities, technical complexity, dealer needs, customer impact, and emerging product concerns.
  • Champion consistent technical diagnostic and repair standards, effective root cause analysis, repair quality, warranty compliance, and timely resolution throughout the dealer network.
  • Guide the development of training, mentoring, technical communication, and knowledge-sharing practices for field personnel and dealer service teams.
  • Use field technical insights to support product quality improvements, service procedures, parts availability priorities, training needs, policy updates, and enterprise decisions.
  • Identify organizational risks and resource needs, develop business cases and recommendations, and communicate priorities to senior and executive leadership.
  • Develop and maintain executive-level presentations, business updates, operating reviews, process documentation, and strategic plans supporting organizational objectives.
  • Promote a culture of customer focus, collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, technical excellence, and compliance.
  • Ensure programs and processes remain adaptable to changing business needs, product conditions, customer expectations, and organizational priorities.

title: Director of Quality
description:
About the Role

This role exists because quality-by-design doesn't have a playbook yet for AI-enabled products in regulated life sciences environments — you'll be the one writing it. As Director of Quality, you'll establish, lead, and continuously improve the Quality Management System (QMS) for Hippocratic AI's Life Sciences business, building a risk-based quality framework for AI-enabled solutions used in clinical trial operations, patient engagement, medical affairs, pharmacovigilance, and related use cases.

You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory, Compliance, Security, Medical Affairs, and Commercial teams to embed quality and compliance throughout the product lifecycle and service delivery model.

What You'll Do

Build and run the quality system

  • Establish, implement, and continuously improve a scalable QMS for the Life Sciences business, including policies, procedures, and governance aligned with GxP requirements.

  • Own CAPA, deviation, change control, document control, training, risk management, and supplier quality processes end to end.

  • Build quality metrics, dashboards, and KPIs that give executive leadership a real-time read on compliance and operational effectiveness.

  • Lead root cause investigations and management review, turning findings into continuous improvement initiatives rather than one-off fixes.

Ensure regulatory and audit readiness

  • Operationalize applicable regulatory requirements and guidance — ICH E6 (GCP), FDA clinical trial regulations (21 CFR 11, 50, 54, 56, 312), EU CTR 536/2014, GxP principles, and computerized system/software validation requirements — into working quality processes.

  • Track evolving global regulation on AI, digital health, and life sciences technology, and translate it into changes to the QMS before it becomes a problem.

  • Serve as the quality subject matter expert in customer audits, regulatory inspections, and due diligence — and keep the organization in a continuous state of inspection readiness.

Extend quality to AI products, vendors, and the org

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to build quality-by-design into the AI development lifecycle, including validation and qualification strategies for software, AI models, and regulated workflows, and controls for model updates, release management, and change governance.

  • Establish qualification, monitoring, and audit programs for vendors, CROs, technology partners, and subcontractors.

  • Advise executive leadership on quality risk and compliance obligations, and build and mentor a quality organization as the business scales.

Location and Travel

We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week.

What You Bring

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Quality, Engineering, Pharmacy, Regulatory Affairs, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of progressive quality and compliance experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO, clinical research, healthcare technology, or a related regulated industry.

  • 5+ years of leadership experience building and managing quality systems and teams.

  • Deep working knowledge of ICH E6 (GCP), FDA and EU clinical trial regulations, GxP quality systems, risk management methodologies, and vendor qualification/audit management.

  • Demonstrated experience establishing or significantly enhancing a quality management system from the ground up.

  • Experience supporting customer audits and regulatory inspections directly.

  • Strong understanding of software-enabled or digital health solutions operating in regulated environments.

Nice-to-Have

  • Advanced degree (MS, PharmD, PhD, MPH, or equivalent).

  • ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), RAC, or a comparable certification.

  • Experience with AI/ML-enabled products or SaaS platforms.

  • Experience supporting clinical trials, patient support programs, pharmacovigilance operations, or medical information services.

  • Familiarity with GAMP 5, computerized system validation (CSV), and software quality assurance methodologies.

  • Experience scaling quality systems inside a high-growth technology company.

What Success Looks Like

  • A comprehensive Life Sciences Quality Management System is established and operating.

  • Core quality processes — CAPA, change control, supplier quality, audits, and management review — are implemented and functioning.

  • Multiple pharmaceutical customers have completed audits with successful outcomes.

  • A scalable framework supporting regulated AI products and services is in place.

  • Executive leadership has measurable quality metrics and compliance dashboards to work from.

  • Hippocratic AI is positioned as a trusted, inspection-ready partner for global life sciences organizations.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @ email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

description:
The Role

We are looking for a Senior Java Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain reliable, scalable applications. You will take ownership of features throughout the software development lifecycle, contribute to architectural decisions, and support other engineers through technical guidance and code reviews.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

  • Collaborate with product owners, QA engineers, and other technical teams in an Agile environment.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum 5-6 years of professional software development experience, primarily using Java.
  • Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, and the Spring ecosystem.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, design principles, and common design patterns.
  • Experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices.

title: Senior IT Portfolio Analyst
location: District of Columbia, Washington, DC, US
description:
Farmer Mac is seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented Senior IT Portfolio Analyst to support the effective management of the IT portfolio and the Office of the Chief Information Officer (CIO). This role combines IT change coordination, financial and resource management, management reporting, audit coordination, process automation, Power BI leadership, SharePoint administration, and project coordination. The successful candidate will bring strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills and will work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

The People You Will Work With

The position will report directly to the Director - Finance Technology & IT Operations. The role will collaborate with IT leadership, project managers, Finance, Internal Audit, External Audit, Cybersecurity, Development, IT Infrastructure, business stakeholders, managed service providers, consultants, and third-party auditors.

Where and When You Will Work

The position will be based at Farmer Mac's headquarters at 2100 Pennsylvania Avenue, N.W., Washington, D.C., with the ability to work remotely. Farmer Mac is a Presence with a Purpose work environment, providing flexibility while creating opportunities for teams to come together in the office with purpose. Occasional work outside core hours may be required for planned or unplanned activities, time-sensitive projects, or off-site meetings and events.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Responsibilities and essential job functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • IT change management: Assist with IT change coordination to ensure changes to IT systems and processes are properly managed. Coordinate change requests, assess impacts, maintain supporting information, and communicate with stakeholders.
  • Office of the CIO: Support and manage Office of the CIO activities, including planning, coordination, reporting, follow-up, documentation, and alignment of key IT priorities.
  • IT budget management: Manage an IT budget of more than $10 million, including budget tracking, forecasting, accruals, variance analysis, and coordination with Finance and IT leaders.
  • Resource management: Track resource allocations, availability, capacity, and utilization to support effective deployment of resources across projects and operational priorities.
  • Annual project planning: Play a key role in the annual project planning process to help ensure IT has the appropriate budget, capacity, and resources to deliver approved priorities.
  • Portfolio delivery coordination: Work with IT project managers and other stakeholders to track priorities, dependencies, risks, milestones, and follow-up actions so key commitments are met in a timely manner.
  • KPI and management reporting: Compile monthly Key Performance Indicators by collecting relevant data, analyzing metrics, and preparing reports, dashboards, or presentations that communicate the performance of IT projects and initiatives.
  • IT audit management: Coordinate internal and external audit requests, provide requested documentation, facilitate audit activities, track responses and remediation items, and support compliance with audit requirements.
  • AI-enabled process automation: Identify and automate manual processes using AI and related tools to improve efficiency, consistency, transparency, and scalability across IT operations.
  • Power BI leadership: Serve as the Power BI subject matter expert and lead the Power BI Community of Practice to mature adoption and utilization across the company. Maintain and actively advance the Power BI roadmap.
  • IT SharePoint administration: Maintain and update the IT SharePoint environment for all areas of IT, ensuring content, documentation, resources, and portfolio information are organized, accessible, accurate, and current.
  • Ad hoc project coordination: Provide project coordination support to the Finance Technology team for ongoing initiatives, including coordinating tasks, meetings, status updates, dependencies, documentation, and follow-up actions.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

  • At least five years of related experience in IT portfolio management, IT project coordination, IT operations, financial management, PMO support, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated experience with Power BI, including dashboard and report development, data analysis, governance, roadmap planning, and user adoption.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, particularly supporting change management, workflow coordination, reporting, or related IT processes.
  • Experience using AI and related automation tools to redesign or automate manual processes and deliver measurable efficiency improvements.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasts, accruals, actual spend, and financial variances.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources to support decisions.
  • Experience developing executive-ready KPIs, dashboards, management reports, presentations, and portfolio insights.
  • Knowledge of IT change management, audit coordination, project management, resource management, and portfolio governance practices.
  • Proficiency with SharePoint and collaboration tools used to organize and maintain enterprise information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous learning mindset focused on emerging technology and practical business outcomes.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree strongly preferred, ideally in Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Minimum of five years of related professional experience.
  • Experience in the financial services industry is a plus.
  • Relevant certifications such as PMP, CAPM, ITIL Foundation, Power BI Data Analyst Associate, or similar credentials are a plus.

Our compensation philosophy is targeted pay positioning relative to peers, our industry, and external markets. Farmer Mac is committed to a compensation program that will enable the organization to attract, motivate, reward, and retain highly skilled and creative talent to maintain sustained long-term performance and achieve the organization’s strategic business objectives. The typical starting salary range for this position is between $100,000 -$120,000, although wages can vary based on experience and geography. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience.

title: React Native Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer (React Native & Expo)

Fully remote, UK

A fast-growing sports betting content business is turning its successful, data-rich web platform into a dedicated mobile app.

Most of its audience already uses the platform on mobile, so this is not an experimental side project searching for users. The audience and product already exist. The opportunity is to take an early React Native prototype, decide what is worth keeping and turn it into a properly engineered iOS and Android app.

You’ll become the team’s mobile expert and shape how mobile development is done across the business. That includes the architecture, tooling, performance, testing and release process, as well as solving the real-world problems that only appear once an app reaches different devices and both app stores.

The app needs to make large amounts of sports and betting data clear, fast and easy to navigate on a small screen. You’ll work closely with product, design and experienced engineers, while helping the wider team build its own mobile capability through collaboration, pairing and code reviews.

  • AI augmentation experience, with the knowledge to ensure quality code

  • The confidence to lead mobile technically while remaining a hands-on, collaborative member of the engineering team

  • Wider interest in software engineering outside of mobile

This is a rare chance to build something new without the usual early-stage uncertainty. You’ll have an established platform, a substantial audience and a capable team behind you, while still having genuine influence over what the mobile product becomes.

title: Entry Level- RF Systems Engineer (Onsite- Aberdeen, Maryland)
description:
ENTRY-LEVEL SYSTEMS ENGINEER

xG and Mixed Signal Product Development | Technical Services

About the opportunity

Fairwinds Technologies is continuously looking for curious, organized, and hands-on early-career engineers who want to help turn advanced communications and RF concepts into integrated, testable, and supportable systems. In this role, you may support either our xG or Mixed Signal product development team, or technical-services contracts aligned with those product areas.

You will work alongside experienced systems, RF, network, DSP, FPGA, embedded software, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, cybersecurity, and test engineers. The role provides exposure to the full engineering lifecycle, including stakeholder needs, requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration, verification, validation, configuration, documentation, demonstrations, and field support.

What you will do

  • Help capture, clarify, decompose, organize, and maintain system, subsystem, interface, performance, and verification requirements.
  • Support development of system concepts, functional architectures, physical architectures, interface definitions, operational workflows, and engineering trade studies.
  • Maintain traceability among customer needs, requirements, design decisions, interfaces, test methods, results, risks, and deliverables.
  • Create and update system diagrams, block diagrams, interface-control information, use cases, verification matrices, test plans, procedures, and technical reports.
  • Coordinate technical information across RF, networking, DSP, FPGA, embedded software, electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, cybersecurity, and test disciplines.
  • Support integration of radios, modems, processors, networks, RF subsystems, antennas, embedded platforms, software, test equipment, and mechanical assemblies.
  • Assist with verification and validation planning, requirement-based testing, acceptance criteria, data review, discrepancy tracking, and closure evidence.
  • Participate in laboratory and field integration, customer demonstrations, design reviews, test-readiness reviews, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigations.
  • Help manage technical risks, assumptions, dependencies, open decisions, action items, configuration baselines, and engineering changes.
  • Prepare clear engineering documentation and concise technical briefings for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technology and mission areas

Depending on assignment, you may contribute in one or more of the following areas:

  • xG wireless systems, including 5G, non-terrestrial networking, tactical communications, software-defined radio, mesh and mobile networks, gateways, and edge-compute platforms.
  • Mixed Signal products, including Global Link and EchoPhase-related capabilities, channel emulation, coherent combining, wideband RF systems, embedded control, and network-connected test equipment.
  • Integrated systems that combine RF, antennas, digital signal processing, FPGA logic, embedded Linux, networking, power, mechanical packaging, and management software.
  • Performance areas such as interoperability, throughput, latency, signal quality, channel effects, timing, synchronization, reliability, environmental constraints, and operational usability.
  • Government-funded R&D and technical-services contracts involving requirements analysis, architecture, integration, test, documentation, demonstrations, and field support.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related technical field, completed or expected before start date.
  • Coursework, laboratory, internship, capstone, research, or personal-project experience involving multidisciplinary system design, integration, testing, requirements, modeling, or technical documentation.
  • Foundational understanding of the engineering lifecycle, including requirements, design, integration, verification, validation, and configuration control.
  • Ability to organize complex technical information, identify interfaces and dependencies, and convert discussions into clear diagrams, requirements, plans, or action items.
  • Basic ability to analyze test data, investigate discrepancies, communicate assumptions, and document conclusions.
  • Ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical teammates.
  • Ability to satisfy customer, site-access, export-control, and security requirements associated with assigned work.

Preferred, not required

  • Exposure to requirements-management, model-based systems engineering, SysML, UML, architecture modeling, or digital-engineering tools.
  • Familiarity with interface-control documents, verification cross-reference matrices, trade studies, risk registers, configuration management, or technical reviews.
  • Coursework or project experience in wireless communications, RF systems, 5G or LTE, non-terrestrial networks, software-defined radio, satellite communications, embedded systems, or computer networks.
  • Experience using MATLAB, Python, Linux, Git, diagramming tools, issue trackers, test-management tools, or data-analysis and automation workflows.
  • Awareness of systems-engineering guidance such as the V-model, requirements traceability, verification methods, reliability concepts, human factors, cybersecurity, or environmental qualification.
  • Hands-on experience integrating or troubleshooting hardware, software, networks, radios, sensors, test equipment, or electromechanical systems.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: learn the assigned product or program, mission context, architecture, requirements, interfaces, documentation workflow, laboratory environment, and test objectives; complete scoped systems-engineering tasks with mentoring.
  • First 6 months: independently maintain a defined requirement set, interface, verification matrix, trade study, diagram package, or integration activity and produce clear technical evidence and documentation.
  • First year: own a defined subsystem, interface, requirements area, integration thread, or verification capability and become a dependable coordinator across engineering disciplines, product activities, and technical-service deliverables.

Why join Fairwinds Technologies

  • Work on products and customer-funded R&D activities within the same technical domain, connecting mission needs and engineering decisions with real hardware, software, networks, RF systems, and measured performance.
  • Gain broad exposure to wireless communications, RF hardware, software-defined radios, DSP, FPGA, embedded computing, networking, mechanical integration, cybersecurity, manufacturing, laboratory testing, and field support.
  • Learn from experienced multidisciplinary engineers while receiving meaningful requirements, architecture, integration, verification, and documentation responsibilities early in your career.
  • Join a growing technology organization expanding its xG and Mixed Signal portfolios and strengthening repeatable product-development and systems-engineering practices.

How to apply

Submit your resume and, if available, links or short descriptions for relevant capstone projects, system diagrams, requirements work, trade studies, integration activities, test plans, laboratory work, research, internships, technical papers, or portfolios. Tell us what system problem you addressed, what you personally contributed, how you verified the result, and what you learned.



Compensation- Salary

At Fairwinds, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location and experience. Additional incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work

This is a full time, exempt position.

Must be eligible to work in the US.
