title: Founding Operations (Recruiting Coordinator / People Coordinator)
description:
About Us

MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools.

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera.

The Job

You own how candidates and new hires experience MintMCP. From day one you do both the recruiting coordination (scheduling interviews fast, keeping candidates moving, making the process clean end to end) and the people ops around it (onboarding that makes new hires day-one ready, the HR operations that keep the team running, and the documented processes that replace tribal memory). You may not have done all of it before, and that is fine: we will teach you the parts you are missing. Process is the job here, so you should like building it.

We are an AI-native company. With our help, you'll build agentic workflows in our own product to streamline your work, so you're able to make better judgment calls. The role is hybrid in the Bay Area.

About You

  • Likely 2 to 4 yrs as a recruiting coordinator, ready to take on recruiting ops and people ops from day one.

  • You have owned a process, not just worked tickets and schedules. You can point to something you built or fixed.

  • You love optimizing and automating. This is the builder seat, so that matters most here.

  • You have high attention to detail. You genuinely care about candidate experience, and you are organized enough that nothing slips.

  • You are a fast learner who is AI-native, or will get there fast.

  • You have a strong desire to grow, and you are excited to pick up the people ops side (onboarding, HR ops, and compliance) as we teach it.

Nice to have:

  • You have built or directed AI agents or agentic workflows, not just used AI tools.

  • You have touched HR ops, onboarding, or compliance.

  • You have used an ATS like Ashby or Greenhouse.

  • You have built or improved a recruiting or onboarding workflow.

What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.

  • The chance to build recruiting and people ops at an AI-native company from the ground up, with room to grow.

  • Direct access to the founders and to how the company hires and runs.

  • Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

description:
This position requires travel up to 85% of the time. Access to major highways and airports a plus.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Field Technology Specialist to support the deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting of computer, network, and electronic physical security systems. This role is responsible for ensuring optimal performance of low voltage infrastructure, security devices, and associated technologies across multiple project environments. The ideal candidate is hands-on, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, field-driven setting with shifting priorities.

In this role, you will install, configure, and troubleshoot low voltage systems supporting physical security and IT infrastructure, including cameras, access control devices, power supplies, biometric systems, and locking hardware. You will work with video and data cabling, assemble and deploy hardware using standard hand and power tools, and ensure all equipment is installed according to design specifications and technical drawings. You will also be responsible for coordinating materials and equipment needed for project execution, managing receipt and tracking of hardware, and ensuring timely delivery of project deliverables. Success in this role requires strong problem-solving ability, solid communication skills, and a commitment to delivering high-quality work that meets customer expectations.

Qualified candidates typically have at least three years of experience in low voltage installation, security systems, or IT hardware deployment, with a strong understanding of IP-based systems and networking fundamentals. Experience installing and maintaining video surveillance systems and troubleshooting low voltage infrastructure is highly desired. Familiarity with design plans, schematics, and basic electrical theory is essential, along with the ability to interpret blueprints and CAD drawings.

You should be comfortable working in diverse environments, both indoors and outdoors, and able to handle physical demands such as climbing ladders, lifting equipment, and working at heights. Travel of up to 85 percent may be required depending on project needs. A valid driver's license is required, and industry certifications such as A+, Network+, Security+, BICSI, or similar are a plus.

This position is ideal for a self-starter who takes pride in workmanship, adapts quickly to change, and is committed to delivering reliable, high-performance systems in support of mission-critical operations.

title: Principal Architect (Customer & Revenue Transformation)
description:
This role owns learn, shop, buy, catalog, marketing, sales, CRM and ordering, plus quote-to-cash and AI-enabled engagement. The front-office architect.


GCI's Principal Architect will define, communicate, govern, and advance architecture direction in support of business outcomes, technology modernization, operational effectiveness, and long-term organizational objectives. These roles partner with business, product, engineering, delivery, operations, and leadership stakeholders to translate organizational needs into sustainable solutions, standards, roadmaps, and technology capabilities. The job family provides architectural leadership across products, platforms, systems, services, and business capabilities by developing guidance, patterns, target-state designs, and roadmaps that reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility, and optimize technology investments. Roles apply common architecture principles, governance practices, and industry standards across one or more architecture practice areas, with scope, autonomy, and decision influence increasing by career level.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assess business objectives, customer needs, operational priorities, current-state capabilities, technologies, processes, operating models, risks, dependencies, architecture gaps, technical debt, lifecycle risks, and modernization opportunities.
  • Develop target-state architectures, transition states, and roadmaps that guide technology investment, solution design, and implementation planning.
  • Create architecture artifacts, models, standards, patterns, reference designs, principles, non-functional requirements, and design guardrails; evaluate alternatives and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and governance forums, applying architecture standards, policies, principles, and industry practices.
  • Manage architecture risks, dependencies, technical debt, lifecycle considerations, exceptions, reusable assets, repositories, and technology rationalization efforts.
  • Partner with product, delivery, engineering, and operations teams to provide architecture guidance through planning, design, delivery, and operationalization.
  • Support road mapping, dependency management, implementation sequencing, decision facilitation, trade-off discussions, and alignment to intended architecture outcomes.
  • Improve architecture methods, tools, standards, governance practices, operating models, reusable patterns, communities of practice, mentoring, knowledge sharing, innovation, and simplification.

Discipline-Specific Focus Areas:

The core responsibilities and minimum qualifications outlined in this job description apply across the Architect job family. Discipline-specific responsibilities, technical competencies, and/or preferred qualifications are defined in the applicable addendum. See the corresponding discipline-specific addendum for additional details.

Enterprise Architecture:

Defines enterprise-wide business and technology direction, target-state architecture, capability alignment, governance standards, portfolio strategy, and technology roadmaps. Provides strategic guidance to align investments, modernization, and architecture decisions with long-term organizational objectives.

Business Architecture:

Defines business capabilities, value streams, operating model impacts, business process alignment, organizational dependencies, and business architecture views that connect strategy to execution.

Solution Architecture:

Defines solution direction, design, standards, and roadmaps for business initiatives and technology solutions. Provides guidance to align business needs with scalable, secure, supportable solutions while balancing value, cost, risk, complexity, and long-term sustainability.

Minimum Qualifications:

Career Level:

Recognized organizational authority; sets long-term architecture strategy, principles, and technical direction.

Provides advanced technical and architectural leadership across complex initiatives. Defines and forecasts architecture requirements, drives platform and enterprise capability growth, and serves as a senior consulting resource.

  • Lead complex architecture initiatives and guide cross-functional teams.
  • Define current- and future-state architecture requirements and roadmaps.
  • Provide expert consulting and strategic recommendations to resolve complex challenges.
  • Participate in setting architectural direction and advise on enterprise strategy and development.
  • Develop and enhance architecture documentation, templates, standards, principles, policies, and guidelines.
  • Mentor architects and technical staff and review architecture/design deliverables.

REQUIRED:

* A combination of education and relevant work experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may substitute to meet the total years required on a year-for-year basis.

Education*:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; this requirement is met by candidates who hold an associate or bachelor’s degree.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Data Management, Cybersecurity, or related discipline.

Experience*:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience, including experience in at least two relevant architecture/technology disciplines.
  • Typical scope: Organization. Primary differentiator: Organizational Influence.

Skills:

Guides technology strategy, portfolio alignment, architecture governance, and professional capability development. Influences executive decision-making, investment prioritization, and organization-wide architectural direction. Demonstrated proficiency appropriate to level in: Architecture modeling and documentation; business and technology alignment; systems design and integration; strategy and roadmap development; governance and standards management; relevant cloud, application, integration, infrastructure, security, or data technologies; technology lifecycle planning; and risk and dependency management.

PREFERRED:

  • 10 to 12 years of experience
  • Advanced degree, MBA, or nationally recognized architecture, technology, or executive-level expertise
  • Relevant telecom industry or job-specific certifications.
  • TOGAF, FEAC, Open CA, CITA, SABSA, CCAr, cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP), security certifications (CISSP, CISM), Agile / SAFe certifications, or practice-specific certifications, as applicable.

Work Requirements and Conditions:

description:
This role owns enterprise transformation, the architecture runway, SAFe alignment and AI governance. The spanning architect.

GCI's Principal Architect will define, communicate, govern, and advance architecture direction in support of business outcomes, technology modernization, operational effectiveness, and long-term organizational objectives. These roles partner with business, product, engineering, delivery, operations, and leadership stakeholders to translate organizational needs into sustainable solutions, standards, roadmaps, and technology capabilities. The job family provides architectural leadership across products, platforms, systems, services, and business capabilities by developing guidance, patterns, target-state designs, and roadmaps that reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility, and optimize technology investments. Roles apply common architecture principles, governance practices, and industry standards across one or more architecture practice areas, with scope, autonomy, and decision influence increasing by career level.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assess business objectives, customer needs, operational priorities, current-state capabilities, technologies, processes, operating models, risks, dependencies, architecture gaps, technical debt, lifecycle risks, and modernization opportunities.

Defines enterprise-wide business and technology direction, target-state architecture, capability alignment, governance standards, portfolio strategy, and technology roadmaps. Provides strategic guidance to align investments, modernization, and architecture decisions with long-term organizational objectives.

Defines business capabilities, value streams, operating model impacts, business process alignment, organizational dependencies, and business architecture views that connect strategy to execution.

AI Architecture:

Defines architecture direction for artificial intelligence capabilities, including model and solution patterns, responsible AI guardrails, data and integration dependencies, platform alignment, lifecycle management, risk controls, and adoption guidance.

Who We’re Looking For

Toyota’s Data Science group is seeking a highly motivated and experienced actuary to join the team as an individual contributor, with responsibilities and scope aligned to the candidate’s experience, knowledge, interview performance, and unique skill set. This role will be responsible for developing and implementing pricing and reserving analyses for Toyota’s insurance and protection products. As these products represent a strategic growth area for Toyota, the actuarial function will play a critical role in supporting continued expansion.

The Primary responsibilities include independently partnering with product teams to lead pricing strategy for back-end vehicle purchase and lease products, including Vehicle Maintenance Plans, Key Replacement, and GAP coverage. The role will own monitoring and analysis of key pricing components, including claims and operating expenses, identify and recommend opportunities to refine pricing strategies, and lead related updates, including state rate filings as needed. In addition, the role will lead claim reserving and loss estimate development, while partnering with accounting teams to ensure appropriate risk recognition in accordance with applicable actuarial and accounting standards.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Provide actuarial expertise in the development, review, and implementation of program pricing and filed premium rates.

  • Build, test, and refine predictive models and analytical frameworks that improve forecasting accuracy and business insights

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to support pricing and performance decisions across product lines.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify trends, monitor earnings patterns by product segment, and translate data into actionable recommendations

  • Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders through concise analysis, visualizations, and recommendations

  • Own the quarterly development and delivery of unpaid claims estimates, ensuring soundness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable accounting standards.

  • Monitor earnings patterns by product segment and identify trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for further analysis.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners across departments to support timely decision-making and business objectives.

What You Bring

  • Master’s degree in Actuarial Science, Math, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Actuarial modeling and production analytics experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing pricing, reserving, forecasting, or loss analysis solutions using Python and SQL, with direct contribution to supporting or implementing actuarial models, rate indications, claims estimates, or decision-support tools, and strong familiarity with version control, model documentation, validation/testing, and peer review practices, as well as core statistical and data analysis methods.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to apply sound judgment to complex business and actuarial problems.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence and adapt to change in a collaborative environment.

  • Experience with predictive modeling and analytical methods

Added Bonus If You Have

  • Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS) or equivalent certification

  • Demonstrated experience supporting pricing analyses, rate indications, and state rate filing activities

  • Experience performing reserving analyses, including unpaid claim estimates and related actuarial review

  • Experience conducting pricing reviews and evaluating profitability, trend, and loss performance by product or segment

  • Exposure to warranty, vehicle service contract, or similar insurance/protection products

  • Experience with checks and controls, model governance, or actuarial controls processes

  • Experience developing analytical solutions using Python to support actuarial modeling, reporting, or automation

  • Experience developing analytical solutions with Python

title: Beach Patrol Officer

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. title: Medical Records Analyst I - Part Time, Variable Shift, Mother Baby, Atlantic Health Overlook Medical Center

Maintains on-site files of all birth certificate/fetal death applications by ensuring placement of all documents with baby's medical record as well as any imperative documents in files within the office for future access.

Waséyabek Development Company, LLC (WDC) is wholly owned by the Nottawaseppi Huron Band of the Potawatomi (NHBP), a federally recognized Indian Tribe. WDC is committed to fostering the development of a stable, diversified economy for the Band which will contribute to its long-term wealth and economic self-sufficiency while managing risk and creating quality employment opportunities.


Position Summary

The Chief Executive Officer (CEO) serves as the senior executive leader of Waséyabek, a 100% Tribally owned holding company, and is accountable for establishing the organization's vision, strategic direction, and long-term value creation. The CEO provides enterprise leadership across a diversified portfolio of companies while honoring the Tribe's Seven Grandfather Teachings, culture, and economic development objectives.

As the primary outward-facing executive, the CEO cultivates and maintains trusted relationships with the Tribal Council, Board of Directors, Tribal Membership, business partners, government agencies, investors, lenders, and other strategic stakeholders. The CEO serves as the principal spokesperson for the organization and ensures the company's mission, strategy, and performance are communicated with transparency and integrity.

The CEO is ultimately accountable for the overall performance of the holding company, including strategic growth, capital allocation, organizational capability, governance, and enterprise risk management. Working closely with the COO and executive leadership team, the CEO establishes enterprise priorities while empowering operational leaders to execute effectively.


Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

  • Establish and communicate a clear long-term vision and enterprise strategy aligned with priorities and economic development goals, as captured in 1-yr and 5-yr strategic plans and budgets.
  • Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and growth of portfolio companies.
  • Ensure disciplined capital allocation across investments, operating companies, and strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor market trends and emerging opportunities to strengthen the organization's long-term competitiveness.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Governance & Stakeholder Relations

  • Serve as the primary liaison to the Tribal Council, Board of Directors, and Tribal Membership.
  • Build trusted relationships with external partners, financial institutions, government agencies, industry leaders, and strategic allies.
  • Ensure timely, transparent, and meaningful communication regarding company strategy, performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Support effective governance practices and ensure management recommendations are aligned with Board expectations.


Enterprise Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and retain an exceptional executive leadership team.

  • Foster an executive culture built on integrity, accountability, respect, and collaboration.

Financial Stewardship

  • Maintain overall accountability for enterprise financial performance.
  • Approve enterprise capital deployment and major investment decisions.
  • Balance long-term growth with financial sustainability and risk management.
  • Ensure appropriate governance over financial reporting and resource allocation.


Portfolio Growth

  • Champion strategic acquisitions, partnerships, and new business opportunities.
  • Oversee enterprise-wide strategic planning.
  • Ensure portfolio company operations, budgets and plans align with the holding company's long-term investment philosophy and Five-Year Strategic Plan while preserving appropriate operational autonomy at the portfolio level.


Organizational Culture

  • Model leadership consistent with the Tribe's values and long-term vision
  • Promote ethical leadership, inclusion, accountability, and servant leadership throughout the organization
  • Strengthen organizational culture while supporting entrepreneurial leadership across the portfolio

title: 2027 Graduate - Software Developer or RF Systems Engineer
company: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory
description:
Description

Are you interested in developing software or advancing radar and radio-frequency systems for critical national security challenges?

Do you enjoy understanding how complex systems work, testing ideas against evidence, and turning technical concepts into useful capabilities?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are a multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, mathematicians, and software developers who advance electromagnetic and computer-system capabilities for critical national security missions, with a primary focus on maritime applications. Our work spans radar, electronic warfare (EW), RF communications and propagation, remote sensing, signal and image processing, software development, modeling and simulation, and technical prototyping.

We bring domain experts, analysts, algorithm developers, and software engineers together to carry ideas from initial analysis and concept development through implementation, integration, test, and evaluation. We are seeking engineers, computer scientists, mathematicians, and physicists with strong technical fundamentals who want to contribute in one or both of the areas described below.

We value people who ask thoughtful questions, take initiative when the path forward is not obvious, test assumptions against evidence, seek out expertise when needed, and follow through to technically sound, useful results. The breadth of our work provides opportunities to build deep expertise, contribute across adjacent disciplines, and grow into technical or project leadership.

As a member of our team, you will...

  • Work with multidisciplinary teams to understand operational needs, formulate technical problems, and develop practical approaches.
  • Develop software, models, algorithms, analysis tools, experiments, or prototypes appropriate to the problem.
  • Use simulated, laboratory, and real-world data to understand system behavior, evaluate performance, and guide further development.
  • Contribute across multiple stages of the development lifecycle and clearly communicate your work through code, documentation, technical discussions, presentations, and reports.

Depending on your background, interests, and project needs, your work may emphasize one or both of the following areas:

Software Development

  • Design, implement, test, document, and maintain software applications, analysis tools, and technical prototypes.
  • Develop software that processes sensor data, supports modeling and simulation, or interfaces with hardware, networks, and distributed systems.
  • Apply an understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, networks, protocols, and software behavior to understand how complex systems communicate, perform, and fail and to improve their security and resilience.
  • Work closely with algorithm developers and domain experts to mature technical concepts and research prototypes into reliable, maintainable, and efficient software.

RF Systems Engineering

  • Analyze and model radar, communications, EW, remote-sensing, propagation, and other RF systems.
  • Develop and evaluate signal-processing algorithms for detection, estimation, tracking, classification, and other sensor-data exploitation problems.
  • Use modeling, simulation, laboratory experiments, and field data to characterize system performance, understand limitations, and evaluate new concepts.
  • Develop technical prototypes and support algorithm, software, and hardware integration, test, and evaluation.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

  • Have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, software engineering, mathematics, physics, or another closely related technical field.
  • Have programming experience through coursework, research, employment, or independent projects using languages such as C++, Python, Java, MATLAB, or similar.
  • Have a technical foundation in at least one of the following:
    • software development, computer systems, operating systems, or networking; or
    • electromagnetics, RF systems, communications, signal processing, or the mathematical or physical foundations underlying these areas.
  • Have demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to apply technical fundamentals to unfamiliar problems.
  • Can work independently, collaborate effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team, and communicate technical ideas clearly.
  • Are willing and able to work in closed-area facilities.
  • Are able to obtain an Interim Secret security clearance by your start date and ultimately obtain a Top Secret/SCI security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security-clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

  • Have completed an internship, capstone, thesis, research effort, independent project, or other substantial technical activity related to one or more of the areas described above.
  • Have experience with software-development or system-level computing practices such as object-oriented or systems programming, Linux, version control, automated testing, debugging, continuous integration, performance optimization, computer networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
  • Have coursework or project experience involving electromagnetics, radar, RF systems, communications, EW, propagation, antennas, remote sensing, or signal processing.
  • Have experience with modeling and simulation, scientific computing, numerical methods, data analysis, machine learning, or algorithm development.
  • Have experience integrating software with sensors, hardware, networks, laboratory equipment, or other real-world systems, or evaluating technical approaches through experiments, field tests, or benchmarking.
  • Have demonstrated initiative, follow-through, or emerging leadership by defining next steps, coordinating with others, seeking out needed expertise, and carrying an open-ended technical effort to completion.
  • Hold an active Secret, Top Secret, or higher-level security clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation's most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL's campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities athttps://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please .

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

description:
ABOUT US:

Merrimack Services is a people-first company that leads door-to-door voter mobilization programs across the country, and is working with Progressive Turnout Project, the largest voter contact organization in the country, specifically dedicated to mobilizing the Democratic Party and defending democracy.

OUR MISSION: Rally Maine Democrats to vote!

OPPORTUNITY:

Do you want to make a difference in your community? We are seeking enthusiastic Door Knockers to help get out the vote for Democrats in the upcoming midterm elections! Door knockers will have conversations with voters at their homes and talk to them about the importance of making their voices heard.

As independent contractors, door knockers may complete every part of the program on their own schedule, and have the flexibility to knock on doors and talk to voters when and where they choose–no schedule or time commitment is required. Door Knockers will be paid $150 for each completed door knocking packet, which can be done in a location convenient for you and on your own schedule. It takes the typical Door Knocker about three-four hours to complete each packet, which can be done all at once or over multiple days–it’s up to you! If you successfully complete your first door knocking packet, you’ll be offered additional opportunities.

Door Knocking will begin August 8th and continue through Nov. 3rd. Door Knockers will be able to set their own schedules and working hours.

TASKS:

  • Complete an online briefing that will provide an overview of your contract responsibilities.

  • Travel door-to-door in your community or in a surrounding region and knock doors to speak with voters.

  • Talk to voters about the upcoming election on November 3rd.

  • Door Knocking can be done all at once or over multiple periods of time.

  • Enter data from all conversations with voters into an app on your phone.

HOURS AND PAYMENT:

All Door Knockers will be *independent contractors* and paid $150 per completed door knocking packet. Door Knockers may choose their own door knocking hours, but must complete their full task to be eligible for compensation. Compensation will be provided by direct deposit, or by mailed check if requested.

Manage milestones, dependencies, risks, and delivery outcomes across all workstreams. Drive the program from crawl (current) through walk and run phases with clear measurable gates.

Drive RMCS and Subscription Management maturity to reduce revenue leakage, improve billing accuracy, and enable compliant revenue recognition across all channels.

title: Supply Chain Management Student Program - FCAT
description:
STUDENT PROGRAM FORMAT

This student program supports the Fiat Chrysler Automobiles Transportation (FCAT) team.

This student program follows a format in which participants work remotely during the academic year (September through April) and onsite during the summer (May through August). Remote work must be performed from a location within the United States.

During the academic year, students who reside in the Metro Detroit area are highly encouraged to work onsite at the Detroit, Michigan FCAT Terminal, as their schedule permits.

During the academic year, students are expected to work 24 hours per week during normal business hours, Monday through Friday. Students selected for the program will work with their manager to establish a consistent weekly schedule that fulfills the 24-hour requirement while accommodating their class schedule.

During the summer months (May through August), students are expected to work onsite at the Detroit, Michigan FCAT Terminal. Students may be required to relocate and may work up to 40 hours per week during this period, based on business needs and management discretion. Relocation assistance may be available to students who meet specific eligibility requirements.

Student program cohorts begin quarterly in January, April, June, and September. Students are intended to remain in the program through graduation.

STELLANTIS STUDENT PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS

The Stellantis Student Program offers a unique alternative to traditional summer internships by providing students with the opportunity to work year-round throughout their academic journey. This continuous engagement allows students to apply their classroom learning in real-world settings on a daily basis, fostering deeper integration within their teams and organizations. As they progress through the program, students are empowered to take on increasing levels of responsibility, gaining valuable experience, and making meaningful contributions along the way.

Students will be assigned to a department based on the candidate's background and skill set. The assignments are project-oriented, meaningful to the department, and allow the student to provide valuable contributions. Students experience a sense of personal accomplishment and learn about the corporate business culture through work assignments, structured activities, and exclusive student networking events.

STUDENT PROGRAM BENEFITS

  • Exposure to cutting-edge projects and technologies
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Mentorship from experienced professionals
  • Networking opportunities with peers and leaders
  • Skill development workshops and training sessions
  • Paid US holidays
  • Stellantis Employee Advantage Vehicle Discount Program
  • Eligible students may be able to participate in the Company Vehicle Employee Lease Program

DEPARTMENT DETAILS

The Supply Chain Management organization manages the flow of parts and materials, works with sales and manufacturing to connect demand to production plans and is responsible for parts and vehicle transportation networks. Supply Chain Management - FCAT students will experience comprehensive projects while working within one of the following organizations:

  • Demand Planning: This organization is responsible for retail forecasting, vehicle inventory analysis, reporting, validation, and order allocation.
  • Supply: This organization aligns demand plans with production capacities to develop an optimal vehicle production plan. They are responsible for slotting, scheduling and sequencing orders within our manufacturing facilities as well as order execution, releasing, production programming and capacity sizing. In addition, this organization works to resolve production and supplier constraints, material requirement variances, expedite/crisis management and critical part resolution.
  • Transportation: This organization manages parts and vehicle transportation networks and cost management, as well as operating an internal trucking company. This organization also manages inter-regional flow and customs activity by facilitating the inbound and outbound transportation of parts and material between the global regions.
  • Transformation Projects: This organization serves as the single point of contact for coordination and ownership of all supply related activities for new program launches as well as creating main supply chain assumptions and ensuring cross-functional areas are aligned. They also manage vehicle specification, components and options and supplier development and system integrations.
  • Global Supplier Delivery Crisis Management: This organization works to resolve critical part constraints by working with suppliers to develop production and supply plans.

Selected candidates will gain industry experience, interface with all levels within our supply chain department and apply their coursework to drive results.

title: Director of Quality Assurance

This role assures adherence to all QA programs, Kosher, Halal, Organic and GFCO standards, maintains all documentation associated with all certification bodies and oversees daily QA duties of Mantrose Group, working with quality resources at all locations. This position will also be responsible for managing the SQF audit process and management of documentation required for customers.

  • Manages all governing agency certifications & audits (Kosher, Organic, Halal, USDA, FDA Biodegradable).

title: Senior Data Engineer, Supply Chain & AI
description:
The Staples Enterprise Data team builds and governs scalable data products that enable trusted, timely decision-making. Within Data & Analytics, the Supply Chain Data team partners across transportation, fulfillment, inventory, delivery, returns, product, analytics, and engineering to create dependable foundations for operational reporting, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled experiences.

As a Senior Data Engineer I, you will design, build, test, deploy, and operate modern data products for Staples Supply Chain. You will translate complex operational needs into governed, reusable datasets and pipelines, with Snowflake and dbt serving as the primary production stack. You will also help extend the platform for AI-ready data products and conversational analytics using Snowflake and Databricks capabilities where they provide clear value. In this hands-on role, you will own solutions from design through production, build strong cross-functional partnerships, and improve reliability, data quality, security, and measurable business outcomes. Your work will help supply chain teams find and trust the data they need to make faster, better-informed decisions while enabling future analytics and AI experiences.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, develop, test, and support batch, event-driven, and near-real-time pipelines for supply chain data ingestion, integration, transformation, and curation.
  • Build modular, well-documented dbt models in Snowflake using reusable patterns, incremental processing, testing, lineage, and performance-conscious design.
  • Create governed, analytics-ready data products that support transportation, fulfillment, inventory, delivery promise, last-mile delivery, returns, and related supply chain decisions.
  • Partner with supply chain product owners, analysts, application teams, data scientists, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, define data contracts, and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Build reliable data foundations for AI and agentic workflows by creating governed datasets, semantic context, metadata, evaluation data, and secure production interfaces.
  • Use Databricks capabilities such as Spark, notebooks, workflows, Unity Catalog, and Genie when they are the right fit for scalable engineering, governed data products, and conversational analytics.
  • Implement automated data quality checks, unit and integration tests, reconciliation controls, observability, alerting, and production support practices.
  • Optimize Snowflake compute, storage, SQL, and dbt workloads for performance, reliability, and responsible cost management.
  • Apply software engineering practices including Git-based version control, peer review, CI/CD, environment promotion, secrets management, and infrastructure automation.
  • Create reusable frameworks and components while reducing technical debt and improving engineering standards across the team.
  • Document architecture, data models, lineage, operational procedures, and support expectations so solutions are transparent and maintainable.
  • Lead assigned initiatives from design through production with minimal oversight, communicate risks early, and contribute actively to design and code reviews.

What you bring to the table:

  • A strong ownership mindset and the ability to move from ambiguous business needs to practical, supportable data solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical choices, tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes to technical and nontechnical partners.
  • Curiosity, sound judgment, and a continuous-learning mindset in a fast-moving data and AI environment.
  • The ability to balance delivery speed with quality, governance, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Comfort working independently while collaborating across product, engineering, analytics, and business teams.

What’s needed- Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data analytics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on data engineering or analytics engineering experience delivering production data solutions, or equivalent experience demonstrated through progressively complex technical ownership.
  • Experience working with supply chain data or closely related operational domains, with working knowledge of one or more areas such as transportation, fulfillment, inventory, order lifecycle, delivery, returns, reverse logistics, or distribution operations.
  • Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience designing scalable data models, ELT pipelines, and cloud data warehouse solutions.
  • Production experience with Snowflake, including data modeling, workload optimization, access patterns, and operational support.
  • Production experience with dbt, including modular model design, tests, documentation, lineage, incremental strategies, and deployment practices.
  • Hands-on programming experience with Python and working knowledge of PySpark or Apache Spark for distributed data processing.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud, including cloud storage, identity and access patterns, orchestration, monitoring, and secure integration with modern data platforms.
  • Experience implementing data quality, monitoring, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and support controls for business-critical pipelines.
  • Experience delivering multiple concurrent initiatives in an Agile product or engineering environment.

What’s needed- Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, notebooks, jobs or workflows, and governed data-product development.
  • Experience enabling Databricks Genie or Genie Code, semantic layers, natural-language analytics, or AI-assisted data engineering workflows.
  • Experience building data foundations for machine learning, generative AI, retrieval, or agentic applications, including metadata, data contracts, evaluation, and production monitoring.
  • Experience with orchestration and streaming technologies such as Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Kafka, or cloud-native equivalents.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, containerized workloads, APIs, event schemas, and secure integration patterns.
  • Knowledge of dimensional modeling, data vault or domain-oriented data products, master data, data governance, privacy, and role-based access control.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, improving standards, and influencing technical direction through design reviews and reusable patterns.
  • Background in retail, B2B, B2C, ecommerce, logistics, or high-volume operational data environments.

We Offer:

  • Inclusive culture with associate-led Business Resource Groups
  • 22 days of PTO and Holiday Schedule (7 observed paid holidays + 1 floating holiday)
  • Online and Retail Discounts, Company Match 401(k), Physical and Mental Health Wellness programs, and more!

The salary range represents the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The specific base pay may be influenced by a variety of factors to include the candidate's experience, skill set, education, geography, business considerations, and internal equity. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for bonuses, or other forms of variable compensation.

title: Team Lead - Outbound Operations
description:
The Outbound Team Lead contributes to meeting Langham goals of exceptional customer service, quality, process improvement, and profitability by ensuring that all designated finished good items and quantity of items are correctly picked, packed, and shipped according to client specifications, eliminating errors and claims. The Lead is a direct link between the associates and the supervisor, distributing daily work orders, ensuring orders are correctly completed and recorded, and ensuring that shipments get out according to schedule.

The Lead ensures productivity and quality goals are met on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis, maximizing productivity and efficiency through the use of RF guns and cross training. This position will assist and/or lead training efforts for new hires within their department and cross train veterans in other functions; and is charged with planning for adequate manpower to meet daily schedules and appropriately matching associate skills with duties of the job.

The Outbound Lead delegates investigation of problems, such as mispicks, packing errors, QC findings, pallet load discrepancies, and quantity variances. The Outbound Lead also ensures that all work is done according to safety and security guidelines, with particular attention to guidelines regarding hazardous materials and those mandated by the Department of Homeland Security.


Key Outcomes Expected

All Warehouse Associates, regardless of assigned area or duties, are expected to:

  • Operate all equipment, machinery, forklifts, etc., in an efficient, safe, and productive manner;
  • Work according to customer orders and specifications;
  • Meet established quality and productivity metrics;
  • Make daily checks and provide basic maintenance on machines as assigned;
  • Keep work areas neat and clean.
  • Communicate with the customer to take care of inaccuracies in shipments.
  • Ensure inventory accuracy by entering material into data base, ideally, via the use of an RF gun.
  • Provides direct assistance to the Supervisor by helping assign workloads and expedite workflow
  • Ensure quality checks are made at the appropriate stages of receiving and put away
  • Effectively perform basic lead responsibilities of coaching, training, performance.
  • Ensure a team environment in the warehouse; cross train all employees in the department.
  • Identify and make arrangements for appropriate manpower needs on a daily basis and get approval from the Supervisor to issue overtime requirements as needed.
  • Prepare daily work schedules and issue written and oral instructions, ensuring that orders (pick tickets) are distributed in a timely manner.
  • Assign daily tasks as appropriate based on individual team member skills (i.e. picking, driving, banding, QC, cycle counts, receiving, put away, etc.).
  • Maximize efficiency through the use of RF guns in all areas (where appropriate)
  • Assist employees with work process problems
  • Monitor warehouse associates’ productivity and make adjustments as needed.
  • Ensure hand-picked orders are correctly picked and packed and ready for shipment (generally UPS or Fed Ex)
    • Using the pick tickets, hand pick and pack boxes and prepare for shipping.
    • Quality check all parts against part numbers and printed orders to ensure accuracy.
    • Pack items into the most appropriate sized box.
    • Seal boxes and prepare for shipping.

Critical Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrates ability to verbally and/or visually communicate with others
  • Able to read, interpret and use forms and other visual instructions in order to perform required work
  • Demonstrate effective verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
  • Proactive in anticipating and alerting others to problems with projects or processes
  • High detail orientation and accuracy
  • Takes initiative and needs little supervision.
  • Able to prioritize, organize tasks and time. Performs responsibilities efficiently and timely.
  • Can adjust to changing workloads and hours.
  • Works well in a team environment and as part of a team.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in basic mathematics
  • Ability to influence others to meet goals.
  • Demonstrates basic supervisory abilities of coaching and training.
  • Demonstrates basic computer skills.
  • Proficient in operating all forms of forklift equipment.

Experience and Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • At least 1 year previous experience in a comparable position. Forklift drivers must be able to pass forklift certification training.


Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • Must be able to operate a variety of equipment: stand up forklift, sit down forklift and order picker. Physical movements including bending, stooping, and lifting up to 50 pounds as part of daily work routine. Must be able to operate computer equipment. Work is performed in a warehouse environment subject to temperature variances that include occasional function in a cold environment.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The Outbound Team Lead may be required to perform other related duties assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. Langham reserves the right to modify job responsibilities and expectations as business demands evolve.

title: CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MANAGER
description:
Job Description & Requirements

The Construction Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all construction activities to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with design specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The role involves managing site teams, liaising with clients, consultants, and subcontractors, and ensuring efficient use of materials and resources.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversee and manage all stages of construction works, including planning, scheduling, and execution.
  • Coordinate and supervise site engineers, supervisors, and workers to achieve project objectives.
  • Review project drawings, specifications, and contract documents to ensure compliance with technical and quality standards.
  • Monitor progress and provide regular updates to management and clients on project status, milestones, and potential issues.
  • Ensure all site activities comply with Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) regulations and environmental requirements.
  • Liaise with consultants, architects, and authorities for project coordination, inspections, and approvals.
  • Prepare project budgets, monitor costs, and ensure resource efficiency.
  • Manage procurement schedules for materials, equipment, and subcontractor works.
  • Conduct site meetings, resolve technical and operational challenges promptly.
  • Ensure timely completion and proper documentation for handover, testing, and commissioning stages.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree or Diploma in Civil, Structural, Building, or Construction Engineering.
  • Minimum 5–10 years of relevant experience in construction management, preferably in civil, structural, or architectural works.
  • Strong knowledge of construction methods, project management, and safety practices.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Proficient in project scheduling software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera) and MS Office applications.
  • Familiar with BCA, LTA, and relevant Singapore regulatory requirements.
  • Possession of a valid WSH Safety Supervisor / bizSAFE / BCSS certification (advantage).
  • Class 3 driving license preferred.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Full-time, site-based position.
  • Working hours: As per project schedule (may include weekends/public holidays depending on site progress).
  • Locations: Various construction sites across Singapore.

title: 5103 - VAC Purchasing Supervisor
location: Green Cove Springs, Florida, United States
description:
Purchasing Supervisor Job Description

Position Summary
The Purchasing Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the procurement of raw
materials, components, equipment, and indirect supplies required to support
manufacturing operations. This role supervises purchasing personnel, manages supplier
relationships, monitors inventory levels, negotiates pricing and contracts, and ensures
materials are available to meet production schedules while maintaining quality and cost
objectives.

Key Responsibilities
Procurement & Supplier Management
• Supervise daily purchasing activities and purchasing team performance.
• Source and qualify suppliers to ensure quality, delivery, and cost requirements are
met.
• Negotiate pricing, contracts, payment terms, and service agreements with
vendors.
• Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships to support operational needs.
• Monitor supplier performance through key metrics including on-time delivery,
quality, and responsiveness.
• Lead supplier issue resolution and corrective action initiatives.

Demand Planning, Forecasting & Analytics
• Analyze historical material usage, purchasing activity, production schedules, and
demand to identify trends and future requirements.
• Use ERP/MRP data, forecasts, open orders, lead times, safety stocks, and
inventory levels to anticipate material needs.
• Develop purchasing plans that support future production while minimizing excess
inventory.
• Identify potential shortages, excess inventory, obsolete material, and supply risks
before they impact operations.
• Evaluate changes in demand and production schedules and adjust purchasing
plans accordingly.
• Analyze numerical data and purchasing trends to determine appropriate order
quantities, timing, safety stocks, and reorder points.
• Create and maintain reports, spreadsheets, dashboards, and other tools to
support purchasing and management decisions.
• Compare historical results to future requirements and adjust strategies based on
actual usage and changing business needs.

Inventory & Production Support
• Coordinate material purchases to support production schedules and customer
demand.
• Monitor inventory levels to minimize stockouts and excess inventory.
• Collaborate with Production Planning, Operations, Engineering, and Quality
teams to ensure material availability.
• Review material requirements planning (MRP) reports and execute purchasing
strategies accordingly.
• Support cycle counts and inventory accuracy initiatives.
Cost Management
• Identify and implement cost reduction opportunities through strategic sourcing
and negotiation.
• Analyze purchasing trends, market conditions, and supplier pricing.
• Monitor spending against budgets and purchasing targets.
• Generate cost savings reports and procurement performance metrics.

Team Leadership
• Supervise, train, and develop purchasing staff.
• Establish departmental goals and performance expectations.
• Conduct employee performance reviews and coaching sessions.
• Promote continuous improvement and best practices within the purchasing
function.

Compliance & Process Improvement
• Ensure compliance with company purchasing policies and procedures.
• Maintain accurate purchasing records, contracts, and supplier documentation.
• Support quality management and regulatory compliance requirements.
• Lead initiatives to improve procurement processes, system utilization, and
operational efficiency.

Qualifications
Education
• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration,
Operations Management, or related field preferred.
• Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
Experience
• 5+ years of purchasing or procurement experience in a manufacturing
environment.
• 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience preferred.
• Experience with ERP/MRP systems and supply chain processes.
• Experience with inventory analysis, forecasting, material planning, or demand
planning preferred.

Skills & Competencies
• Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
• Knowledge of manufacturing operations, inventory control, and procurement
best practices.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Knowledge of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement principles
preferred.

Key Metrics
• Material availability and production support.
• Supplier on-time delivery performance.
• Inventory turns and inventory accuracy.
• Cost savings achieved through sourcing initiatives.
• Purchase price variance (PPV).
• Supplier quality performance.
• Procurement cycle time.

Working Conditions
• Manufacturing and office environment.

title: Security Officer - Full Time - Day
description:
Overview

Our team members are the heart of what makes us better.

At Hackensack Meridian Health we help our patients live better, healthier lives — and we help one another to succeed. With a culture rooted in connection and collaboration, our employees are team members. Here, competitive benefits are just the beginning. It’s also about how we support one another and how we show up for our community.

Together, we keep getting better - advancing our mission to transform healthcare and serve as a leader of positive change.

The Security Officer will assume responsibility for the safety and well-being of patients, team members, physicians, visitors, students and Medical Center property. These responsibilities include but are not limited to continuous surveillance, reporting and documenting all incidents and remaining sensitive to the need for delivery of quality guest services and assistance to all persons visiting the Medical Center.

Responsibilities

A day in the life of a Security Officer at Hackensack Meridian Health includes:

  • Make continuous patrols throughout the Medical Center to observe and take corrective action regarding violations and detrimental conditions related to security and safety of patients, visitors, team members, students and property either on foot or in a vehicle. Security Team Members act as visible deterrence to crime and prohibited activities.
  • Respond to calls and codes for security assistance by any person within the Medical Center and take proper action including responding quickly and effectively to emergent and non-emergent situations including all Codes in a timely manner.
  • Provide continuous coverage of the Medical Center, controlling access to the area and assisting patients and visitors as necessary. Challenges unauthorized persons in a professional and courteous manner, issues appropriate passes, and enforces policies and procedures of the Medical Center.
  • Maintain and control access to all facilities owned or operated, leased or owned by Hackensack Meridian Health.
  • Expedite and ensure safe flow of traffic through the Medical Center parking lots while enforcing parking regulations.
  • Conduct preliminary and/or detailed investigations of all unusual occurrences falling under the realm of security matters including but not limited to interviewing witnesses, obtaining signatures and collecting accurate information.
  • Respond to fire drills and perform fire watches; facilitate fire department inspections scheduled by regional safety function
  • Provide escorts to team members and visitor vehicles as requested within jurisdiction.
  • Report for duty in a clean and complete Medical Center issued uniform, including photo identification badge and security officer breast badge.
  • Make continuous inspections of outer buildings, grounds, and parking lots. Works with facilities for detection of fire and life safety hazards
  • Inspects all packages leaving the Medical Center when necessary and according to policy.
  • Prepares and submits computerized security incident reports before the end of shift.
  • Completes and submits a daily activity log at completion of tour of duty.
  • Maintains all departmental security equipment in good operating condition and reports all damage immediately to the Security Leader.
  • Always keeps Security Leaders informed of all matters pertinent to safety and security conditions. 16. Has knowledge of and abides by all Medical Center Code of Conduct regulations and departmental procedures and policies including parking regulations.
  • Completes all in-service training, lectures and programs as assigned.
  • Attend all mandatory meetings (departmental or special).
  • Subject to all weather conditions; will be required to work in all areas of the Medical Center, including parking lots, grounds and outer buildings as requested.
  • Will be required to perform duties as assigned by Security leadership and execute physical security component of emergency management plan upon occurrence of an emergency
  • Other duties and/or projects as assigned.
  • Adheres to HMH Organizational competencies and standards of behavior.

Qualifications

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • High School diploma, general equivalency diploma (GED), and/or GED equivalent programs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient computer skills that may include but are not limited to Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite platforms.

Education, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred:

  • 2 years of college credits.
  • Previous experience as Security Officer or Law Enforcement experience.

Licenses and Certifications Required:

  • Possession of a valid driver's license
  • Full scale State, County, Federal, and License Check will be conducted every other year.

If you feel that the above description speaks directly to your strengths and capabilities, then please apply today!

Starting Minimum Rate

Minimum rate of $20.68 Hourly

The posted rate of pay in this job posting is a reasonable good faith estimate of the minimum base pay for this role at the time of posting in accordance with the New Jersey Pay Transparency Act and does not reflect the full value of our market-competitive total rewards package. title: Privileging Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Access TeleCare is the national leader in acute specialty telemedicine, having launched more than 2,600 telemedicine programs and partnered with 1 in 5 U.S. hospitals across all 50 states. As a pioneer in tech-enabled virtual care for the last 20+ years, the company has grown to now deliver care in more than 1 million patient encounters annually across multiple specialty service lines, including behavioral health, neurology, hospitalist medicine, pulmonary and critical care, maternal-fetal medicine, infectious disease, cardiology, and nephrology. The virtual care provided by Access TeleCare is crucial in ensuring timely and high-quality healthcare coverage across a geographic area that represents more than 65% of the U.S. population, approximately 216 million Americans, many of whom live in medically underserved, vulnerable, or rural areas. As the first and longest-standing telemedicine organization to receive The Joint Commission’s Gold Seal of Approval in 2006, Access TeleCare is leading the way to a better healthcare delivery system with clinically excellent tech-enabled services.

We love what we do, and if you want to know more about our vision, mission, and values, go to to check us out.

The Opportunity

The Privileging Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for client facility Medical Staff Offices (MSOs), ensuring physicians are properly privileged and reappointments are completed in accordance with facility requirements, typically every two to three years. Throughout the privileging cycle, this role partners closely with Medical Staff Offices, Credentialing, and Licensing teams to support provider onboarding and ongoing compliance. The coordinator is responsible for maintaining accurate, complete, and up-to-date provider credentialing files while facilitating timely communication and issue resolution across all stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Review applications/re-appointments to ensure accuracy and completion
  • Use credentialing system to process all facility privilege - Salesforce
  • Follow up with facilities and answer any requests they have to complete privileging files for approval
  • Make sure applications have been received, document all progress, and ensure all deadlines are met
  • Escalate issues to management as necessary
  • Ensure work and product standards are of the highest level
  • Correspond with physicians as needed to obtain information in a professional manner
  • Other duties as assigned

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or high school diploma with 1-2 years’ experience in medical staff field
  • CPCS preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate and provide exemplary customer service via verbal and written means with internal customers, hospitals, and vendors in a diverse and distributed team environment
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft office programs, communication, and collaboration tools in various operating systems
  • Ability to balance multiple projects concurrently, follow through and focus on details
  • Understanding of medical terminology
  • Ability to work effectively under deadlines and self-manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and time management skills
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of Joint Commission Standards
  • Ability to thrive in a high growth, fast-paced organization and 100% Remote based environment
  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time

Why Join Access TeleCare

  • 100% Remote Work
  • Health Insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, life, and 401(k)
  • Paid Time Off, Sick Leave, and wellness days — because we value both performance and balance
  • Culture of ownership, transparency, and results where the best ideas rise
  • Opportunity to directly impact patient access nationwide

Access TeleCare, is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Aldar Academies are currently seeking an outstanding Teacher - EYFS with responsibility for Head of Year for Mamoura British Academy in Abu Dhabi commencing January 2027.

Mamoura British Academy is a British curriculum, mixed gender school until Year 8 and a girl’s only school from Year 9 onwards. It is located in a state of the art building in the heart of Abu Dhabi. We strive for excellence in all that we do through our high expectations and commitment to ensuring that we provide high quality learning opportunities for our students. Our vision is to be ‘a sustainable and innovative learning community, where we nurture all learners through our bespoke Mamoura British Academy DNA .’ This Mamoura Learner, Teacher and Values DNA is at the heart of the school community.

The successful candidates will be closely aligned with our core values and ethos and possess a genuine understanding and appreciation of the values of the region.

A. Qualities and attributes:

· A supportive and approachable team player who can collaborate effectively with others.

· A good communicator at all levels.

· A commitment to developing positive relationships with all members of the school community.

· A desire to be part of a school that strives for excellence in all that we do.

· Passion to instil awe and wonder to the learning of young students.

B. Leadership:

· Contribute to the whole school vision and the strategic direction of the school.

· Lead team and planning meetings to ensure that the team is well informed, organised and successful.

· Ensure that the learning opportunities for the children are innovative, purposeful and challenging across all curriculum areas.

· Promote the pastoral care and well-being of children within the year group by ensuring all systems and procedures are followed.

· Effectively line manage a team of teachers and teaching assistants to ensure they are performing successfully against the UAE Professional Teacher Standards.

· Contribute to the school’s Monitoring, Evaluating and Reporting processes and quality assure all aspects of provision within the year group to ensure we are consistently promoting high standards and expectations.

· Contribute to the school’s Professional Development cycle helping to upskill and share good practice amongst fellow teachers.

· Actively participate in the school’s bespoke Middle Leader training programme.

C. Teaching and learning:

· To be able to teach all areas of the Primary English National Curriculum.

· Organising the classroom, learning resources and creating displays to encourage a positive learning environment and support the development of the Mamoura British Academy USP in this area.

· Planning, preparing and presenting lessons that cater for the needs of the whole ability range within the class.

· Providing support and interventions for students with EAL or who have additional learning needs.

· Motivating pupils with enthusiastic, imaginative presentation.

· Evidencing children’s work and learning in line with the Mamoura British Academy Marking and Feedback policy.

· Being reflective of lessons taught and student progress, and adjusting planning, curriculum and continuous provision to reflect this.

· Meeting with other professionals such as speech and language therapists, occupational therapists and educational psychologists, if required.

· Ensuring that the Mamoura British Academy Teacher and Learner DNA language and attributes are being embedded throughout the curriculum.

· Contribute to the development of teaching and learning across the school by sharing best practice, participating in school CPD and T&L initiatives.

· Using data provided by assessments to influence further planning and interventions.

· Providing regular feedback to parents and carers on a student’s progress at Parent Teacher Conferences and other meetings.

· To plan, prepare and contribute to termly Pupil Progress meetings.

E. Behaviour management and duties:

· To follow the Mamoura British Academy behaviour management policy and promote the TRACK Values to set high expectations.

· Manage classes effectively, using approaches which are appropriate to pupils’ needs in order to inspire, motivate and challenge pupils.

· Maintain good relationships with pupils and parents and follow the school’s procedures to manage and challenge any rare occurrences of unwanted behaviour.

· Carry out playground and other duties in a punctual, interactive and proactive manner.

· Ensure that any concerns relating to behaviour & Safeguarding are accurately followed up on and logged on CPOMS.

Minimum Qualification

· A Bachelor degree in Education or Bachelor Degree in a related subject with PGCE or equivalent teaching qualification

Minimum Experience

· Minimum of 3 years teaching experience in the English National Curriculum.

· Leadership experience desirable.

Job Specific Knowledge & Skills

· Teaching across the age ability range with proven success

· Passion for education, teaching, and a belief in the potential of every student
