title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
SENIOR FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Java / JVM | Distributed Systems | Microservices | Kafka | APIs | Cloud

Cape Town OR JHB -Hybrid Working Arrangement

12-Month Contract possibility conversion

Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead

We are looking for a highly technical Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a large-scale financial technology environment working on business-critical, high-volume systems.

This is not a traditional CRUD development role. We need an engineer who understands systems end-to-end — including applications, APIs, databases, messaging, distributed services, observability and production operations.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable, resilient distributed applications
  • Work across backend and frontend development
  • Develop and integrate REST APIs and microservices
  • Work with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms
  • Design and optimise databases, queries and application logic
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis
  • Implement effective monitoring, logging, alerting and observability
  • Build and optimise systems handling high transaction volumes
  • Contribute to architectural and technical design decisions
  • Develop clean, maintainable and reusable code
  • Implement automated testing and CI/CD practices
  • Work with cloud and containerised environments
  • Participate in code reviews and engineering standards
  • Mentor developers and help raise the team's technical capability

Technical Experience

We are looking for strong experience in:

  • 6 - 10 years' commercial software development
  • Full-stack software development
  • Java / JVM technologies — highly preferred
  • Spring Boot or equivalent backend frameworks
  • Distributed systems and microservice architecture
  • REST APIs and system integration
  • Event-driven architecture and messaging
  • Kafka — highly advantageous
  • Strong SQL and relational database knowledge, including query optimisation
  • Production troubleshooting and debugging
  • Observability, monitoring, logging and alerting
  • AWS and/or Azure
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • CI/CD and automated testing
  • Software design principles, design patterns and clean architecture

Experience with other JVM technologies such as Scala will also be considered.

Strong .NET engineers will be considered where they can demonstrate genuine experience with distributed systems, messaging, cloud, APIs, databases and large-scale production environments.

What We're Looking For

The right person will:

  • Think beyond individual applications and understand systems end-to-end
  • Understand how applications, APIs, messaging, databases and infrastructure interact
  • Have experience working on real production systems at scale
  • Be able to diagnose complex technical problems independently
  • Understand scalability, resilience, failure handling and performance
  • Be comfortable going deep into the technical detail
  • Be able to explain why a technical solution works, not just which technology was used
  • Take ownership of system reliability and production performance
  • Be comfortable mentoring and supporting other engineers
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly with both technical and business stakeholders

Banking / Payments Experience

Experience in banking, payments, fintech or other high-volume financial environments is highly advantageous.

However, financial-services experience is not mandatory.

We will consider engineers from other environments where they have worked on large-scale, distributed, transaction-heavy or business-critical systems.

This Role Will Suit You If...

title: Master Thesis: AI Receiver
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join Ericsson for a master’s thesis investigating how neural-network-based AI receivers can adapt to changing wireless conditions in live radio access networks. You will explore unsupervised and self-supervised online adaptation strategies that enable a physical shared channel (PxSCH) receiver to maintain performance across varying configurations and propagation environments without requiring labeled training data.


What you will do:

You will review research on online learning, self-supervised training, and domain adaptation for AI receivers. Using field-trial data, you will analyze how receiver performance changes across different PxSCH configurations and channel conditions and identify the causes of performance degradation. You will then design, implement, and evaluate one or more online adaptation methods against a static baseline. The evaluation will consider receiver accuracy, link-level performance such as BLER and throughput, adaptation speed, computational cost, and model stability. The thesis will conclude with a presentation of your results and recommendations to the Ericsson research team.

The skills you bring:

  • Background in electrical engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or similar
  • Machine learning and deep learning (ANN, CNNs, training methodologies)
  • Wireless communications fundamentals (OFDM, channel estimation, MIMO)
  • Programming proficiency in Python (PyTorch, Jax or TensorFlow)
  • Background in signal processing is a plus

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

description:
Come join us and make a difference in the world!

Reporting to the Head of DevOps, you'll provide technical leadership across cloud infrastructure, platform engineering and automation while staying hands-on in delivery. The Head of DevOps owns the overall function and people leadership across our UK and Pune capabilities. You'll be the senior technical leader, working alongside the engineers.

You won't lead from the sidelines. You'll be in the infrastructure, pipelines and code alongside the team, shaping our DevOps practice and turning good engineering principles into solutions that work in production.

You'll design and evolve secure, scalable and cost-effective infrastructure, keeping our platforms reliable, observable and efficient. Working with engineering, security and product teams, you'll take difficult technical challenges from design through to a stable production outcome.

If you want real technical depth with genuine leadership, where you can set direction and still know what's happening under the hood, this is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own our AWS and Azure infrastructure. You'll set practical standards for security, reliability, scalability, performance, compliance, cost and resource use, working with architects, developers, security and product teams to ensure they work in the real world.
  • Write and maintain the Terraform that runs our infrastructure. Build reusable modules, manage state and environments, and keep documentation up to date. Use the consoles to diagnose problems, but make lasting changes through code, review and controlled deployment.
  • Get hands-on with our CircleCI pipelines, creating standards practical enough to be adopted, not simply written down. Embed secret detection, dependency and container scanning, software bills of materials, code-quality checks and supply-chain controls, then help teams fix the risks that matter.

  • Ensure we can recover as effectively as we can run. Help maintain and test our backup, resilience and disaster-recovery arrangements, using Python or Bash to remove repetitive work and improve consistency.
  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews and hands-on problem-solving. Spread knowledge, share responsibility and avoid creating reliance on a single person.

title: Style Director
description:
Z SUPPLY | Style Director

REPORTS TO: VP Creative + Operations. Dotted line reporting to Design Director.

Works in close partnership with Creative Marketing, Design, Merchandising, E-commerce, and Wholesale.


Z SUPPLY is an established California Women’s lifestyle apparel brand that is leading the space for casual, comfortable style. Located in the heart of Orange County, we are passionate about staying true to our roots and living a life of good vibes in and out of the office. We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Buyer to join our Buying team.


The Role

Z SUPPLY is hiring its first-ever Style Director — a newly created role that reflects where the brand is going, not just where it's been. This is not a shoot stylist. This is a brand architect.

This role will own the visual and stylistic identity of Z SUPPLY across every touchpoint: campaigns, e-commerce, social, wholesale, editorial, events, and product. They will work at the intersection of brand storytelling, product design, and content — ensuring that everything Z SUPPLY puts into the world looks, feels, and moves as one coherent brand.

This role works in close partnership with the Creative, Design, Merchandising, and Marketing. This role requires a style visionary and an executor — setting the direction and ensuring its execution[1] .


What You'll Own

Brand Style Identity & Direction

  • Establish a clear, ownable styling POV that distinguishes the brand from its peers in the casual lifestyle space.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive Brand Style Guide that governs how Z SUPPLY product looks across all channels: styling, color, texture, silhouette, composition, and overall visual world.
  • Ensure that customers experience a cohesive Z SUPPLY brand - from the way the product is designed and styled to how it appears online, in boutiques, at events, and across marketing channels.
  • Partner with Design and Creative/Marketing to translate seasonal design direction into a cohesive visual brand point of view - from mood boards and concept development through to final execution.
  • Identify emerging trends, cultural shifts, and competitor movements synthesizing them into actionable direction that keeps Z SUPPLY relevant
  • Drive operational excellence through effective planning, prioritization, and execution across multiple concurrent campaigns, shoots, launches, and channel needs while meeting critical deadlines.


Product Obsession & Creative Development

  • Be the brand's most obsessive product eye - deeply understanding each season’s line - from fit, fabrication, and design intent of every piece - translating that into styling choices that serve both brand definition and sell-through.
  • Partner with Merchandising, Design, and Marketing to identify both product gaps and product priorities and hero categories — informed by trend, category definition, past performance — anchoring seasonal storytelling, integrated campaigns, and monthly go-to-market planning.
  • Partner with Product and Merchandising throughout the seasonal design process to bring styling and consumer perspective to silhouette, color palette, fabrication, and assortment decisions.
  • Contribute to how product is photographed, styled, and presented – from wholesale to e-commerce - to tell a compelling story. Champion the idea that how a product is styled is inseparable from how it sells.
  • Attend key product reviews and stay aligned with Design and Merchandising on seasonal readiness, product flow, and sample availability - ensuring creative timing alignment each season
  • Identify opportunities to redefine how core and hero products are presented; elevating basics and essentials through styling choices that feel fresh and intentional, not generic.


Campaign, E-Commerce & Content Execution

  • Lead styling for all brand campaigns, e-commerce photography, and social content — from pre-production (pre-styles, mood development) through on-set execution and post-production review, managing looks and outfit composition on-set with photographers and creative teams.
  • Oversee styling for all social content creation, ensuring that TikTok, Instagram, influencer, talent briefs + content reflect the same aesthetic sensibility
  • Manage external freelance stylists, wardrobe assistants as needed (in partnership with Production)
  • Review and approve all creative output for styling consistency before publication — serving as the final eye on visual assets that carry the brand.
  • Manage and continuously develop the brand's prop and styling archive — fabrics, textures, objects, and styling elements that reflect Z SUPPLY’s visual world.
  • Ensure key category + product investments, and major launches are prominently represented across seasonal campaigns, e-commerce, paid media, wholesale, and customer-facing experiences.
  • Partner with Marketing and E-commerce to constantly evaluate campaign, content, and product-storytelling performance / resonance to refine future styling direction


Wholesale & Retail Visual Presentation

  • Partner with the Creative Director, Wholesale to develop styling standards and selling tools — lookbooks, merch lineups, linesheets, trade show presentations, SMU assets, and in-store/boutique guidelines — ensure Z SUPPLY's visual world extends cohesively into wholesale and retail.
  • As needed, contribute to trade show booth design and execution, ensuring the physical presentation of Z Supply reflects the same craft and intention
  • Contribute to visual POV for Wholesale events inclusive of recommending brand elements and decor
  • As needed, attend tentpole Trade Shows to support sales team


Brand: PR, Influencer, Events

  • Partner with PR + Influencer to develop a monthly lookbooks for gifting and pitching highlighting key products and Z SUPPLY trends
  • Collaborate with the Influencer Marketing and Social to ensure creator partnership briefs authentically align to the Z SUPPLY brand while aligning to key product priorities / investments


What You'll Bring

Experience & Expertise

– 8-10 years of styling experience in fashion, with a portfolio that demonstrates consistent, evolved aesthetic vision across multiple brands or seasons — not just beautiful individual images.

– Deep familiarity with the women's lifestyle, casual, and contemporary fashion market — understanding of the Z SUPPLY

– Proven experience leading styling across multiple content types simultaneously: campaign, e-commerce, social, and wholesale.

– Experience collaborating with product and merchandising teams on design development

– Track record of building and evolving a brand's visual identity, not just executing someone else's direction.

– Experience managing freelance talent and external creative partners; confident giving direction while maintaining collaborative relationships.

– Familiarity with social-first content aesthetics and how styling must adapt across formats and channels without abandoning brand integrity.


Who You Are

– You have a genuine, specific point of view about style and the confidence to advocate for it while remaining open to collaboration.

– You are as obsessed with the product as you are with the image. You read a garment before you style it. You know what it wants to be.

– You think about brand identity holistically — copy, color, casting, texture, and tone are all part of the same conversation for you.

– You're organized and have a high capacity without being rigid. You adapt without losing the creative thread.

– You are a strong communicator who can articulate visual decisions clearly to non-creative stakeholders.

– You are culturally fluent — you know what's happening in fashion, in social media, in the broader culture — and you filter it through a Z Supply lens rather than chasing it.

– You care about the customer. You don't dress the brand for your own taste. You dress it for the woman who wears it.


Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $160,000 – $175,000 annually, commensurate with experience.


At Z SUPPLY, departments work cross-functionally enabling everyone to further their knowledge and expertise in an inclusive, supportive environment that is committed to healthy work/life balance, peer mentorship, and community outreach. In addition to a collaborative and supportive culture, here are a few additional perks that are enjoyed by the Z SUPPLY team:

  • Half-Day Fridays year-round
  • Generous clothing discount
  • New chic and modern offices located near top restaurants and shopping in Costa Mesa, CA
  • Comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • 401K with discretionary employer match of up to $2500
  • Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Paid Preventative Health Care Time Off, Paid Birthdays and various other company perks and benefits.
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity leave following 1-2 years of service
  • Collaborative, cohesive team environment focused on a thriving, progressive , inclusive & dynamic company culture
  • Hybrid work arrangement — collaborative on-site presence balanced with focused remote work
  • A creative environment where brand-building is taken seriously and this role has real influence

  2. Quality Control:Ensure that all construction work is performed in accordance with the plans, specifications, and quality standards. Inspect the work being done and identify any issues or defects. Conduct regular checks on the quality of materials used and the workmanship on site.
  3. Safety Management:Ensure compliance with the Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) Act and regulations in Singapore. Conduct daily safety briefings, toolbox meetings, and implement corrective actions where necessary. Monitor the construction site for safety hazards and take immediate action to address any risks.
  4. Liaising with Stakeholders:Act as a point of contact between the project team (architects, engineers, and project managers) and workers on site. Communicate progress, issues, and any delays to senior management, clients, or contractors. Assist with resolving any on-site disputes or challenges between workers, subcontractors, or other stakeholders.
  5. Resource Management:Ensure that adequate labor, materials, and equipment are available on-site for the timely execution of construction work. Maintain an inventory of materials and ensure that they are stored properly. Monitor and control costs associated with materials and labor.
  6. Scheduling and Planning:Assist in planning work schedules and allocate tasks to workers based on their skills and availability. Ensure that the project adheres to established timelines and work schedules. Monitor work progress and resolve any delays or issues that may arise.
  7. Documentation and Reporting:Keep accurate records of daily activities, progress, work completed, issues, and safety inspections. Provide regular reports on site progress and any issues to the project manager. Maintain records of inspections, permits, and any required certifications.
  8. Problem Solving:Troubleshoot and resolve issues that arise during construction, whether they are related to technical problems, delays, or disputes. Ensure that corrective actions are implemented to prevent future issues.
  9. Environmental Compliance:Ensure that construction practices adhere to environmental regulations and standards. Implement waste management and sustainability practices, including the proper disposal of construction waste.
  10. Training and Development:
  • Provide on-the-job training for workers and ensure they are familiar with the tools, equipment, and safety measures.
  • Encourage continuous learning and compliance with industry standards.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • A diploma or degree in civil engineering, construction management, or a related field.
  • Prior experience in construction supervision or project management.
  • Knowledge of local construction laws, regulations, and safety standards (e.g., WSH Act in Singapore).
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in project management software or tools is a plus.

Working Conditions:

  • Construction supervisors in Singapore may work long hours, including weekends or holidays, depending on the project deadlines.
  • They are often required to work on-site, exposing them to various weather conditions and the inherent risks of construction work.

This role is crucial in ensuring that construction projects are completed efficiently, safely, and according to specifications, all while maintaining high standards of quality and safety.

GCI's Principal Architect will define, communicate, govern, and advance architecture direction in support of business outcomes, technology modernization, operational effectiveness, and long-term organizational objectives. These roles partner with business, product, engineering, delivery, operations, and leadership stakeholders to translate organizational needs into sustainable solutions, standards, roadmaps, and technology capabilities. The job family provides architectural leadership across products, platforms, systems, services, and business capabilities by developing guidance, patterns, target-state designs, and roadmaps that reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility, and optimize technology investments. Roles apply common architecture principles, governance practices, and industry standards across one or more architecture practice areas, with scope, autonomy, and decision influence increasing by career level.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assess business objectives, customer needs, operational priorities, current-state capabilities, technologies, processes, operating models, risks, dependencies, architecture gaps, technical debt, lifecycle risks, and modernization opportunities.
  • Develop target-state architectures, transition states, and roadmaps that guide technology investment, solution design, and implementation planning.
  • Create architecture artifacts, models, standards, patterns, reference designs, principles, non-functional requirements, and design guardrails; evaluate alternatives and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and governance forums, applying architecture standards, policies, principles, and industry practices.
  • Manage architecture risks, dependencies, technical debt, lifecycle considerations, exceptions, reusable assets, repositories, and technology rationalization efforts.
  • Partner with product, delivery, engineering, and operations teams to provide architecture guidance through planning, design, delivery, and operationalization.
  • Support road mapping, dependency management, implementation sequencing, decision facilitation, trade-off discussions, and alignment to intended architecture outcomes.

The core responsibilities and minimum qualifications outlined in this job description apply across the Architect job family. Discipline-specific responsibilities, technical competencies, and/or preferred qualifications are defined in the applicable addendum. See the corresponding discipline-specific addendum for additional details.

Defines enterprise-wide business and technology direction, target-state architecture, capability alignment, governance standards, portfolio strategy, and technology roadmaps. Provides strategic guidance to align investments, modernization, and architecture decisions with long-term organizational objectives.

Business Architecture:

Defines business capabilities, value streams, operating model impacts, business process alignment, organizational dependencies, and business architecture views that connect strategy to execution.

AI Architecture:

Defines architecture direction for artificial intelligence capabilities, including model and solution patterns, responsible AI guardrails, data and integration dependencies, platform alignment, lifecycle management, risk controls, and adoption guidance.

Minimum Qualifications:

Recognized organizational authority; sets long-term architecture strategy, principles, and technical direction.
